name: AGCOM – Copilot pilot & report classification
authority: Autorità per le Garanzie nelle Comunicazioni (AGCOM)
desc: AGCOM has launched a pilot making Copilot available to roughly 10–15% of staff, with the aim of extending coverage. It is evaluating a system to analyse and classify user reports about improper conduct and online hate speech.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: ART – consumer NLP chatbot
desc: ART's main live use case is a consumer chatbot on its institutional website that gives basic guidance. It is based purely on NLP, not generative AI (excluded for now over data-security and retention concerns). ART is assessing ML to classify complaints by transport mode.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: AgID – generative-AI productivity tools & code generation
keywords: GenAI assistant, code generation, open-source LLM
desc: AgID equips its staff with generative-AI assistants and uses GenAI to write deterministic code (reporting a sharp drop in development time). It is also running experiments with open-source GenAI models, with a view to building internal chatbots.
envMethod: AgID's draft AI guidelines require administrations to carry out an organisational-level environmental-impact assessment; AgID also issues opinions on large ICT investments (e.g. INPS and INAIL data centres) reviewing their energy consumption. National/EU technical metrics for measuring AI's footprint are under development.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Banca d'Italia – in-house AI development
desc: Among the most advanced administrations, Banca d'Italia prefers to develop AI systems in-house, ensuring control over the code, flexibility and the growth of internal skills.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: CONSOB – market-abuse detection & greenwashing screening
authority: Commissione Nazionale per le Società e la Borsa (CONSOB)
keywords: unsupervised ML, K-means, PCA, ClimateBERT, ESGBert, web scraping, RAG
desc: CONSOB uses unsupervised ML (K-means, PCA) to detect anomalous trading patterns and potential market abuse; web scraping plus semantic text/image analysis to support shutting down abusive websites; vertical models (ClimateBERT, ESGBert) to screen bond prospectuses for greenwashing; and a RAG-based internal chatbot.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Corte dei conti – financial-distress prediction & ruling anonymisation
authority: Corte dei conti (Italian Court of Auditors)
keywords: predictive model, anonymisation, document checking, Copilot
desc: The Court runs an ML model (piloted since March 2025) predicting the insolvency risk of local authorities and ranking their 'virtuousness' to steer audits; an LLM project that selectively anonymises rulings; and automated congruence checks of regional political-group accounts.
envMethod: Underwent an IT-sustainability assessment scoring ~70% adherence to green criteria (qualitative, partly based on cloud-provider data). Applies green-by-design choices: preference for pre-trained models, environments active only during testing, pipelines that spin up resources only when needed. Internal energy-use guidelines issued; evaluating adding AI environmental impact to staff training.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: INPS – PEC email routing, virtual assistants & 'green index'
keywords: email classification, virtual assistant, on-prem GPU, Copilot 365, green coding
desc: INPS automatically classifies and routes certified e-mail (PEC) to the competent offices; runs citizen virtual assistants trained only on public sources; invested in on-prem GPUs for GenAI on sensitive data; and is rolling out Copilot 365 (~2,000 licences) with structured staff training.
envMethod: Developing a 'green index' that measures software energy efficiency from the coding stage (e.g. how efficiently code is written), set to become a mandatory requirement for new developments, plus green-coding guidelines. Running three data centres, INPS tracks energy costs directly on its own budget.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: ISPRA – environmental research & call for AI footprint standards
authority: Istituto Superiore per la Protezione e la Ricerca Ambientale (ISPRA)
desc: ISPRA, the national environmental-protection and research institute, uses AI in its work and has voiced strong concern about the limited attention the regulatory framework (including the AI Act) pays to AI's environmental footprint.
envMethod: Has not yet measured the impact of its own systems but calls for a coordinated EU approach to define measurement standards for AI's environmental footprint.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Provincia Autonoma di Trento – ChatPAT, PATBOT & AIxPA platform
keywords: Gemini, ChatPAT, PATBOT, RAG, AIxPA, orchestration platform
desc: PAT is rolling Gemini out to provincial staff (after a mandatory AI-fundamentals course) and has built two LLM+RAG chatbots — ChatPAT (website interaction) and PATBOT (public competitions). With Fondazione Bruno Kessler it takes part in the national 'AIxPA' flagship, building an AI-orchestration platform on Azure.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Reg4IA – Italian Regions' AI proof-of-concept programme
keywords: PoC, quantum communication, fibre sensing, disaster resilience, policy support
desc: Under Reg4IA (Innovation-Fund-backed AI prototypes), Italian regions co-develop pilots: Liguria-led health waiting-lists & tourism flows; Toscana-led territorial resilience to disasters using quantum communication and fibre sensing; Puglia-led AI support to administrative decisions and policy-making.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Regione Emilia-Romagna – Copilot pilot & 'Savia' legislative assistant
keywords: Copilot, Savia, legislative drafting, BETTI, Interreg
desc: Emilia-Romagna piloted 300 Copilot licences (the strongest use case: the regional accounting office checking commitment/payment acts, cutting some steps by up to 50%). With universities it is building 'Savia', an open-source LLM supporting legislative-impact evaluation and drafting. It is a partner in the Interreg 'BETTI' project on responsible GenAI.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Regione Friuli-Venezia Giulia – SUAP chatbot & tender-anomaly detection
keywords: SUAP chatbot, FAQ, public procurement, anomaly detection, Horizon Europe
desc: FVG built a chatbot for the SUAP business one-stop-shop, giving municipalities fast, uniform answers on procedures based on regional FAQs and law. It also takes part in a Horizon Europe project analysing tender documents to flag anomalies and suspicious patterns (e.g. recurring discounts, abnormal bids).
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Regione Liguria – in-house development & Reg4IA health/tourism PoC
keywords: in-house, Liguria Digitale, Reg4IA, waiting lists, tourism flows
desc: Liguria favours in-house development through Liguria Digitale to keep control of data and technological independence, and leads a Reg4IA proof-of-concept on reducing health waiting lists and managing tourism flows.
envMethod: Direct, hands-on experience of infrastructure/energy costs: installed a water-cooling system for a single dedicated test server, highlighting the energy density of AI workloads — illustrating the tension between digital sovereignty (in-house) and the superior compute of large private providers. No formal measurement yet.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: Regione Lombardia – controlled AI experiments with human oversight
keywords: virtual assistants, document search, job matching, back office, ARIA
desc: Lombardy runs a structured set of supervised AI experiments: advanced virtual assistants, citizen-communication support, intelligent search across large archives, labour supply–demand matching and back-office work on EU funds. AI never takes automatic decisions; it supports preparatory and control activities.
envMethod: Through its in-house body ARIA, procurement benchmarking jointly weighs effectiveness, cost, security and sustainability when selecting GenAI/embedding solutions (SaaS via API), alongside parallel tests of on-premise deployments.
source: Astrid–SUSTAIN-AI-REG joint research (Fantoni & Rallo, BioLaw Journal 2/2026)

name: AI for healthcare project in Albania
desc: Healthcare systems face pressure to detect diseases earlier and manage growing diagnostic workloads. Albania aims to strengthen diagnostic capacity through advanced digital tools. The objective of this project is to support clinicians in radiology by improving early detection and treatment planning.

name: AI for taxation project in Albania
desc: Combating tax evasion and financial crime requires timely detection of anomalies across large volumes of transactional data. Albania aims to enhance its tax administration by automating routine analysis while strengthening investigative capacity.

name: AI-Driven Harmonisation of Albanian Legislation with the EU Aquis
authority: National Agency of Information Society, under the Prime Minister’s authority
desc: The AI-assisted platform, developed by Microsoft in partnership with the Albanian Government, accelerates the transposition of EU legislation into Albanian law, enhancing both administrative efficiency (G2G) and public service quality (G2C, G2B).

name: AI-powered procurement platform
desc: Public procurement processes are often time-consuming, error-prone and vulnerable to inefficiencies that undermine transparency and competition. In Albania, authorities seek to modernise procurement practices to improve fairness and operational efficiency.

name: Albania to speed up EU accession using ChatGPT
desc: Aligning national legislation with the European Union acquis requires the translation, interpretation, and integration of very large volumes of legal and regulatory material, making accession an administratively demanding and time-intensive process.

name: Diella - World's First Virtual Minister
desc: The Albanian government, led by Prime Minister Edi Rama, has appointed Diella, an artificial intelligence system, as a full member of its cabinet, making it the world’s first AI-powered government minister.

name: Machine Thinking Lab to accelerate the advancement of AI technologies
desc: The project represents a strategic partnership between the Government of Albania and the AI startup Machine Thinking Lab, founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati.

name: Nation-wide AI-powered smart city project
desc: Rapid urbanisation and increased mobility place pressure on city infrastructure, traffic management and emergency response. Albania has launched a nationwide initiative to modernise urban management across 20 cities.

name: e-Albania platform chatbot
authority: Albanian national agency of information technology (AKSHI)
desc: The chatbot for citizens enquiries was developed by the Albanian national agency of information technology and is available on the e-Albania platform, that was launched at the beginning of 2024.

name: A DIGITAL BUILDING PERMIT SYSTEM FOR THE SMART CITY in Wien
authority: City of Wien - Municipal Directorate of Strategic ICT
desc: BRISE (Building Regulations Information for Submission Envolvement) generally stands for smart, efficient public administration. Based on administrative procedures in building and construction as an example for smart digital administration, the City of Vienna has taken on a pioneering role in Europe.

name: AI Act Chatbot
desc: The AI Act Chatbot by Digital Austria is an online service developed to assist citizens, businesses, and public institutions in understanding and complying with the European AI Act.

name: AI Literacy in Action: An Interactive and Reusable Prompting Workbook for Public Servants
desc: The AI Prompting Workbook was developed to rapidly build AI literacy among public administration employees, addressing the limitations of passive training formats and fulfilling capacity-building requirements under the EU AI Act.

name: AI for analysing incoming mail
desc: Automated routing of all incoming documents (structured and unstructured, scanned and via ELC), without manual processing of the administration staff of the courts.

name: AI for analysing investigative data in Austria
desc: Austrian authorities implemented advanced analytics tools to process and analyse large volumes of investigative data in complex cases involving fraud and financial crime.

name: AI for anonymisation of court decisions
desc: Automated anonymization and metadata recognition of court decisions and preparation for publication in the Legal Information System (RIS).

name: AI for digital file management
desc: For consistent file management, incoming unstructured documents should be processed uniformly and metadata should be adopted automatically. The intelligent digitization of existing paper files should also be supported.

name: AI:AT New AI-optimised Supercomputer
desc: The AI Factory Austria (AI:AT) is a national initiative launched on 12 March 2025 to strengthen Austria’s AI ecosystem as part of the European High-Performance Computing (EuroHPC) AI Factories programme.

name: AMS Berufs Infomat -  personalized career advice for job seekers
desc: Job seekers often struggle to navigate complex information on occupations, training pathways, and reskilling opportunities, particularly in a rapidly changing labour market.

name: AMS – Algorithmic Profiling in the Austrian Public Employment Service
desc: Public employment services aim to allocate counselling resources and labour market programmes efficiently while supporting diverse jobseekers with varying employment prospects.

name: AmigaAI - Chatbot for the legal sector
desc: The GesetzeFinden.at Legal AI project is Austria’s first AI model specifically designed for the legal sector.

name: Auditing a City of Vienna AI solution under IEEE CertifAIEd
desc: Public service providers increasingly deploy automated systems that must align with ethical, legal, and societal values. The City of Vienna sought to ensure that its digital services adhere to principles of transparency, accountability, and human-centric design.

name: Bebot – Vienna AirportCity Virtual Assistant
desc: Airports must provide clear, up-to-date information to diverse users, particularly during disruptions such as public health emergencies, while managing high volumes of enquiries. Vienna AirportCity introduced a digital assistant to support visitors navigating transport, facilities, and Covid-19-related requirements.

name: Chatbot - City of Vienna
desc: The City of Vienna website provides comprehensive, detailed content, while the WienBot is all about information for immediate use. People looking for specific information while out and about need a different kind of content to those accessing the web from home.

name: Chatbot - austrian Federal Ministry of Justice
desc: The chatbot is an interactive assistant of the Austrian Ministry of Justice that helps users navigate justice services by answering simple legal-administrative questions.

name: Data-driven Wildfire Prevention System for Forest
desc: Forest authorities face increasing risks from wildfires due to climate change, requiring early detection and accurate risk assessment over large areas. In Salzburg, managing forest safety demanded real-time environmental insights to support preventive action.

name: ELLI - Chatbot of the City of Linz
desc: The City of Linz provides an AI-powered chatbot service called “ELLI” (short for Elektronische Linzerin) to help citizens find information about municipal services quickly and easily.

name: Eduthek - The learning platform on AI for schools
authority: Federal Ministry of Education, Science and Research ( BMBWF )
desc: Schools need accessible, up-to-date teaching materials on artificial intelligence, yet many teachers and families lack the time or specialist expertise to assemble reliable resources independently.

name: FOLDOUT - Through-foliage detection, including in the outermost regions of the EU
desc: FOLDOUT is an Horizon 2020 project focusing on border surveillance with the use of AI and machine learning algorithms. With novel specialised machine learning algorithms and performance evaluation matrices FOLDOUT technology provides added value to sensor data .

name: Flynn - first AI-art university student
desc: Flynn, a non-human student, has been admitted to the digital art programme at the University of Applied Arts Vienna after successfully completing the same application process as human applicants, including portfolio submission, interviews and an artistic suitability test.

name: Graz outfits intersection with smart sensors to improve cyclist commute
desc: Municipal officials sought a low-cost tool for capturing traffic trends and potential violations. latvian firm LMT's AI-powered platform evaluates video footage and categorizes different types of traffic. This system monitors bus lane use by passenger vehicles, illegal turns, and red-light violations.

name: JustizOnline
desc: The idea of JustizOnline is, firstly, that physically going to court will no longer be necessary in many cases and, secondly, that information and answers will be provided quickly. The chatbot “Justitia” guides people in search of information directly to the information and functions that are relevant to them.

name: LLM-Based Agents for User Story Quality Enhancement in Agile Development
desc: In agile software development, poorly specified user stories can reduce productivity, create misunderstandings and increase rework. Austrian Post Group IT explored automated approaches to enhance user story quality within development teams.

name: Mona - Public chatbot for companies on the subject of the economy
desc: Businesses often need rapid, reliable guidance on economic measures, employment rules, subsidies, and administrative obligations, especially during periods of disruption such as the coronavirus crisis, when demand for official information rises sharply and questions become more varied.

name: Smart Assistant - Development of a chatbot for the municipalities of the LEADER Region Weinviertel Ost
desc: Municipalities in the LEADER Region Weinviertel Ost needed a practical way to automate routine online interactions and improve digital service delivery without each authority having to build separate solutions from scratch.

name: SmartDriveAI - digitising accident reporting
desc: SmartDrive AI enhances road safety by digitising accident reporting, enabling real-time GPS-tagged incident reports with multilingual support. Partnering with Graz Linien and Mapular, the platform integrates external data like weather conditions to provide proactive safety alerts.

name: Vienna AI with generative search (de: WienKI mit generative Suche)
desc: The City of Vienna has proactively embraced artificial intelligence to modernise public administration and deliver tangible benefits to citizens and employees.

name: agrifoodTEF - innovative AI and robotics applications for the Austrian agricultural and food industry
desc: The AgriFood TEF (Testing and Experimentation Facility) by Digital Austria is a national initiative designed to support the application of artificial intelligence in the agriculture and food sectors.

name: A new virtual assistant for the city of Kortrijk
desc: The City of Kortrijk sought to enhance accessibility to municipal services and streamline citizen interactions as part of a broader regional digitalisation strategy supported by NextGenerationEU funding. Traditional service channels often require in-person visits or complex navigation of online portals.

name: AI platform for agri-food applications from field to fork
authority: Flanders Research Institute for Agriculture, Fisheries and Food (ILVO)
desc: Across ILVO’s living labs, food pilot, greenhouses, laboratories and test environments, large volumes of data are generated every day from IoT sensors, machine-mounted cameras, drones, satellites and analytical equipment.

name: AI within the Flanders Investment and Trade organisation
desc: Flanders Investment and Trade (FIT), the regional trade promotion organisation, manages numerous ‘trade cases’ submitted by Flemish companies seeking information on foreign markets, regulations, partners or opportunities.

name: AI-Based Public Sentiment Analysis – Statistics Flanders (Belgium)
desc: Statistics Flanders explored the use of publicly available social media data to complement official statistics with timely insights into public sentiment. The objective was to assess societal reactions to major events such as the COVID-19 pandemic and the war in Ukraine.

name: AI-enable accessibility check tool to make EU-compliant federal websites
authority: Federal Public Service Policy ans Support (FPS BOSA)
desc: Following the EU Web Accessibility Directive requiring public sector websites to meet accessibility standards, Belgium’s Federal Public Service Policy and Support (BOSA) sought to improve consistency and reduce manual errors in compliance assessments.

name: AI4AGRIFOOD platform in Flanders - Precision agriculture and data technology
authority: Flanders Research Institute for Agriculture, Fisheries and Food (ILVO)
desc: Agricultural research institutions increasingly rely on data science and advanced analytics, yet researchers often face barriers in accessing user-friendly tools that accommodate varying levels of technical expertise.

name: ALTRUIS - Alternative Use of Imaging Systems through Artificial Intelligence
authority: DigiPolis, IT provider for the City of Antwerp
desc: With the project Alternative Use of Imaging Systems through Artificial Intelligence (ALTRUIS), Digipolis wants to help tackle the mobility problem in and around the city ​​of Antwerp by using camera images alternatively and using Artificial Intelligence (AI).

name: AcPaas - Technical procurement documents comparison
desc: Public procurement processes often involve reviewing complex technical documents and determining whether existing internal digital components could already meet some of the stated requirements.

name: Algorithmic school registrations
desc: In many Belgian cities, there are problems when registering children for schools, especially when a lot of parents want to register their children at the same school. This has led to parents spending several nights in tents outside schools so that they can be the first to register their children.

name: Asbestos suspect roofs from aerial imagery
desc: Identifying buildings with asbestos-containing roofing materials is essential for public health, environmental protection and safe renovation planning, yet manual inspections across large territories are costly and time-consuming.

name: Belgian city uses artificial intelligence to tackle noise pollution
desc: Excessive traffic noise poses health and safety risks for residents, yet traditional enforcement relies on sporadic checks and citizen complaints. Genk aimed to better quantify and address noise pollution along a busy street.

name: Belgium - Detection batch numbers vaccines
desc: Accurate recording of vaccine batch numbers is essential for pharmacovigilance, traceability and rapid response to safety issues, yet non-standardised packaging complicates manual data entry. Stakeholders include Child and Family services, healthcare professionals and public health authorities.

name: Brussels Airport Company – Baggage Forecasting Project (Belgium)
desc: To prevent bottlenecks in baggage handling, Brussels Airport Company implemented predictive analytics to forecast the number of bags per flight, with particular focus on time-critical transfer baggage.

name: Brussels Airport Company – Check-in Forecasting Project (Belgium)
desc: As part of its Airport Operations Plan, Brussels Airport Company sought to optimise workforce allocation by forecasting passenger arrivals at check-in counters in 30-minute intervals. Fluctuating passenger flows can create congestion or underutilised staff capacity.

name: Brussels Airport Company – Passenger Reduced Mobility (PRM) Forecasting (Belgium)
desc: Brussels Airport Company aimed to improve planning for assistance services provided to passengers with reduced mobility (PRMs), a resource-intensive yet essential service. Daily fluctuations in PRM numbers require accurate staffing forecasts to maintain service quality without incurring excessive costs.

name: CATE - Continuous Auditing based on Technological Evolution and Data Mining
desc: The Flemish Audit Authority is responsible for the (financial and operational) auditing of the projects that are subsidized through European structural funds and Flemish co-financing. A significant proportion of audits must be outsourced.

name: CSAI: Cyber Security Artificial Intelligence
desc: Funded by the innovation & entrepreneurship agency in Flanders (Vlaanderen Agentschap Innoveren & Ondernemen), this project aims to move beyond the stage of automated data analytics and to seek models and techniques that provide some degree of intelligence beyond this level, that can serve Cyber Security technology…

name: Camera System - Mobile phone usage on vehicles
desc: The Belgian road safety institute Vias identified the growing risk of traffic accidents caused by drivers using mobile phones while driving, particularly handheld usage. Traditional enforcement methods rely heavily on manual observation by police, limiting detection rates and scalability.

name: Capsat - Information from satellite images for a better agricultural policy in Flanders and Europe
desc: Every Flemish farmer who receives 'direct support' within the European Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) is obliged to adhere to a number of climate and environmentally friendly principles and practices with a view to sustainable, liveable and competitive agriculture.

name: Chatbot - City of Rosealare
desc: The City of Roeselare receives frequent general enquiries from residents and visitors covering a wide range of municipal topics, from administrative services to local facilities. Managing these enquiries through traditional channels can be resource-intensive and limit availability outside office hours.

name: CitizenLab - Youth for Climate
desc: Large-scale participatory initiatives often succeed in collecting substantial volumes of ideas and opinions, yet the real challenge lies in processing that material quickly enough to turn it into meaningful recommendations and actions.

name: Clearance of dumped war ammunition in the North Sea
authority: Department of Mobility and Public Works (MOW)
desc: On the North Sea sandbank De Paardenmarkt near Knokke, around 35,000 tonnes of First World War ammunition, including both conventional and chemical munitions, remain buried beneath the seabed.

name: Competence based matching - a success story from Flanders to Malta
authority: Flemish Employment and Vocational Training Service (VDAB)
desc: Public employment services often struggle to match jobseekers and vacancies accurately due to vague job descriptions and inconsistent skill profiling. This leads to inefficient labour market matching and prolonged unemployment.

name: Computer-related and AI services for CATE project
desc: The Flemish Audit Authority launched the CATE project to modernise audit processes through advanced data analytics and automation. Traditional auditing relies on periodic manual sampling, which may limit timeliness and coverage.

name: Creation and management of semantic OTL relationships
authority: Roads and Traffic Agency of the Flemish Government
desc: With the implementation of Construction Information Management (BIM) , which (generally) relates to virtual construction and digital collaboration between all project partners within a construction project, the Roads and Traffic Agency (AWV) of the Flemish government is fully committed to the evolution towards a…

name: Crowd monitoring in Antwerp
desc: The City of Antwerp required accurate, real-time insights into crowd movements to support public safety, mobility management, and city marketing, particularly during large events and peak activity periods. Traditional manual counting and static sensors provided limited coverage and delayed insights.

name: Deep learning-based mapping of tree density and species diversity in Flemish forests
desc: Forest managers require accurate, large-scale and up-to-date information on tree density and species diversity to support biodiversity conservation, climate adaptation strategies and sustainable timber management. Traditional field surveys are resource-intensive and limited in spatial coverage.

name: Digital Europe Language Tools - Named-entity recognition
desc: The eTranslation Named-Entity Recognition (NER) service provides EU institutions with automated extraction of key entities from documents in common formats. Administrations handling multilingual documentation require efficient methods to identify references to persons, organisations and locations.

name:
Digital Europe Language Tools - Social Media Translator, Anonymization support,
Classification
desc: The eTranslation Social Media Translator enables EU institutions to publish multilingual social media content efficiently while maintaining consistency and reach. Communication teams often need to disseminate short messages across multiple EU languages under tight deadlines.

name: Digital Europe Language Tools - Speech Transcription
desc: The eTranslation Speech Transcription service was developed to provide EU institutions and public administrations with an accessible tool for converting audio and video content into written text.

name: Digital Europe Language Tools - eBriefing
desc: eBriefing is an AI-based drafting service developed within the European Commission’s language technology ecosystem to assist in preparing official briefings. EU staff frequently need structured briefing documents summarising complex materials in a standard institutional format.

name: Digital Europe Language Tools - eSummary
desc: Public administrations and organisations handle large volumes of documents, making it time-consuming to identify relevant information quickly. The European Commission developed eSummary to support faster understanding of documents across languages.

name: Driving collective data governance through smart engagement platforms (COLLIBRA)
desc: The goal of this project is to bring data governance closer to the actual workplaces that are using the data by tapping into the many business applications that shape systems of engagement, ranging from physical board rooms and design workshops to virtual team collaboration tools such as Confluence and Slack.

name: EPD: Employability in programme development
desc: The EPD -project has the following goals (1) Map the availability of information on skills demand for each participating institution as well as the needs of practitioners in participating Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) for labour market intelligence to inform course and programme design.

name: EV Charging Optimiser
desc: In this project, VUB and Energis aim to develop an efficient and viable way to charge an entire fleet of EVs in a coordinated and controlled way, and to test this approach in lab and real environments. Unlike synthetic ones, real environments are characterised by a high degree of unpredictability.

name: Elsa - AI-assisted spreading decisions
desc: The Agency for Roads and Traffic (AWV) is responsible for the control of slippery conditions on Flemish roads under its own management. The AWV winter service is supported for this with various data sources and technical tools.

name: Face recognition system at Brussels Airport
desc: In July 2015, Brussels Airport installed ‘e-gates’ with face recognition technology that checks the identity of EU-citizens from outside the Schengen zone. It electronically checks to see if identity papers are real and if a passenger is flagged.

name: Fietsbarometer - barometer for cycleways safety
desc: The Province of Antwerp developed the Fietsbarometer as a web-based participatory platform to assess and improve cycling safety, particularly on home-to-school routes.

name: Flemish Infoline - Automatic classification of incoming phone calls
desc: Public contact centres handle large volumes of citizen questions across multiple channels, and service quality often depends on how quickly each request can be understood, categorised, routed, and answered by the most suitable staff member.

name: Fraud detection in family allowances (Groeipakket)
desc: Fraud Detection in Family Allowances (Groeipakket) addresses the need to safeguard the Flemish Government’s family benefits system, which distributes approximately €4 billion annually to 1.6 million children residing in Flanders.

name: Ghent turns downtown traffic data into predictions during three-month pilot
desc: The pilot tests four types of cameras and sensors throughout Gent's downtown streets. Each device gathers anonymized data on pedestrians, cyclists, and vehicles for analysis by an AI-powered system.

name: Healthy Food production with AI
desc: The Healthy Food project is a joint project with Puratos and the AI Lab of the Vub.

name: Henchman - contract drafing with AI support
desc: Uses GPT-3.5 to enrich drafting options, for example to change single to plural in a clause or add an element to a clause.

name: HoPE - Holistic Personal public Eco-mobility
desc: The overall platform is intended to be user oriented and user centric, in a way that will foster and promote user awareness and consciousness about public transports and eco-mobility, other than providing for a significant mix of services including info-mobility, trip planning, ticket reservation, fare calculation and…

name: IADAS: project to identify individual tree and tree species based on EO and AI
desc: Monitoring forest ecosystems at individual tree level is essential for biodiversity assessment, carbon accounting and precision forestry, yet conventional surveys lack scalability. Stakeholders include environmental authorities, forestry services and research institutions.

name: ILVO supporting Flanders AI research program (FAIR) pilots
authority: Instituut voor Landbouw-, Visserij- en Voedingsonderzoek
place: Région de Bruxelles-Capitale/ Brussels Hoofdstedelijk Gewest
desc: The Institute for Agricultural, Fisheries and Food Research (ILVO) participates in the Flanders AI Research Programme (FAIR) to explore the application of advanced data-driven methods in agriculture and food systems.

name: ISA2 Action 1.7 – AI Pilot for Document Classification
desc: Public administrations frequently handle large volumes of unstructured documents and emails that must be reviewed within strict deadlines, particularly in investigative and compliance contexts. Manual classification is labour-intensive and may lead to inconsistencies.

name: Innovative functionalities and AI for energy saving in the public sector
authority: Felmish Energy Company (VEB), Agency for Facility Operations (HFB) and Flemish Energy Agency (VEA)
desc: The Flemish public sector manages a large and diverse portfolio of buildings and infrastructure, yet turning building and energy data into practical action remains a complex task.

name: Jobnet - Reskilling, upskilling and retraining of people
authority: Vlaamse Dienst voor Arbeidsbemiddeling en Beroepsopleiding
desc: Labour markets change rapidly, and many citizens need support to understand how their existing experience and capabilities relate to emerging job opportunities, especially when they are seeking to reskill, upskill, or retrain.

name: LEOS Case 2: Transposition of EU directives
desc: This use case explores how AI can be used to document the transposition and consolidation of EU law into Member States.

name: LEOS Case 3: Derogations and transitory provisions
desc: This use case explores how AI classification can detect derogations and connect them with the initial obligations. We also wanted to detect the temporal parameters, when they are declared in the text, and the conditions when the derogation is applicable

name: LEOS Case 4: Checking for digital readiness
desc: This use case explores how to support the assessment of an act’s digital readiness: policies and legislative acts are digital-ready if they enable smooth and digital-by-default policy implementation through best use of digital technologies and data. There are three main subgoals in this proof of concept: 1.

name: LEOS Case Study 1: Learning from examining corrigenda
desc: This use case can detect patterns that could be avoided in legal drafting, with benefits that include better regulation, clear legislation, bringing down the costs associated with republication, and saving time in making updated legislation available.

name: Managing vacancies - Recommender: the amazon of the labour market
authority: Flemish Employment and Vocational Training Service (VDAB)
desc: Public employment services face challenges in efficiently matching jobseekers with suitable vacancies, particularly as labour markets become more dynamic and digitally mediated. Traditional keyword-based search functions often fail to capture skills proximity, transferable competences and evolving job profiles.

name: MareGraph: Towards an interoperable marine knowledge graph
desc: The aim of MAREGRAPH is to support the EU and its Member States in the achievement of ambitious marine themed objectives by semantically enriching, interlinking and providing high value and foundational datasets.

name: Monitoring structure health of bridges with InSAR
authority: Flemish Ministry of Mobility and Public Works (MOW)
desc: Public authorities responsible for bridge management must ensure structural safety while optimising inspection budgets and minimising traffic disruption. Conventional monitoring relies on periodic visual inspections and targeted topographic surveys, which may fail to detect gradual deformations at an early stage.

name: NER-based extraction of contract data
desc: Public bodies that handle large volumes of incoming correspondence and forms often face a difficult administrative problem: important information is buried in siloed documents and must be extracted manually before it can be reused in central systems.

name: Naamsestraat - Reduce night noise through technology and nudging
desc: Naamsestraat in Leuven is a busy transit route for people returning home after a night out, and this regularly generates disturbance for residents through late-night noise.

name: Optimum - decision making for efficient integration of transport modes
desc: OPTIMUM was created to support urban authorities in making better decisions about the integration of transport modes across interconnected mobility systems.

name: Parcel Monitoring Platform Flanders, an AI-based geo-imaging tool for data-driven policy formulation and evaluation
desc: Public authorities increasingly need continuous, parcel-level intelligence to support decisions in agriculture, energy, spatial planning, and environmental management, yet raw satellite imagery alone is often too noisy and technically demanding for direct policy use.

name: PaveAI 2.0 - Interprets the figures in Google Analytics via machine learning and custom reports
desc: VISITFLANDERS explored the use of automated analytics tools to better interpret website performance data and support digital marketing strategies. Analysing large volumes of web analytics data requires specialised expertise and can be time-consuming, limiting the ability to quickly derive actionable insights.

name: Predictive ADM systems for healthcare and upbringing
desc: A Brussels startup called Kantify and the AI Lab at the Université Libre Bruxelles (Iridia) has—for the first time—developed a model for predicting atrial fibrillation, a heart rhythm disorder, which causes heart attacks.

name: Procurement data quality and CPV improvement for TED data
desc: Improve TED data quality, have better expenditure data and statistics with AI. Objectives are: (1) Elaborate Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV) codes from notice/procurement documents through Natural Language Processing (NLP) (2) Elaborate statistics (examples: which DG spent the most money in the past 5 years?

name: Quickscan Organisaties
authority: Departement Cultuur, Jeugd en Media (CJM) - Wallonia
desc: Grant-making bodies often face a heavy administrative burden when assessing subsidy applications, particularly where they must judge not only the substantive quality of a proposal but also whether the applicant has sufficient organisational and business maturity to deliver it successfully.

name: Remote interpreting services - Communicating in Flemish sign language
authority: Flemish Agency for Persons with Disabilities
desc: A remote interpreting service offers the deaf the opportunity to communicate with hearing people (and vice versa) remotely in Flemish Sign Language.

name: School choice preferences algorithm in the Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles
desc: The Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles uses an authomatic algorithm to allocate children to secondary schools depending on their preferences. First, for each school in their list of preferred schools, students receive a random rank.

name: Semi-Supervised Training to Improve Detection for Satellite Images
desc: Detecting objects and land features in satellite imagery often requires extensive labelled datasets, which are costly and time-consuming to produce. Limited annotated data can constrain model performance and scalability.

name: Shelfex AI - Predictive AI transforming shelf life management
desc: Belgian food safety technology company Handary has implemented a predictive, AI-driven approach to transform how food shelf life is managed.

name: Smart Personalisation of the cultural offer in Antwerp Testing (SOCRATES)
desc: The City of Antwerp and Digipolis launched SOCRATES to address a growing challenge in cultural participation: citizens are exposed to a broad and fragmented cultural offer, yet it is often difficult to connect individuals with activities and content that genuinely match their interests.

name: Smart regulation - Using Artificial Intelligence to train computers to interpret regulation
desc: Regulations are extremely valuable information that is relevant to everyone in our society. However, the large amount of divergent and incoherent regulation leads to information silos. There are so many different types of documents that there is little structure to be found in them.

name: Smart video surveillance by the local police: Briefcam
authority: Local police in the cities of Kortrijk, Kuurne, and Lendelde (VLAS)
desc: Since 2019, the local police in the cities of Kortrijk, Kuurne, and Lendelde (VLAS) have been using a ‘smart’ video surveillance system developed by an American company called Briefcam. The system stores all ‘objects’ (for example: people, small and large vehicles, and animals) that appear in the video images.

name: The Flemish public employment service reinvents orientation tests with AI
desc: VDAB, the Flemish public employment service, modernised its career orientation testing system to provide more personalised guidance for job seekers. Traditional standardised tests offered limited adaptability to individual profiles and labour market trends.

name: Turing - Automatically control Flemish road lighting with local and current data
desc: On Flemish motorways, road lighting is only on where it is needed. Specifically, the light goes out when possible and stays on when necessary. In 2011, the Agency for Roads and Traffic (AWV) developed a light vision in response to the European Union's climate target to reduce energy consumption by 20% by 2020.

name: Unlocking the potential of crowdsourcing for public decision-making with artificial intelligence
desc: Public administrations increasingly use online participation platforms to collect citizen input, but processing thousands of contributions manually limits their impact on decision-making.

name: Use of smart video surveillance by the local police
desc: Since 2019, local police forces in the Belgian cities of Kortrijk, Kuurne and Lendelede have used smart video surveillance systems to support investigations, public safety and policy analysis.

name: VDAB Chatbot for job seekers - Chatbots to better match jobseekers with the right vacancies
authority: Vlaamse Dienst voor Arbeidsbemiddeling en Beroepsopleiding
desc: Jobseekers often need timely, practical support when searching for vacancies, yet traditional guidance channels can struggle to provide immediate and personalised assistance at scale.

name: Verontrustingen - Enabling accurate predictions to detect day-care services inspection
desc: The Flemish Agency for Child and Family (Kind en Gezin), now part of the Opgroeien agency, faced constraints in conducting comprehensive inspections of childcare facilities due to limited inspection capacity and increasing demand for oversight.

name: Walloon - Agricultural subsidy monitoring with the use of GeoAI
desc: Monitoring whether agricultural subsidy conditions are met is traditionally a labour-intensive process, often based on limited field inspections that cover only a small proportion of parcels and crops.

name: iBorderCtrl: Virtual Policeman
desc: iBorderCtrl (Intelligent Portable Control System) is an innovative project that aims to enable faster and thorough border control for third country nationals crossing the land borders of EU Member States (MS), with technologies that adopt the future development of the Schengen Border Management.

name: SAFELY - Road Safety Analytics System
desc: Municipalities often rely on recorded accidents alone to understand road-safety problems, yet this reactive approach can miss hidden risks and delay intervention until serious incidents have already occurred.

name: BRAIN++ New AI-optimised Supercomputer
desc: Bulgaria is establishing its own AI factory, a €90 million project led by INSAIT in collaboration with Sofia Tech Park. The initiative, called BRAIN++, will create a modern GPU-based AI data centre in Sofia, supporting large-scale AI research and applications.

name: BgGPT - A bulgarian LLM
authority: INSAIT – Institute for Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Technology
desc: Many widely used language technologies provide limited support for smaller European languages, constraining digital inclusion and technological sovereignty. In Bulgaria, public institutions, businesses and citizens lack high-quality language models tailored to national linguistic and cultural contexts.

name: BgGPT – a cutting-edge Bulgarian artificial intelligence integrates in Municipality of Burgas' services
desc: Burgas Municipality is the first in the country to introduce BgGPT – a cutting-edge Bulgarian artificial intelligence that will be used to serve citizens and businesses in the coastal city. This was announced during a meeting between Mayor Dimitar Nikolov with Prof.

name: Bronia.AI - acoustic technology
desc: Established in 2024, Bronia developed intelligent acoustic signal processing technology. With a strong emphasis on innovation, the startup is developing a cutting-edge AI-powered platform to address intricate problems in acoustic technology, such as sound optimisation, noise reduction, and advanced signal processing.

name: Data-driven water infrastructure maintenance in Burgas
desc: Ageing water infrastructure causes significant water losses, threatening sustainability, service reliability, and public resources. In some regions, leakage rates reach critical levels, requiring proactive detection and maintenance strategies.

name: Discoverer+ Supercomputer
desc: Discoverer is Bulgaria’s petascale supercomputer, hosted at Sofia Tech Park as part of the European High-Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) infrastructure. Originally launched in October 2021, Discoverer delivers powerful high-performance computing with sustained performance of around 4.5 petaflops.

name: Enhancing healthcare policy evaluation through AI-driven analytics platform for the National Public Administration
authority: National Council on Prices and Reimbursement of Medicinal Products
desc: The Enhancing Healthcare Policy Evaluation through the AI-Driven Analytics Platform for the National Public Administration project, initiated by Bulgaria's National Council on Prices and Reimbursement of Medicinal Products (NCPR), aims to transform healthcare decision-making.

name: INNOAIR - Green public transport on-demand in the Municipality of Sofia
desc: Sofia faces persistent air pollution and traffic congestion, particularly in rapidly developing neighbourhoods with limited public transport coverage.

name: Plovdic - City Concierge Chatbot
desc: City Concierge is an AI-powered city chatbot like a virtual Tourist Office in the mobile. It is there for the visitors 24/7 in Messenger and provides information about the city Point of Interests pf the city.

name: ROSE - Route optimisation module for waste logistic platforms - Montana (BG) pilot
desc: Municipal waste collection often runs on fixed schedules that do not reflect actual container fill levels, leading to unnecessary journeys, higher operating costs, avoidable fuel use, and excess emissions.

name: AI application developed for Dubrovnik visitors predicting the number of visitors in the Old Town
desc: The City of Dubrovnik, the DURA development agency and the Enum Software startup, within the measures projected by the ‘Respect the City’ project, have developed and launched an application which predicts the number of visitors to the Old Town of Dubrovnik, reports Dubrovački Vjesnik on October 10, 2018.

name: AI for anonymisation of court decisions in Croatia
desc: The "AI for anonymisation" project uses AI-powered tools to automatically anonymise court decisions so that judicial decisions can be published online while protecting personal data.

name: AI use in the City of Kastav
desc: Municipal administrations often manage competitive funding and co-financing processes that involve large volumes of documentation, manual evaluation and tight deadlines, placing strain on staff and reducing transparency.

name: Andrija - Virtual assistant supporting advising suspected COVID-19 infections
desc: During the COVID-19 pandemic, public health authorities faced high volumes of citizen enquiries regarding symptoms, testing and protective measures. In Croatia, the digital assistant Andrija was developed to provide consistent, evidence-based guidance and reduce pressure on health services.

name: Creating an AI-driven mobile virtual assistant and common public services platform
desc: The Croatian pilot in the inGOV project focuses on the City of Bjelovar and demonstrates how digital public services can be made more accessible through an AI-driven mobile virtual assistant.

name: Hope - Chatbot informing work of the Civil Protection Staff
desc: Local authorities require effective communication channels to inform citizens during emergencies, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic. In Vinkovci, the Civil Protection Staff sought a digital solution to address frequently asked questions and reduce administrative workload.

name: Smart Public Lighting in City of Sveta Nedelja (Croatia)
desc: The research and development pilot project for smart public lighting is a solution that can work on all types of network technologies, including 3G, 4G, 5G, NB IoT and is applicable to all types of public lighting.

name: Smart parking in Dubrovnik with IoT
desc: In the City of Dubrovnik, which receives a high number of visitors each year, it is extremely difficult to find a parking space, especially in the old town. As a result of this, Dubrovnik launched a cutting-edge Smart Parking initiative in 2018, which uses IoT technology to connect different devices and/or sensors.

name: Tackling Air Pollution in the City of Zagreb
authority: Teaching Institute of Public Health “Dr. Andrija Štampar”
desc: Air quality management in large urban areas requires accurate, granular and timely information to protect public health and guide environmental policy. In Zagreb, authorities and health institutions faced limitations in understanding pollution dynamics across the city.

name: Transforming Croatian Schools with Indoor Air Quality Monitoring
desc: Learning environments are directly influenced by indoor air quality, yet many schools lack the tools to monitor and manage classroom conditions effectively. In Croatia, education authorities and school administrators sought to improve student wellbeing and learning outcomes through better environmental control.

name: AI-OBSERVER - Enhancing Earth Observation capabilities of the Eratosthenes Centre of Excellence on Disaster Risk Reduction through Artificial Intelligence
desc: Effective disaster risk reduction relies on timely and accurate Earth observation data, yet integrating large-scale satellite and environmental datasets into operational decision-making remains complex.

name: FLOBOT - Floor Washing Robot for Professional Users
desc: FLOBOT develops and validates a professional, robotic scrubber-dryer (floor washer with brushes and suction to dry the floor) for large areas Supermarkets, as well as other industrial, commercial and public use premises, such as airports, trade fairs and hospitals, have huge floor surfaces that must be cleaned daily…

name: GENAI4ED - A Platform for Assessing and Bridging Generative AI and Human Skills in Secondary Education
desc: Secondary schools face growing pressure to adopt digital tools that enhance learning while supporting teachers rather than increasing their workload. Educators and policymakers require evidence-based guidance to select appropriate educational technologies.

name: Generative-AI based chatbot for the Cypriot Government Portal
desc: Citizens interacting with public administration often face fragmented information and limited service availability outside office hours. The Cypriot Government sought to improve digital access to public information through its central portal, gov.cy.

name: Microsoft Copilot in Cyprus' Public Administration
authority: Ministry of Research, Innovation and Digital Policy
desc: The Government of Cyprus has begun introducing Microsoft 365 Copilot across the public administration as part of its wider digital modernisation efforts. In the initial phase, 350 civil servants will receive licences and dedicated training to ensure the tool is used safely and effectively.

name: Policies for Holistic Urban Mobility and Accessibility
desc: Urban congestion and accessibility barriers disproportionately affect people with disabilities, requiring targeted policy interventions informed by reliable data. The Municipality of Nicosia, within the AI4PublicPolicy initiative, developed a citizen-centric framework to design evidence-based mobility policies.

name: WaterAnalytics - Water quality monitoring
authority: The Water Development Department, The Water Development Department, Cyprus
desc: The Water Development Department in Cyprus is responsible for monitoring water resources, including quality and distribution efficiency, in a context of increasing environmental pressures and resource scarcity.

name: AI MOVE - AI mobility optimisation and vehicle efficiency for public transport
desc: Many public-transport-priority systems still rely on transponders installed on vehicles communicating with traffic lights, a set-up that typically benefits only municipal operators and excludes other high-occupancy services.

name: AI agent for Prague 6: Simplifying communication between the office and citizens
desc: The Citymind chatbot was implemented by Prague 6 to improve citizen-office communication and streamline access to public services.

name: AI in social service to improve long term stay
desc: Social-care systems face growing pressure to support older and vulnerable people in ways that preserve independence, quality of life, and continuity of care, while also reducing unnecessary institutionalisation.

name: AI pilot in Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) in Czechia
authority: Fire Rescue Service of the Czech Republic
desc: Emergency call centres must gather critical information quickly, even when callers do not speak the local language fluently, yet language barriers can delay understanding at the very moment when speed and precision matter most.

name: AI-Powered Speed Measurement – Municipal Police of Prague
desc: The Municipal Police of Prague operate an automated speed enforcement system to improve road safety and ensure compliance with traffic regulations.

name: AI-driven citizen engagement platform for the City of Prague
desc: Municipal administrations often struggle to manage large volumes of citizen reports submitted through fragmented communication channels, leading to delays, misrouting and reduced public satisfaction.

name: Algorithm based quality control of presidential candidates
desc: To ensure compliance with legal requirements for presidential candidacy, Czech authorities apply statistical verification to nomination signatures submitted by candidates. Candidates may qualify either through parliamentary support or by collecting 50,000 voter signatures.

name: Central Bohemian Region to test on-demand public transport
desc: The Central Bohemian Region launched an innovation partnership to design and implement a system optimising public transport service settings, including testing on-demand transport solutions.

name: City of Prague AI Traffic Management System
desc: Urban congestion at major transport hubs leads to delays, increased emissions and reduced public transport reliability. Prague seeks to improve traffic flow while maintaining priority for tram services. Stakeholders include municipal transport authorities, road users and public transport operators.

name: Computer Vision for monitoring the condition of streets and the city environment
desc: Municipalities require timely information on the condition of streets, waste containers and public infrastructure to maintain cleanliness and service quality. Manual inspections are costly and infrequent.

name: Detection protective equipment
desc: University Hospital Olomouc tested this system during April and May 2021, at a time when hospitals and other indoor environments needed practical ways to monitor compliance with COVID-19 protective measures.

name: Judicial Anonymisation Tool
desc: Courts must publish judicial decisions to ensure transparency and legal certainty, while strictly complying with personal data protection requirements.

name: KarolAIna - petascale EuroHPC supercomputer in Czechia
desc: The Czech AI Factory (CZAI) is the Czech Republic’s national AI factory, selected in October 2025 under the European High‑Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC) AI Factories programme.

name: Smart enforcement: automated detection and handling of prohibited transit in Vojkovice
desc: The municipality of Vojkovice has experienced increased safety risks and infrastructure damage due to heavy trucks using roads where transit is prohibited. Manual enforcement mechanisms proved insufficient, limiting the municipality’s ability to monitor violations and impose penalties effectively.

name: Video-based Intelligent solution for traffic monitoring in the Municipality of České Budějovice
desc: The traffic monitoring pilot in České Budějovice responded to growing congestion and limited visibility over real-time mobility patterns. City authorities sought better tools to manage traffic efficiently while supporting economic activity and public safety.

name: nShield - Predictive Maintenance for escalators downtimes in Prague
desc: Escalator failures in public transport systems cause service disruptions, safety risks, and high maintenance costs. Prague’s public transport operator sought to reduce downtime and improve maintenance efficiency.

name: AI Assisted Process Understanding for Management of N2O Reduction from Wastewater Treatment Plants (AIAP-N2O)
desc: The project aims to reduce emissions of the greenhouse gas nitrous oxide (N₂O) from wastewater treatment plants by using AI‑driven process understanding and control strategies.

name: AI helps the Danish Digital Agency conduct analyses
desc: Since 2021, large Danish companies must address data ethics in their annual reports. The Digital Agency needed to analyze thousands of reports to strengthen national data ethics guidance. The sheer volume—3,673 reports totaling approximately 88,000 pages from 2022-2023—made manual analysis impractical.

name: AI predicts cardian arrest in Copenhagen
desc: Recognising cardiac arrest during emergency calls is a high-stakes operational challenge, because callers may describe symptoms unclearly and dispatchers must make life-critical decisions within seconds.

name: AI solution in ATP writes journal notes of conversations with citizens
desc: ATP, Denmark's labor market fund, receives approximately 2.5 million citizen calls annually, each requiring documentation as journal notes. The automated journaling solution converts call recordings to text, then summarizes conversations using generative AI.

name: AI solution in Roskilde Municipality helps create minutes of consultation responses
desc: Roskilde Municipality uses generative AI to automatically create summaries of consultation responses from residents regarding planning decisions. When citizens submit feedback on municipal projects, employees manually had to summarize each response—a time-consuming and variable process.

name: AI to analyse X-ray images for bone fractures and joint injuries in the healthcare system
desc: Emergency departments face increasing pressure from high patient volumes, particularly during out-of-hours periods, which can delay diagnosis and treatment. In Denmark, healthcare providers seek tools to support clinicians in analysing injury-related X-rays.

name: AI to anonymise judicial courts in Denmark
desc: This project pseudonymises Danish courts' judgments in order to be able to publish them in a move to ensure the transparency of court judgments. In terms of technology, the solution is based on machine learning. Each judgment is pseudonymised and controlled by two human participants.

name: AI to plan meeting dates, times and locations for prosecutors
desc: The project focuses on allocation of meeting dates, times and locations to prosecutors based on their profile.

name: AI-EFFECT, Advancing AI Integration in the European Energy Sector - Multi energy and sector coupling
desc: Energy systems are becoming increasingly complex as electricity, heating, and other energy vectors must be coordinated to reduce emissions while maintaining reliability and affordability.

name: AI-Rehabilitering (AIR) - Intelligent rehabilitation and targeted healthcare services for citizens
desc: In municipal rehabilitation services, one recurring challenge is that citizens who could benefit from physical exercise or preventive support are not always identified or referred at the most appropriate time.

name: AI-based feed optimisation – real-time processing of large amounts of data in pig production
desc: The project aims to develop an advanced AI‑based system that collects and processes large amounts of data from pig production farms in real time, in order to continuously optimise the feeding strategies for growing pigs.

name: AI-enabled Rehabilitation in danish municipalities
authority: Aarhus University, Municipality of Aalborg and DigiRehab
desc: AI-Rehabilitation (AIR) is one of seven municipal signature projects on testing artificial intelligence in the municipal area.

name: AI-enabled platform for reduced hospitalizations among senior residents
desc: The planned platform uses patient notes from municipal caregivers for early disease detection. Køge officials also receive recommendations for localized resource deployment. Senior care employees previously trained in early diagnosis and patient communications skills complemented by the platform.

name: AI-enabled speech-to-text in the health and elderly area
desc: The initiative is to contribute to streamlining documentation tasks in the health and elderly area in selected municipalities.

name: AI-enabled system for assistive technology requests
desc: Sønderborg Municipality receives between 15 and 20 applications daily for body-worn aids such as corsets, diabetes materials, orthopedic footwear etc. This corresponds to approx. 5000 applications annually.

name: AI-for-Søren: AI for work injuries
desc: AI-for-Søren is an AI assistant that answers questions related to work-related and eye injuries.

name: AI-powered platform for hospital rehabilitation recommendations in two danish municipalities
authority: Municipality of Aalborg and Municipality of Rødovre
desc: Aalborg and Rødovre spend 3,000 staff hours per year on planning rehabilitation paths for patients admitted to hospitals. A newly designed platform turns data on 18,000 past patients into insights on how future patients should be treated.

name: Aarhus Municipality creates an AI-enabled analytical tool for sustainable procurement decisions
desc: Aarhus Municipality has taken a significant stride in the realm of sustainable procurement, leveraging the power of artificial intelligence through a collaboration with the local company Konsido.

name: An effective and holistic employment effort through the artificial intelligence technology Process Mining
desc: The use case addresses inefficiencies and fragmentation in public employment services, where multiple stakeholders—including job centres, administrative units, and case workers—operate across disconnected systems, limiting coordinated and citizen-centric support.

name: Artificial Intelligence for better planning of cancer treatments
desc: Cancer services must balance clinical complexity, finite resources and the need to tailor treatment to the individual patient’s likely trajectory.

name: Artificial Intelligence for faster and better diagnosis of emergency patients
desc: In emergency departments, clinicians must decide quickly whether a patient can be safely discharged or needs immediate admission, often while facing incomplete information, time pressure and high patient volumes.

name: Artificial Intelligence in general practice
desc: General practitioners routinely receive large volumes of clinical information, including laboratory results, many of which do not require immediate medical action but still demand time and attention to review.

name: Artificial Intelligence to prevent complications after bowel cancer surgery
desc: Bowel cancer surgery carries substantial risk: around one in four patients develops complications after the operation, and roughly one in three experiences relapse.

name: Artificial intelligence dives into thousands of WWII photographs
desc: Researchers in history, computer science, and the social sciences face significant challenges when analysing large collections of historical photographs, as manual examination is time-consuming and limits the scale of inquiry.

name: Artificial intelligence for predicting exacerbations in multidisease with easy-to-understand explanation of complex results
authority: TeleCare Nord/Region Nordjylland, North Jutland, Aalborg University, TeleCare Nord
desc: The project focuses on improving care for citizens with multiple chronic conditions, where disease progression is complex and difficult to monitor, often leading to unanticipated exacerbations and hospitalisations.

name: Artificial intelligence for the prevention of malnutrition and hospitalization of the elderly
authority: Aarhus University Hospital, Aarhus Municipality,MedTech Innovation Consortium,Regional Hospital Horsens and Skanderborg Municipality
desc: Malnutrition among older citizens is a major risk factor for prolonged hospital stays, readmissions and increased mortality, yet early identification in community settings remains challenging.

name: Artificial intelligence for treatment support for eye patients
desc: Ophthalmology departments faced growing demand to assess patients with age-related macular degeneration (AMD), a leading cause of blindness in Denmark. The pilot aimed to support treatment decisions and optimise specialist time. Stakeholders included patients, clinicians, and hospital administrators.

name: Artificial intelligence to support the visitation of referrals from general practice
authority: Region Zealand, Capital Region of Denmark
desc: The use case addressed inefficiencies and inconsistencies in the handling of patient referrals from general practitioners to hospitals, where large volumes of referrals require manual processing, classification, and routing across multiple stages.

name: Artificial intelligence to support the visitation of rehabilitation courses (AIR Project)
desc: Municipal case workers in Denmark faced increasing pressure to assess citizens’ suitability for rehabilitation programmes consistently and efficiently. The AIR pilot in Aalborg aimed to support decision-making while maintaining professional judgement.

name: Baggage handling at the Copenhagen Airport
desc: Copenhagen Airport introduced data-driven optimisation in 2016 to improve baggage handling efficiency and passenger experience. Managing baggage flows requires precise coordination of staff and conveyor systems to minimise delays and queue times.

name: Better diagnosis of prostate cancer
desc: Prostate cancer is frequently identified at an early stage, when the disease has not yet spread beyond the prostate, yet many patients still undergo surgery that may later prove unnecessary and can cause complications or long-term discomfort.

name: Better diagnostics of pregnant women using artificial intelligence
authority: CAMES Rigshospitalet, DTU Compute, Region Zealand, Southern Denmark and North Jutland
desc: Early identification of complications during pregnancy is essential to initiate preventive measures and improve maternal and neonatal outcomes. However, variability in ultrasound image quality can affect diagnostic accuracy and limit the ability to predict adverse developments.

name: Better match between unemployed citizens and companies
desc: Even where employers are actively seeking staff, matching unemployed citizens to suitable vacancies can remain difficult because the fit between a person’s experience, transferable skills and available roles is not always obvious from standard job titles or sector boundaries.

name: CHAIN - Smart Water optimising energy consumption
desc: The municipality of Aarhus sought to address inefficiencies in water and energy consumption within its water management infrastructure. Traditional systems lacked the capability to dynamically optimise operations based on real-time demand and system conditions.

name: Carbon Intelligent City - Copenhagen
desc: Achieving climate neutrality requires cities to move beyond aggregated emissions inventories towards dynamic, activity-based monitoring of greenhouse gas emissions.

name: City Shark - Keeping Aarhus harbor clean with a robot
desc: The idea for the City Shark project and its three phases innovates from Aarhus Municipality's ITK (Innovation, Technology and Creativity) department and is implemented in collaboration with the Agency for Data Supply and Efficiency, the Port of Aarhus and the City of Aarhus as well as several external suppliers.

name: Copilot in the Randers Municipality
desc: All employees in Randers Municipality have been given access to use Copilot in Edge, Microsoft’s generative AI assistant integrated into the Edge browser to support everyday work tasks. Copilot helps with generating and summarizing text, drafting communications, and assisting with routine productivity tasks.

name: Correct and uniform case management when sanctioning unemployed citizens
desc: Deciding whether an unemployed citizen should be subject to an economic sanction is a difficult and sensitive task, as case workers must consider not only the triggering event, such as absence from an interview or activation offer, but also whether a sanction is likely to have the intended effect on the person’s…

name: Corti's AI - Emergency medical services real-time speech analysis for cardiac predictions
desc: Emergency call handlers must identify cardiac arrest within seconds, yet callers often describe symptoms unclearly and high-pressure conditions can lead to delayed recognition or missed warning signs.

name: CostAI Kalundborg
desc: The project CostAI Kalundborg aims to gather and unify the various AI‑tools used by a municipality into a single, user‑friendly platform.

name: DBA - Intelligent Control Platform
desc: The research unit was established in 2017 when put first two AI models into production, in direct integration with an (internal) Control Systems so they are continually evaluating new data. Every time there's a change in our data, it's machine interprets certain thresholds put up for decision support.

name: Decision support for handling municipal document access cases
desc: Municipalities face increasing demand for access to public documents, requiring significant administrative effort to review, redact, and process requests in compliance with legal requirements such as data protection regulations. Manual handling of these cases is time-consuming and may lead to inconsistencies.

name: Energy Optimisation of Buildings
desc: Municipal buildings represent a major share of urban energy consumption, yet optimising energy use while maintaining indoor comfort is operationally complex. Copenhagen Solutions Lab and Copenhagen City Properties initiated this pilot to reduce energy consumption, emissions and costs across municipal buildings.

name: Energy-efficient de-icing with camera detection and artificial intelligence
authority: Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Utilities
desc: “Energy‑efficient de‑icing with camera detection and artificial intelligence” is a Danish energy innovation project funded under the Energiteknologisk Udviklings‑ og Demonstrationsprogram (EUDP). It started in 2024 and is expected to run until 2026 in Høje‑Taastrup, Denmark.

name: Erhvervsstyrelsen - Detection of errors in business statements
desc: Supervising corporate filings and financial statements at scale is difficult for regulators because manual review cannot easily keep pace with the volume of submissions, while material errors and potentially fraudulent reporting may remain hidden among routine cases.

name: Exam control in schools: fighting fraud or profiling students?
desc: Danish students have protested against the use of digital tools to detect exam fraud, arguing that they are invasive and violate their privacy. Additionally, there are concerns about the accuracy and fairness of these systems, and the potential for them to be used to discriminate against certain groups of students.

name: Fasit Dialogstøtte – AI Assistant for Conversation Notes
desc: An AI assistant, integrated into the Fasit case management system, supports caseworkers by automatically transcribing and summarising conversations with citizens, producing draft minutes and journal notes.

name: Faster case processing when granting cleaning services using new technology
desc: Assessing whether a citizen should receive municipal cleaning assistance can vary considerably in complexity, as case workers must evaluate individual need on the basis of health, living conditions and household circumstances.

name: Gismap AI model for land cover analysis
desc: The Gismap solution, implemented by the Ballerup Municipality in 2025, enables the generation of land cover data using an AI model, editing tools, and integration with various environmental datasets.

name: GladGPT for municipality employees in Gladsaxe
desc: In 2023, the municipality of Gladsaxe launched GladGPT, an internal chatbot based on the technology of OpenAI ChatGPT 4, operated in a closed environment.

name: Gladsaxe Model - profiling families for early detection of vulnerable children
desc: Municipal child welfare authorities aim to identify children at risk of neglect or social vulnerability at an early stage to enable preventive intervention.

name: HOLONI – AI for Urban Solar Potential Assessment
desc: Unlocking the full potential of urban solar energy requires accurate assessment of production capacity and surplus at city scale, yet municipalities often lack tools to analyse this potential dynamically.

name: HabitAi - intelligent data to support sustainable decisions for homeowners
authority: Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Utilities
desc: HabitAi (“Intelligent data to support sustainable decisions for homeowners”) is a Danish environmental technology project funded in 2023 under the Miljøteknologisk Udviklings‑ og Demonstrationsprogram (MUDP) as a preliminary project.

name: IRE - Intelligent Robotic Endoscopes for Improved Healthcare Services
desc: Colonoscopy is essential for early detection of colorectal cancer, yet procedural variability and navigation complexity can affect diagnostic success and patient safety. The IRE project seeks to develop intelligent robotic endoscopes that enhance precision, autonomy and clinical outcomes.

name: Implementation of AI in the knowledge database in Topdesk
desc: Ebbot is an AI chatbot, implemented by Randers Municipality, and integrated into TOPdesk, the municipality’s ITSM system. It is available to municipal employees and can answer questions related to IT, accounting, and procurement.

name: InDialog Voicebot – Internal AI Support for ESDH and Topdesk
desc: InDialog Voicebot allows employees to quickly obtain answers and access guidance via voice commands, streamlining internal processes and freeing up time for more complex tasks. The solution is currently in the testing phase and is used internally to support guidance within the municipality’s ESDH system and Topdesk.

name: Increased continuity in elderly care using artificial intelligence
authority: Aalborg Municipality, Syddjurs Municipality, Aalborg University
desc: Elderly citizens often experience fragmented home care services involving multiple caregivers, which can reduce perceived safety and continuity of care. The project aimed to enhance transparency and improve the citizen experience by increasing continuity in the staff assigned to each individual.

name: Intelligent sorting and filing of mail to provide citizens with faster case processing
desc: Norddjurs Municipality receives substantial volumes of digital mail and emails every day through a central inbox, and each message must be sorted, routed to the correct case worker and filed appropriately before any substantive action can begin.

name: Inter-municipal Chatbot MUNI - Aarhus
desc: Citizens often find municipal websites and self-service systems difficult to navigate, particularly when they are unsure which service they need or how to complete a process such as obtaining a passport, using MitID, or arranging childcare.

name: KAILA - AI tool for Danish legislation
