desc: KAILA is an AI tool used to assist legal staff in handling complex legal tasks more efficiently. It can help with drafting legal documents, gathering relevant sources and arguments, providing new insights, and preparing for meetings.

name: Kiri - chatbot for citizens' enquiries
desc: Municipal websites receive large numbers of routine citizen questions, yet residents increasingly expect immediate answers without having to wait for office hours or contact staff directly for simple matters.

name: LeXFiles and LegalLAMA: Facilitating English Multinational Legal Language Model Development
desc: Legal analysis depends heavily on precise language, domain-specific terminology, and the ability to interpret concepts consistently across jurisdictions and document types.

name: MasterMind - Southern Denmark
desc: The objective of the MasterMind project was “to make high quality treatment for depression more widely available for adults suffering from the illness by the use of ICT” (http://mastermind-project.eu). Collaboration by 23 partners framed in a European H2020 project was created in order to accomplish this objective.

name: NOMAD - the travel-app to travel anywhere in the Nordics
desc: The Nordic Open Mobility and Digitalisation initiative aims to enable seamless cross-border travel across Nordic countries by promoting interoperable Mobility as a Service solutions. Travellers often encounter fragmented booking systems and limited integration between national transport providers.

name: OS2ai - Open-source AI solution in Danish municipalities
desc: Randers Municipality participates in OS2ai, an open-source AI solution developed collaboratively by Aarhus Municipality and several other Danish municipalities. The solution makes it easy to integrate artificial intelligence into municipal workflows and automate tasks across different areas of responsibility.

name: Optimised building use with artificial intelligence
authority: GovTech Midtjylland, Favrskov, Syddjurs and Aarhus Municipality
desc: Many municipal primary schools are ageing buildings with high energy consumption and low space utilisation outside teaching hours, creating inefficiencies and avoidable CO₂ emissions. The project aimed to optimise room allocation and building use to reduce energy demand while maintaining service quality.

name: Pluto – Road Analysis and Maintenance
desc: Pluto Technologies has developed an AI-based solution that identifies issues with the municipality’s roads using smartphones and GPS, for example, devices installed on municipal refuse trucks.

name: Prediction of heart failure from exacerbations in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) patients
desc: This use case focuses on reducing avoidable deterioration and hospital admissions among patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and heart failure by identifying warning signs early enough for preventive treatment to begin.

name: Profiling system for the unemployed
desc: Austria introduced a nationwide profiling tool to support employment services in allocating assistance to newly unemployed individuals claiming benefits. The operational challenge was to identify those at higher risk of long-term unemployment and tailor activation measures accordingly.

name: RandersGPT
desc: RandersGPT is an internal GPT for municipal employees, based on OpenAI in Azure. Its purpose is to provide employees with a more secure alternative to Copilot in Edge and ChatGPT.

name: Real-time predictions and essential information for clinicians
desc: Hospitals need timely and accurate information on ward occupancy, discharges and likely patient returns in order to plan staffing, organise patient pathways and make the best possible use of available beds.

name: Reduction of radiation dose in relation to scans used in cancer treatment
desc: PET imaging is an important tool in cancer diagnosis and treatment planning, but it requires the injection of a radioactive tracer, and higher tracer doses generally produce clearer images.

name: Roboref - Generative AI in the Randers Municipality
desc: Roboref is an AI tool that automatically records, transcribes, and generates summaries and notes from meetings using generative AI. It is used for both internal and external meetings in the public sector, freeing up time for other work while enhancing the objectivity of documentation.

name: Robotic technologies for the construction industry
authority: Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Utilities
desc: "Robotic removal of masonry joints for lifetime extension and deconstruction" is a Danish environmental technology project funded in 2023 under the Miljøteknologisk Udviklings‑ og Demonstrationsprogram (MUDP).

name: Route and shift planning with AI in the health and elderly area
desc: The initiative is to improve the planning of shifts and routes in home care and home nursing in the municipalities. The task of planning shifts and routes in the health and elderly area in the municipalities is a large administrative, complex and time-consuming task.

name: SPIKE – Energy Pilot Project in Copenhagen
desc: Buildings account for a significant share of urban energy consumption, yet many existing facilities lack the flexibility to optimise energy use without costly renovations.

name: Shorter response time to construction applications and help submitting correct documents
desc: Municipal construction applications often take a long time to process, not only because of the complexity of planning and compliance checks, but also because many submissions are incomplete or incorrectly prepared from the outset.

name: Smartmail - intelligent handling of mails
desc: Municipal administrations handle large volumes of physical and digital correspondence, and inefficient mail distribution and journaling processes can lead to delays, lack of transparency, and increased administrative costs.

name: Streamlining Environmental Permitting Processes with Multi-Agent AI in Denmark
desc: Environmental permitting processes are often complex, slow, and resource-intensive, creating uncertainty for project developers while placing pressure on regulators. Denmark’s Environmental Protection Agency modernised this process to improve efficiency and transparency.

name: Supportbot for Vejle Municipality
desc: Supportbot for Vejle Municipality is an AI-powered voice assistant implemented by CleverCall to help the roughly 8,500 employees of Vejle Municipality with IT issues 24/7.

name: Syddjurs, DK and neighboring cities map employment service processes with AI-powered platform
desc: Syddjurs and four partner cities used artificial intelligence for a process mining initiative. Municipal data on unemployment benefits, city services, and department contacts resulted in maps of user experiences.

name: System to control social welfare recipients
authority: Agency for the digitalisation (Ministry of Finance)
desc: Welfare administrations responsible for pensions, housing, family, disability, and maternity-related benefits face a difficult balance between protecting public funds and respecting the rights of citizens, especially when fraud controls operate across very large populations.

name: Targeted employment programmes for unemployed citizens
desc: Employment services often need to decide which programme or activity is most likely to help a job-ready unemployed citizen return to work quickly, yet this is difficult to do consistently without clear evidence on what interventions deliver the strongest results for different profiles.

name: Taxation and the automatization of property evaluation
desc: The Danish government has been trying to centralize and automate tax administration for years. One of the key initiatives is automating property value assessments. The Ejendomsvurderingslov (law on property assessment, 2017) mandates the use of an automated system for property valuation.

name: The 'Wet Index’ project - an AI tool to predict local floods
desc: The tool was developed to tackle the increasing risk of flooding due to extreme weather events, which poses challenges for municipalities, landowners, and urban planners in anticipating and mitigating damage. Existing forecasting tools lack sufficient localisation and lead time for effective decision-making.

name: The LOVOT social AI robot in nursing homes to help people with dementia
desc: LOVOT is a social robot with artificial intelligence that responds to touch, speech, and eye contact. The pilot project was designed to investigate whether social robots can help increase the quality of life for people with dementia.

name: WARD-HOME – Safe discharge from hospital
authority: Capital Region of Denmark (Bispebjerg Hospital and Rigshospitalet) DTU and Region Zealand
desc: WARD-HOME focuses on enabling safe early discharge of patients by addressing the risk of undetected deterioration once patients return home. Healthcare providers require continuous monitoring solutions to ensure patient safety while reducing hospital stays and associated costs.

name: "Donate a Speech": Estonia crowdsources speech data for the preservation of the Estonian language
authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications (MKM)
desc: Estonia identified the limited availability of high-quality speech datasets as a barrier to the development of advanced language technologies in a small-language context.

name: A unique artificial intelligence system now directs Ülemiste City drivers to available parking spots
desc: A new system available to drivers in Ülemiste can guide them precisely to an available parking spot. The system combines signposts, LED displays, web interface and the most advanced AI video camera image analysis tool. It is one of the largest AI powered parking systems in Europe and the whole world.

name: AI Anonymisator for Estonian public sector
desc: Estonian public authorities process large volumes of personal data in appeals, case files and administrative documents, creating risks related to privacy protection and GDPR compliance.

name: AI Robort Judge for small claims in Estonia
desc: The project want to implement a “robot judge” that could adjudicate small claims disputes of less than €7,000 (about $8,000). Officials hope the system can clear a backlog of cases for judges and court clerks. The project is in its early phases and a pilot started in 2019 focusing on contract disputes.

name: AI System for Autonomous Shuttle in the City of Tartu
desc: The autonomous shuttle pilot in Tartu addressed the challenge of making emerging automated transport systems safer, more informative, and better integrated into urban mobility networks.

name: AI to accelerate the legislative power of the Parliament of Estonia
desc: Estonia's parliament, the Riigikogu, partnered with Nortal to enhance legislative efficiency by implementing an AI-driven intelligent search solution.

name: AVENUE – Mobility Pilot Project in Tallinn
desc: Urban authorities increasingly need to align shared mobility policies with ambitious greenhouse gas reduction targets, yet lack tools to quantify the climate impact of different regulatory strategies.

name: Alarm Center Assistant for Risk Assessment
desc: Estonia’s emergency notification process is highly time-critical and operationally complex: rescue operators must assess threats within roughly a minute while taking into account the information needs and resource rules of at least three different agencies.

name: Analysis of customer calls at the Estonian Social Insurance Board
desc: The Estonian Social Insurance Board needed a better understanding of why customers were contacting its service channels and what recurring issues were driving calls and online chats.

name: Appearance - Identification of objects at the Estonian National Archives
desc: The Estonian National Archives wanted to make its vast photographic holdings more accessible by allowing users to search not only through metadata, but also through visual similarity in faces.

name: Automatic border control - Facial Recognition at border controls
desc: Estonia introduced automated border-control gates to improve the efficiency and security of border crossing at busy entry points such as Tallinn Airport and the Narva road border crossing.

name: Automatic proactive social service
desc: Estonia’s Social Insurance Board introduced an event-based proactive service in 2019 to simplify access to family benefits following the birth of a child. Previously, parents were required to submit applications, creating administrative burden and risk of delayed payments.

name: Automatic real-time subtitles
desc: To enhance accessibility of live broadcasts for people who are hard of hearing, Estonia introduced automatic real-time subtitles generated through speech recognition technology. Traditional subtitling requires manual editing and preparation, limiting its use for live events.

name: Automatic translation in the Land Register search portal and Commercial Register
authority: Center of Registers and Information Systems
desc: Estonia’s Centre of Registers and Information Systems introduced automatic translation in the e-Land Register and related registry environments to address a practical accessibility problem: non-Estonian speakers often found it difficult to understand detailed registry information, even when they needed only to read…

name: Automatic translation of Riigi Teataja Ametlikud Teadaanded
authority: Department of Public Relations of the Ministry of Justice
desc: Estonia’s Official Gazette introduced automated translation to make website content available in English, responding to the need for greater accessibility for foreign businesses and other international stakeholders while preserving Estonian as the only legally binding language.

name: BeReady - AI to enhance Air Raid Warning System
desc: The Estonian Air Force has enhanced its air raid warning system by integrating an AI-powered air threat identification feature into the "Be Ready" mobile application, developed in collaboration with Estonia-based IT companies.

name: Bureaucrat of the Environment Agency
desc: The Estonian Environment Agency implemented a “Bureaucrat” chatbot on its website to streamline citizen enquiries and provide accessible digital interaction with public services. Residents often require guidance on environmental regulations, permits and public information, generating recurring questions.

name: Bureaucrat on eID website
desc: Citizens interacting with public authorities often need to consult multiple institutions, each with its own website and processes, leading to fragmented experiences and repeated enquiries. Estonia addressed this challenge by creating a unified conversational access layer across government websites.

name: Business Viability Index: AI support for business planning and avoiding failures
authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communication
desc: Small and medium-sized enterprises and regional development actors often lack timely, data-driven insights to assess business resilience, market positioning and risk exposure. Fragmented data sources and delayed financial indicators can hinder proactive decision-making, increasing the likelihood of business failure.

name: Bürokratt – a virtual assistant for the Public Administration
authority: Information System Authority of the Republic of Estonia
desc: Estonia’s public sector has sought to simplify how people access government services by reducing the need to navigate multiple agencies, channels and digital systems separately.

name: Calculation of forest resources by remote sensing methods
desc: Estonia’s forest monitoring system relies on annual field measurements from 5,600 plots, which provide the basis for national reporting and forest policy, but translating those point measurements into broader, map-based resource estimates remains a difficult and labour-intensive task.

name: ChatGPT Edu into Estonia's education system
desc: The project plans to introduce ChatGPT Edu – a version of ChatGPT built for educational use – across Estonia’s secondary‑school system.

name: Chatbot Vesta - Estonian National Library
desc: The Estonian National Library receives a large number of daily questions and information requests, many of which concern recurring topics and consume significant staff time despite following recognisable patterns.

name: Checking entitlement of umemployment aid
desc: Estonia’s Unemployment Insurance Fund (EUIF) uses ADM to decide what a person is entitled to, including what amount of unemployment aid or unemployment insurance aid, and for how long. 50% of those decisions are made entirely through AI

name: Checking of data Estonian Unemployment Insurance Fund
desc: Estonia’s Unemployment Insurance Fund (EUIF) increasingly uses different automated solutions in its everyday work. After a citizen registers on the Unemployment Insurance Fund website as unemployed, the data is checked and, if it is correct, the citizen is then registered as unemployed.

name: Crop detection from Sentinel-1 and -2 time series using deep learning methods
desc: Estonia needed a more objective and scalable way to identify agricultural crops for official monitoring and statistics, as traditional methods can be labour-intensive and difficult to apply uniformly across the country.

name: Customer call analysis -  Finding patterns in the reasons for customer inquiries
desc: The Social Insurance Board needed a clearer understanding of why citizens were contacting its services and where recurring pain points in service delivery were causing confusion, delays or repeated enquiries.

name: Datel - Speed cameras for detecting speeding violations
desc: Road safety enforcement depends on the rapid and consistent identification of speeding offences, yet manual processing of camera evidence can be slow, resource-intensive, and difficult to scale across large traffic networks.

name: Detection of mowing events on grasslands from Sentinel-data
authority: Estonian Agricultural Registers and Information Board (ARIB)
desc: Nowadays, a vast amount of available data from the Sentinel mission significantly boosted research in agriculture. Estonia is among the first countries to take advantage of this data source to automate mowing and ploughing events detection across the country.

name: EE Parliament- A system for preparing of verbatim reports
desc: Parliamentary administrations are often required to publish accurate verbatim records very quickly after sittings conclude, yet doing so manually places significant pressure on stenographers and can limit both speed and consistency.

name: ESTNLTK - Open source tools for Estonian natural language processing
desc: Estonia’s digital ecosystem depends on high-quality language tools to support public services, research and software development in Estonian, yet language-technology resources for smaller languages often remain fragmented or incomplete.

name: Effective tax collection - Identifying companies or person in need for inspection
desc: Estonia’s Tax and Customs Board has explored how advanced analytical methods could improve tax collection by helping inspectors identify companies more likely to be engaged in undeclared wage payments, often referred to as envelope salaries.

name: Enhanced Care Management - Prediction model for hospitalisation/assistance
desc: The Estonian Health Insurance Fund, in collaboration with the World Bank, initiated a programme to improve the management of patients with chronic conditions by strengthening preventive care and reducing avoidable hospitalisations.

name: Estonia to give citizens Alexa-like access to public services
desc: Because the Estonian government makes all its services available online, the system will be able to access all the information it needs about a citizen to process things such as applications for a new passport.

name: Forecasting models Road Administration (Roads conditions and return of investments)
desc: The Estonian Road Administration is developing forecasting models to address a key infrastructure-management problem: how to decide where road investments will have the greatest effect in terms of network condition and value for money.

name: GAP: preparation of Estonian language tests easy and the assessment automatic.
desc: The Estonian Institute developed GAP to simplify preparation and evaluation of Estonian language tests. Teachers previously needed to manually design gap-fill exercises and assess responses, which was time-consuming and inconsistent.

name: HIF EE: Information-based decision support
desc: Healthcare professionals frequently encounter complex cases where symptoms do not clearly indicate a single diagnosis, requiring consultation of multiple information sources during limited consultation times. Fragmented access to guidelines and drug databases can delay decision-making.

name: ITI - Chatbot for Statistics Estonia
desc: The virtual assistant called ITI, created in collaboration with the Estonian start-up AlphaBlues (now AlfaChat, part of a larger company), shared knowledge regarding the population of Estonia, the size of the pay gap, average wages and consumer price changes, and many other things.

name: Identification of flammable dwellings
desc: A project under development in Estonia about an AI solution for detection of flammable residential buildings Estonia

name: Identification of forest tree species, forest clearing and forest height
desc: Together with the development partner, the Environmental Agency and KEMIT have created a remote forest monitoring information system that enables the keeping of records of forest resources in georeferenced form and the collection and sharing of operational forest information.

name: KRATID - detecting traffic anomalies and incidents of the Estonian data exchange layer (X-Road)
desc: The Information System Authority of Estonia is using machine learning for detecting anomalies and incidents on the traffic of the Estonian data exchange layer - X-Road. Predictive analytics is used to decide where to send the police for traffic regulation.

name: Kama - Multilingual multidisciplinary neuroma machine translation
authority: Ministry of Education and Research, University of Tartu, Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications
desc: In multilingual public and professional environments, the need to translate accurately across a range of languages and subject areas is essential for communication, cooperation and access to information.

name: Kratt Folly - Recognition of museum objects
desc: The National Heritage Board sought to improve how digital objects are described within cultural collections, since manual description is time-consuming, can vary in quality and limits how quickly collections can be made accessible to the public.

name: Kratt Sälli - Organising museum inventory
desc: The National Heritage Board is developing a new prototype of Sälli, an artificial intelligence robot for preservation and inventory, which aims to make museum inventories more convenient and faster.

name: Kratt for Estonian Internal Security Service - Combining video and GIS to identify people
desc: Internal security agencies need tools that help them interpret large volumes of surveillance information quickly and accurately, particularly in situations where location, movement and visual identification must be assessed together.

name: Kratt for analysing customer conversations - Finding the root causes of customer inquiries
desc: The Estonian Unemployment Insurance Fund needed a better understanding of why customers were contacting its service channels, particularly because recurring enquiry patterns were placing pressure on call volumes and indicated friction in digital services and grant-related communication.

name: LifeSaver - enhancing medical services
desc: The LifeSaver project, led by the Estonian Health Board, aims to enhance emergency medical services by improving resource allocation, optimizing service areas, and using AI-driven predictive analytics to forecast system demands.

name: MPAT – Mobility Policy Auto Tuner Pilot in Tallinn
desc: Cities aiming to decarbonise transport must identify where shared micro-mobility can most effectively replace car trips, yet traditional planning tools offer limited insight into spatial and temporal dynamics.

name: Machine translation customer support communication window on the website of Tartu University Hospital
desc: Healthcare providers increasingly serve diverse populations with varying language needs, making effective communication essential for safety and patient satisfaction. Tartu University Hospital sought to improve accessibility of its online customer support for non-Estonian speakers.

name: Machine vision AI solution for better traffic management in Tallinn
authority: Public Transport and Traffic Management Department
desc: To improve evidence-based transport planning, the City of Tallinn launched a pilot project in 2018 to monitor traffic flows using automated video analysis at selected intersections.

name: Mapping of flooded areas from satellite images
desc: Authorities responsible for flood response and environmental monitoring need a dependable way to identify inundated areas quickly, yet flood mapping can be difficult because water detection varies depending on weather, vegetation cover and sensor type.

name: Marakratt - Personal learning path infrastructure
desc: Education systems increasingly need to support learners whose interests, prior knowledge and abilities differ widely, yet standardised content delivery can make it difficult to provide genuinely individual learning pathways.

name: Neurokõne - provide more accessible e-services
desc: Estonian-language e-services remained inaccessible to visually impaired citizens and others who rely on screen readers, as existing text-to-speech solutions for Estonian lacked natural-sounding voices and adequate quality for extended use.

name: New cross-government, AI-powered data management asset
desc: The Estonian government is preparing to launch a new cross‑government, AI‑enabled data‑management platform designed to make public‑sector data from different ministries and agencies searchable and accessible to citizens through a single unified interface.

name: OTT - Predicting employment pathways
desc: Employment services must decide how best to support jobseekers with very different skills, histories, and barriers to work, yet this can be difficult to do consistently when advisers are handling large caseloads and labour market conditions are changing.

name: PPA Information Phone call transcription for customers analysis different languages
desc: The Police and Border Guard Board needed a better understanding of why customers were contacting its information lines and how service bottlenecks were affecting the uptake of digital channels.

name: Politsei.ee large-language model LLM trained on data
authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications
desc: Citizens often struggle to find accurate and relevant information on public authority websites, particularly when content is complex or legalistic.

name: Prediction model for the healthcare needs of patients with chronic illnesses
desc: The EHIF has been cooperating with the World Bank since 2014. The pilot was created by the World Bank with the involvement of the Estonian Health Insurance Fund.

name: Prototype of the entrepreneur's early warning service
authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications
desc: Small and medium-sized enterprises often encounter financial distress too late to take corrective action, leading to insolvency risks with wider economic consequences. Estonia developed a prototype early warning service to help entrepreneurs identify potential liquidity and solvency issues at an early stage.

name: RaRa Bureaucrat
desc: The National Library of Estonia implemented a Bureaucrat chatbot on its website to improve access to library services and information. Users frequently require assistance with catalogue searches, opening hours, digital collections and service procedures.

name: Remote snow monitoring
desc: Estonian meteorological services introduced machine vision techniques to automate measurement of snow cover at weather stations. Manual snow depth measurement is labour-intensive and may limit data frequency and coverage.

name: SATIKAS -  Detecting the agricultural grasslands changes
authority: Estonian Agricultural Registers and Information Board (ARIB)
desc: Agricultural agencies need reliable ways to verify whether grasslands have been mown, since this affects compliance with land-management and subsidy rules, yet traditional inspections are costly, selective, and difficult to scale across an entire country.

name: SUVE - Chatbot for questions about emergency situations
desc: During public emergencies, citizens need quick access to trustworthy and consistent information, yet official websites and helplines can struggle to keep pace with rapidly changing demand and the spread of misinformation.

name: SUVE - Chatbot for questions about the emergency situation and the coronavirus
desc: The websites of several government agencies implemented Suve, an automated chatbot which provided answers to frequently asked questions about general services. The chatbot provided answers to questions in Estonian and English and uses information from the official sources of government agencies.

name: Salme - Speech recognition in courts
authority: Courts of Estonia and Registers and Information Systems Center
desc: Estonia’s courts needed a faster and more efficient way to produce hearing transcripts, since manual transcription of court sessions is slow, labour-intensive and places a heavy burden on clerks.

name: SensusQ: transforming information into knowledge with the help of automation, integration, and interoperability
desc: Military intelligence operations struggle with data overload from multiple sources including UAVs, cyber events, open-source intelligence, and human reports, requiring rapid integration and analysis to support tactical decision-making.

name: Statistical characterization of the sea ice extent in the Gulf of Riga (Baltic Sea) using optical remote-sensing imagery
desc: Monitoring sea-ice conditions in the Gulf of Riga is important for understanding winter dynamics, environmental conditions and maritime risks, yet consistent large-scale observation is difficult to achieve through field methods alone.

name: System called ARNO for submitting and processing application in Estonia
desc: The City of Tartu uses the ARNO system to manage applications and placements for municipal nursery schools, kindergartens and general education schools in a centralised and transparent manner.

name: Text-to-speech synthesis in Estonian
desc: Estonian-language digital services need speech technologies that sound natural and handle linguistic details accurately, yet earlier synthesis methods often produced output that was less convincing in rhythm, intonation and pronunciation.

name: Texta Toolkit - Identifying documents published without authorisation
desc: Public institutions manage very large document collections, and identifying files that have been published without authorisation, or that still contain personal or restricted information, is difficult to do manually at scale.

name: The Youth Guarantee Support System (YGSS) to identifying young people not in education or employment
desc: Since 2018, municipal governments in Estonia have been able to use a tool called The Youth Guarantee Support System (YGSS) (Mis on noortegarantii tugisüsteem? – Tööelu.ee o. J.).

name: Traffic load - Machine vision for collecting information on traffic load
authority: Public Transport and Traffic Management Transport Board in Tallinn
desc: Urban transport planning requires accurate information on how vehicles move through the city, yet municipalities often lack detailed, continuous data on traffic flows across key entry and exit points.

name: Transcription Kratt 112 - Transcribing emergency calls dialed to the emergency number 112
desc: Emergency-call centres handle high volumes of urgent voice data, yet spoken calls are difficult to search, analyse or reuse unless they are converted into text. Estonia introduced this use case to support the handling of 112 emergency calls by beginning the systematic transcription of those conversations.

name: Transcription Kratt 1247 - Transcribing calls to to crisis number 1247
desc: Estonia’s crisis-information services needed a better way to learn from the large volume of calls handled through the 1247 number, especially where spoken interactions contained operational insight that was difficult to analyse systematically in audio form alone.

name: UrbanistAI, a generative AI platform for participatory planning and co-design: Narva use case
desc: The City of Narva aimed to make urban spaces more attractive and liveable for young people by actively involving students in shaping the city’s future development. Conventional planning processes often struggle to engage younger demographics effectively.

name: Water level monitoring in coastal seas and lakes using satellite altimetry
desc: Hydrological monitoring traditionally depends on in situ measurements of water levels and flows at national stations, but these observations do not always provide the spatial coverage needed for large lakes and coastal seas.

name: e-Residency - Chatbot for customer assistance
desc: As the Estonian e-Residency programme grew internationally, customer support demand increased and response times risked lengthening unless more staff were added.

name: AI-Code - GenAi against disinformation
desc: The rapid proliferation of manipulated and synthetic media has increased the difficulty for journalists to verify content and maintain public trust in news reporting.

name: AI-Code - GenAi against disinformation: Use case 2
desc: Media organisations increasingly experiment with generative tools, yet concerns remain about quality, bias and the risk of amplifying disinformation. AI-CODE Use Case 3 addresses this challenge by supporting responsible use of generative technologies in journalism.

name: AI-Code - GenAi against disinformation: Use case 3
desc: Online disinformation increasingly relies on short-form videos, posing challenges for media professionals tasked with identifying coordinated influence campaigns. AI-CODE, a Horizon Europe project, addresses this issue through dedicated use cases.

name: AI-Driven Market Surveillance to Safeguard Consumers in the Digital Single Market
desc: Launched in 2022 by the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Justice and Consumers (DG JUST), this project delivers an EU-wide platform that enables systematic surveillance of online marketplaces across all EU and EEA languages.

name: AI-Powered Digital Twin of the Ocean
desc: The European Digital Twin of the Ocean (EU DTO) is an advanced AI‑powered virtual replica of the ocean, designed to simulate and explore potential “what‑if” scenarios affecting marine environments and human activity.

name: AI4CCAM - Trustworthy AI for Connected, Cooperative and Automated Mobility
desc: AI4CCAM (Trustworthy AI for Connected, Cooperative and Automated Mobility) is a European Union‑funded research and innovation project under the Horizon Europe programme, officially launched in 2023 and running until 2026, with a total budget of approximately €5.97 million.

name: AI4Citizens - Supporting ethical and effective AI governance in European cities and regions
desc: Cities and regions face growing pressure to modernise public services through advanced digital technologies, but adoption can be hindered by uncertainty around governance, ethics, risk management and the practical design of enabling policy mechanisms.

name: AI4Gov - Trusted AI for Transparent Public Governance fostering Democratic Values
desc: Public administrations are increasingly interested in using advanced analytical systems to improve policy design and service delivery, yet this raises difficult questions around transparency, bias, discrimination, legality and public trust.

name: AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Disaster Advisor), and Horizon 2020 project
desc: During major incidents, control rooms are confronted with a flood of potentially relevant information arriving from social media, public channels and other data sources, yet it is rarely possible for emergency staff to collect, validate and assess all of it in real time.

name: Algorithmic Transparency Standard
authority: City of Amsterdam, Barcelona, Brussels, Eindhoven, Mannheim, Rotterdam and Sofia
desc: Public administrations increasingly rely on algorithmic systems, creating a growing need for transparency, accountability and public understanding. Cities lacked a shared, practical framework for explaining how such systems are used, for what purpose, and with what safeguards.

name: Alliance for Language Technologies (ALT-EDIC)
desc: Europe’s language-technology landscape is fragmented by market size, linguistic diversity, and unequal access to high-quality data and infrastructure, which makes it difficult to build competitive large language models and related tools across all European languages.

name: Applying AI to increase quality in the patent grant process at the European Patent Office
desc: Patent examination at the European Patent Office involves assessing millions of applications against complex technical and legal criteria, with AI-related inventions presenting particular challenges due to rapidly evolving technology and novel patentability questions.

name: BorderSens - Border detection of illicit drugs and precursors by highly accurate electrosensors
desc: Customs and border authorities require fast, reliable tools to detect illicit drugs, precursors and cutting agents during inspections, often under time pressure and with limited laboratory access. Existing methods can be slow, costly or prone to false positives, creating operational inefficiencies.

name: CLARIFY – Cloud Artificial Intelligence for Pathology
desc: Digital pathology offers major opportunities to improve diagnostic quality and accessibility, yet widespread adoption is limited by the complexity of image interpretation and the need for scalable infrastructure.

name: CdE - Pilot Programme for Series Co-Productions Advertising Visuals
desc: In the audiovisual sector, promotional content for television series and co-productions must be produced for a highly specialised professional audience across a fast-changing media landscape shaped by multiple distribution channels and new digital production methods.

name: Chatbot Publio - EU Publication Office
authority: Publications Office of the European Union
desc: Publio is the virtual assistant of the Publications Office of the European Union, designed to help users navigate extensive digital repositories of EU documents and institutional information.

name: CitiVERSE - LDT CitiVERSE EDIC

desc: The increasing use of drones for commercial and public services requires their safe and equitable integration into controlled airspace alongside traditional aviation.

name: European AI Factories for businesses

name: European Criminal Records Information System – Third Country Nationals (ECRIS-TCN)
desc: Cross-border crime within the European Union creates challenges for judicial authorities who must determine whether a third-country national has previous convictions in other Member States.

name: FABULOS (Future Automated Bus Urban Level Operation Systems)
desc: Many cities are interested in automated last-mile public transport, yet practical deployment depends on more than vehicle technology alone: it also requires integration with existing networks, regulatory clarity, financial viability and public acceptance.

name: GPT@EC: Generative AI Tool to support EC administrative task

name: GPT@JRC: Generative AI Tool to support Science for Policy at JRC
desc: Within a large scientific and policy-support organisation such as the Joint Research Centre, staff need secure ways to explore emerging language technologies without exposing sensitive information or working outside institutional governance.

name: GPT@JRC: Generative AI Tool to support Science for Policy at JRC
desc: GPT @ JRC is a secure platform for staff to access and experiment with Large Language Models (LLMs) inside JRC. The usage is about day-to-day tasks like summarising, translating, drafting briefings, proof reading, classification, sentiment analysis, etc.

name: GenAI chatbot on the EU-FarmBook platform
desc: Farmers, foresters, advisers, researchers, and policymakers often need practical knowledge quickly, but relevant materials are frequently spread across projects, languages, and institutions, making them hard to find and apply.

name: GenerativeAI @ LDS
desc: Europe’s language-technology ecosystem needs much larger volumes of trustworthy language resources if it is to support strong multilingual LLMs and generative-AI applications across official, regional, and minority languages.

name: GenerativeAI @ TEMS
desc: Public-service media organisations need trustworthy, rights-aware ways to engage with generative AI, especially where questions of data use, attribution, verification, and audience trust directly affect their core mission.

name: INCISIVE - Improving cancer diagnosis and prediction with AI and big data
desc: The INCISIVE project was an EU-funded initiative designed to enhance cancer diagnosis, prognosis and patient follow-up through the use of artificial intelligence and large-scale medical data.

name: PILLAR Robots - a project to increase the autonomy of AI-based robots
desc: PILLAR Robots addresses a fundamental operational challenge in robotics: enabling robots to function with greater autonomy across different domains while ensuring that what they learn remains relevant to real deployment contexts.

name: PILOTING - PILOTs for robotic INspection and maintenance Grounded on advanced intelligent platforms and prototype applications
desc: Ageing infrastructure such as bridges, tunnels and oil and gas facilities requires frequent inspection and maintenance, yet these activities are costly, labour-intensive and often expose workers to hazardous environments.

name: PROMPT - Narrative Intelligence for Information Integrity
desc: The project PROMPT (Predictive Research on Misinformation & Propagation Trajectories) is a European‑level initiative aiming to combat online disinformation and manipulative narratives.

name: SOLARIS - Democratic responses to the challenges of deepfakes and infodemics
desc: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are generative AI models capable of reproducing realistic images, videos and voice outputs.

name: TrustLLM - Democratise trustworthy and efficient LLM technology for Europe
desc: The TrustLLM project will develop European large language models (LLMs) on an unprecedented scale, trained on the largest amount of text so far in European AI, covering a range of underrepresented languages, and pushing the limits of European exascale computing.

name: Visa Application Chatbot for the EU countries
desc: The European Commission, in collaboration with Member State authorities and eu-LISA, initiated the VisaChat pilot to address challenges faced by visa applicants in accessing clear and consistent information on Schengen visa procedures.

name: WARIFA - Watching the risk factors to prevent chronic conditions
desc: Preventing chronic diseases requires early identification of risk factors and sustained support for lifestyle change, yet individuals often lack timely, personalised feedback about their health risks.

name: eTranslation: Machine translation for public administrations
desc: eTranslation allows public administrations to get quick, raw machine translations from and into any official EU language. eTranslation is an online machine translation service provided by the European Commission (EC).

name: iMaging Project - Ecosystem Monitoring at EMSO Sites by Video Imagery
desc: Marine ecosystem monitoring relies on continuous observation, yet manual analysis of underwater video footage is time-consuming and limits the ability to detect changes in biodiversity and environmental conditions at scale.

name: iMaging Project - WITOIL Oil spill detection service
desc: As part of the EU-funded iMagine project, the EyeOnWater initiative addresses the challenge of ensuring the quality and reliability of citizen-contributed data for environmental monitoring.

name: AI Mobility Challenge - DataTalks
desc: DataTalks is an AI-driven service designed to make city information intuitive and useful for residents and visitors alike.

name: AI Mobility Challenge - Dynamik Allocator
desc: Developed by Paavo Kytölä and Anita Kuitunen, Dynamik Allocator focuses on optimising the daily routes of mobile workers — such as service technicians or field staff — to minimise redundant driving.

name: AI Mobility Challenge - Traffic Info

name: AI assistant Hankintavälkky - Hilma Procurement Manual Assistant
desc: Hankintavälkky was piloted by Hansel to address the difficulty faced by procurement professionals and suppliers in navigating complex public procurement guidance. The context involved increasing regulatory complexity and high information demands on a limited expert workforce.

name: AI assisted chat service - Chatbot for tax purposes
desc: OmaVero is an AI assisted chat service provided by Finnish Tax Administration that offers: - Service for individual tax payers: virtual agent advises in most common tax matters. During office hours human agent can be invited into conversation if necessary.

name: AI-Tour guide in the City of Tampere
desc: As visitor expectations shift towards immediate, personalised and multilingual support, cities face growing pressure to offer tourism services that are both more engaging and more adaptive than static signage or traditional information points.

name: Advanced Technology for National Topographic Map Updating - Increasing spatial data accuracy with AI in Finland
desc: Maintaining accurate and up-to-date national topographic maps is essential for land management, infrastructure planning, environmental monitoring, and public safety. name: Artificial intelligence in operational forest management planning
desc: Managing state-owned forests requires balancing economic use, environmental protection, and social value, while operating across large and diverse territories. Metsähallitus needed more precise data to support operational planning and sustainable timber harvesting.

desc: Legislative drafting requires civil servants to examine large volumes of legal, policy, and background material, making the process time-consuming and cognitively demanding, particularly when consistency, traceability, and language quality must be maintained throughout.

desc: Analysing statements submitted during consultation rounds is a demanding part of legislative preparation, as officials must review substantial volumes of written feedback, identify recurring themes, and produce coherent summaries under time pressure.

desc: Front-line public-service advisers often need to consult large volumes of guidance and partner documentation in order to answer citizen questions accurately, which can slow down interviews and reduce the time available for direct support.

name: Aria - Chatbot answering retired people
desc: Retirees often need straightforward access to information about payments, declared income, and direct debits, yet conventional customer-service channels may be available only during limited hours and can struggle to respond quickly to large volumes of recurring enquiries.

name: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Electricity Transmission Network Planning
desc: France’s electricity transmission operator RTE initiated an innovation partnership to develop advanced analytical tools supporting long-term grid adaptation strategies. The energy transition introduces complexity in forecasting demand, integrating renewables and maintaining grid stability.

name: Assess your entitlement to 906 aids: OpenFisca, a tool to writing rules as code
desc: Social and fiscal rules are often complex, difficult to compare, and hard for both citizens and administrations to apply consistently without digital support.

name: Automated surveillance through audio processing
desc: Automated Surveillance through Audio Processing concerns a planned public safety initiative in Saint-Étienne, a city of approximately 175,000 inhabitants, aiming to strengthen urban security monitoring in a disadvantaged neighbourhood.

name: Automatically detecting irregularities in occupancy soils
authority: Departmental Directorate of Territories and the Sea (DDTM) of L'Hérault
desc: Monitoring land use across a territory is a complex responsibility, particularly when authorities need to identify irregular developments such as illegal construction, unauthorised land occupation or waste dumping over large areas.

name: Automating coastline correction work - Improve coastal mapping
authority: Hydrographic and Oceanographic Service of the Navy
desc: Maintaining an accurate national coastline repository is a demanding task because shorelines change over time and raw observation data often require careful correction before they can be used in official mapping.

name: Better guide environmental police checks
desc: Environmental police services must decide where to direct limited inspection resources across large territories and a wide variety of ecological risks, from habitat degradation to unlawful activities affecting protected areas.

name: Bordeaux partners with Superpedestrian on micro-mobility service featuring AI-enabled scooters
desc: The city approved up to 100 Superpedestrian LINK e-scooters for resident use. The LINK houses a Vehicle Intelligence system that evaluates real-time component status. Riders are slowed to full stops if LINKs operate on sidewalks and outside of geofenced areas.

name: Carbon Intelligent City - Paris
desc: Cities face increasing pressure to accurately measure, understand, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions across all sectors, from buildings and transport to industry and energy production.

name: ClaudIA - Chatbot for the invoicing portal for purchases by public authorities
desc: Chatbot Claudia has been setup by the AIFE (State Financial IT Agency) for users of the information system Chorus of SME's and microbusinesses. This chatbot, is based on IBM's Watson Artificial Intelligence technology.

name: Compar:IA - the chatbot arena
desc: compar:IA is a French government-led digital platform designed to compare conversational AI models and educate citizens about generative AI.

name: Covid-bot - France
desc: On 20 March 2020, the Pasteur Institute, Greater Paris University Hospitals (AP-HP) and the chatbot start-up Clevy, released the so-called Covid-bot, an open source COVID-19 auto-diagnosis chatbot. The Covid-bot allows respondents to assess their risk of COVID-19 contamination by filling a questionnaire.

name: DataJust
desc: The Ministry of Justice processes your personal data, called “DataJust”, with the aim of developing an algorithm to be used to Carrying out retrospective and prospective evaluations of public policies in matters of civil or administrative liability; The development of an indicative framework for compensation for…

name: Datakalab - Covid-19 Mask wearing  detection In some French cities
desc: During the Covid-19 pandemic, the use of surveillance cameras was authorised to monitor whether passengers on public transport respected the requirement to wear masks. However, France’s data protection watchdog CNIL called out the practice, saying it was not governed by any legal framework and was therefore illegal.

name: Datascience
desc: The Ministry of the Interior carries out a wide range of missions, from security and territorial administration to crisis management and public-policy coordination, all of which generate substantial volumes of data.

name: Develop a tool to help the establishment of craft businesses
authority: New Aquitaine Chambers of Trades and Crafts
desc: Choosing the right location is a decisive factor for the viability of a new craft business, yet artisans often have limited access to clear, evidence-based information on the characteristics of a territory before committing to an installation decision.

name: Digital twins in cultural heritage conservation: Notre-Dame Cathedral
desc: The AI-powered digital twin of Notre‑Dame is a project led by Microsoft in collaboration with heritage digitisation firm Iconem and the French Ministry of Culture.

name: EBB_AI : Co-creation-as-a-Service
desc: The EBB_AI: Co-creation-as-a-Service project is an innovative platform that allows cultural institutions and artists to harness artificial intelligence while safeguarding copyright.

name: EDF Leverages AI to Predict Grid Stress During Heatwaves
desc: France’s electrical grid is increasingly strained during summer heatwaves, and EDF’s traditional monitoring was largely reactive, often too late to prevent local outages. To address this, EDF deployed an AI system combining transformer-based forecasting and graph neural networks to model high-voltage and regional…

name: Expert systems in meteorology and climate to better forecasting
authority: Ministry of Ecological and Inclusive Transition - Météo France
desc: Weather and climate services must produce forecasts that are not only scientifically robust but also understandable, timely and useful for a wide range of users affected by meteorological risks.

name: Face recognition at schools - Face recognition at the building’s entrance
desc: The two largest southern cities of Nice and Marseille, proposed that some high schools should introduce face recognition at the building’s entrance. Under the plan, students would pass a face check prior to entering their high school. The program was to be funded and implemented by Cisco, a US company.

name: Facilitate access to patient information - Semantic search in patient records
desc: In hospitals and care settings, clinicians and nursing staff often lose valuable time searching through lengthy electronic patient records to locate relevant information needed for treatment, coordination or follow-up.

name: French Fraud - Fraud detection value declarations
desc: Customs authorities process very large numbers of import declarations and must identify potentially fraudulent cases without slowing down legitimate trade unnecessarily.

name: French police test AI-powered security cameras ahead of Olympics
desc: Large-scale public events such as the Olympic Games require robust security arrangements capable of detecting risks in real time while managing dense crowds. France introduced legislation permitting a temporary trial of intelligent video surveillance to identify predefined abnormal events during major gatherings.

name: Group disputes together with AI for a joint decision
desc: Administrative courts receive large numbers of claims, and many disputes may concern the same issue, legal basis or factual pattern even if they are filed separately.

name: Health data hub - Creation of a big data infrastructure in health
authority: Ministry of Solidarity and Health - DREES
desc: Health systems produce vast quantities of information, yet the value of these data is often constrained by fragmentation, inconsistent access and a shortage of shared tools and expertise to make them usable for research and operational decision-making.

name: Hello Charly - AI chatbot assisting students making decisions
desc: Young people often struggle to navigate complex education and career choices, particularly when information is fragmented or difficult to personalise. Hello Charly was developed to provide accessible guidance to students aged 14–24 through familiar digital channels.

name: IAlim - Targeting restaurant health inspections
authority: The General Food Directorate (DGAL) of the Ministry of Agriculture and Food
desc: Food safety authorities must prioritise inspections across large numbers of restaurants, food service businesses, and distributors, yet traditional inspection planning can struggle to identify which establishments present the greatest immediate risk.

name: IX3 - Mobility Pilot Project in Paris
desc: Urban traffic inefficiencies contribute significantly to greenhouse gas emissions, particularly through frequent stopping and re-acceleration at traffic lights. The IX3 mobility pilot in Paris addresses this issue by optimising traffic signal management to smooth vehicle flows.

name: Identify divergences in case law - Detection of divergent interpretations of the law
desc: Courts and legal institutions depend on a coherent interpretation of the law, yet divergences can arise when decisions on the same theme evolve differently across jurisdictions or judicial levels.

name: Identify false customs declarations using text mining
authority: General Directorate of Customs and Indirect Duties
desc: Customs authorities must review product descriptions in administrative documents to ensure that imported goods are declared under the correct nomenclature, particularly where some classifications attract more favourable tax treatment.

name: Improve the identification of the employing establishment in the population census
authority: National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies
desc: In population-census processing, accurately identifying a respondent’s employing establishment is essential for producing reliable statistics on commuting and home-to-work patterns.

name: Improve the online pre-complaint system - Detecting infringements automatically
authority: General Directorate of the National Gendarmerie
desc: Online pre-complaint services help citizens begin reporting offences before direct contact with law-enforcement officers, but these submissions are not always complete or sufficiently precise to be treated immediately as fully qualified complaints.

name: Intelligence Emploi
desc: Install Artificial Intelligence within Pôle emploi as a lever to accelerate the return to sustainable employment.

name: Ionising radiation exposure monitoring information system (SISERI)
authority: Institute for Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety
desc: Monitoring occupational exposure to ionising radiation is a critical public-health and workplace-safety responsibility, particularly for workers whose roles involve repeated or potentially high-risk exposure.

name: LaBonneBoîte - Identification of companies with a high probability of hiring
desc: Many job opportunities are never formally advertised, which means jobseekers can miss suitable openings if they rely only on published vacancies. In France, this use case was created to help people identify employers likely to recruit in the near future, even where no vacancy has yet been posted.

name: LightOn's Paradigm platform - Generative AI at the Île-de-France Regional Council
desc: Public sector agents often struggle to navigate complex internal documentation and information systems, leading to inefficiencies and increased workload for IT support teams. Stakeholders include regional council staff, digital transformation teams and technology providers.

name: Lille Metropole Smart Sensors
desc: Lille Métropole partnered with VizioSense to research, prototype and deploy intelligent parking sensors aimed at optimising management of public parking spaces. Urban congestion and inefficient parking allocation create traffic delays and environmental impacts.

name: Machine-learning to detect tax fraud in France
desc: To strengthen tax compliance and address undeclared income, France amended its 2020 Budget Law to permit the Ministry of Finance to collect publicly accessible data from social networks, online marketplaces and classified advertising platforms.

name: Mon parquet assistant - My assistant prosecutor
authority: Ministry of Justice, Paris Public Prosecutor's Office
desc: Mon parquet assistant is a digital-justice solution, developed under the aegis of beta.gouv.fr and the Parquet général de Paris, aimed at speeding up the processing of criminal-case files in courts under the Cour d'appel de Paris.

name: Nantes Social Water Pricing
desc: Access to affordable water is a fundamental right, yet low-income households often struggle with utility costs. Traditional means-tested assistance programmes require complex application processes and frequently miss eligible beneficiaries who are unaware of available support.

name: Nantes Solidarity Transport Pricing
desc: Public transport affordability is crucial for social inclusion, yet fixed-price ticketing can exclude low-income residents from mobility services essential for employment, healthcare access, and social participation.

name: Noa - chatbot
desc: Noa's chatbot "Guidaci in l'Amministrazione" is a public service accessible online to guide start-ups in their administrative processes.

name: Open LLM France and LINAGORA - Open Source LLM model
desc: European organisations increasingly want language technologies that are transparent, locally governed, and better aligned with national languages and public-sector requirements than many closed commercial models.

name: OpenJustice - Open case law, pseudonymization and enrichment of court decisions
desc: The French open-data programme for judicial decisions addresses a structural tension between transparency and privacy: courts must make case law more accessible and reusable, while ensuring that parties and other individuals mentioned in decisions are adequately protected.

name: Optimize the processing of reports of adverse health events
desc: Health authorities receive large numbers of adverse health event reports, and each submission may contain a mixture of structured details, free-text descriptions and signals of varying relevance or urgency.

name: PARCOURSUP | Screening of university applicants in France
desc: France introduced Parcoursup to manage the allocation of university places following reforms that allowed institutions to select applicants. The system addresses the challenge of matching student preferences with available study programmes at national scale.

name: Paris Hospitals Use AI for ICU Bed Allocation and Mortality Prediction
desc: ICU coordination in Paris’s public hospitals struggled with outdated availability data, exposed during COVID surges. Hospitals implemented an AI system using federated learning, allowing predictive models without centralising sensitive data.

name: Predictice - Summaries of Court Decisions
desc: This French legal research product uses ChatGPT to generate automatic summaries of court decisions. GPT-3 (Generative Pretrained Transformer 3) is a state-of-the-art language model that can generate text autonomously using machine learning algorithms. This tool is considered very promising.

name: Prediction supply of trucks - Machine Learning to predict truck scheduling
desc: At a loading facility confronted with unpredictable truck arrival times due to congestion, a machine-learning classifier is being used by La Poste to estimate the likelihood that each incoming truck would arrive early, on-time or late.

name: R2D3: Active-waiting robot for the disabled people’s waiting room
desc: The Seine-Saint-Denis Innovation Lab developed the R2D3 robot to improve accessibility and user experience for individuals visiting the Departmental House for Disabled Persons. Waiting times in administrative services can be challenging, particularly for users with diverse needs and varying levels of digital literacy.

name: RECITAL' Project: Immediate and Long-Term Energy Reduction
desc: Municipal buildings represent a significant share of urban energy consumption, yet fragmented monitoring systems limit proactive management of inefficiencies. The RECITAL project in Noisy-le-Grand introduced an “energy hypervisor” to centralise and analyse ten years of consumption data across municipal buildings.

name: RenoiRH - Chatbot in HR management rules to facilitate access
authority: Interministerial Center for IT Services Relating to Human Resources
desc: The French Interministerial Centre for IT Services Relating to Human Resources (CISIRH) manages complex HR systems across the public administration, where staff must navigate extensive regulatory frameworks governing careers, mobility, and administrative procedures.

name: SNCF collect 3x more customer feedback with AI
desc: Collection of Hot Feedback from Customers. AlloReview was implemented in an unsolicited manner by displaying QR codes and a phone number as well as providing business cards in over 250 TER train stations in France. Travelers scan or call the number and are free to share their experience at any time.

name: SNCF’s AI Maintenance Scheduler Reduces Train Downtime by 45%
desc: France’s national rail operator SNCF struggled with unexpected mechanical failures in its TGV fleet, as traditional time-based maintenance often missed early risks while causing unnecessary servicing. This led to inefficiencies, delays, and higher costs.

name: SignauxFaibles - Predictive analysis of business difficulties
authority: Ministry of the Economy, Finance and Recovery - General Directorate of Enterprises (DGE) / Ministry of Labor (DGEFP)
desc: Companies in financial difficulty often show warning signs before a crisis becomes visible, yet public support bodies may identify those signals too late to offer effective assistance.

name: Smart Airports: Object detection and pose estimation for airport activity monitoring
desc: Airports manage complex ground operations involving aircraft, vehicles, equipment and personnel, where situational awareness and safety are critical. Manual monitoring through CCTV systems can be labour-intensive and reactive. Stakeholders include airport operators, ground handling services and safety authorities.

name: Sovereign AI for Public Administration in France
desc: France has announced a strategic public–private partnership with Mistral AI and SAP SE to develop and deploy a “sovereign AI” infrastructure tailored for public administrations.

name: Supporting Civil Servant with Generative AI
authority:
Ministry of Processing and Function Public
Interministerial Directorate for Public Transformation (DITP) and the Interministerial Digital Directorate (DINUM),
desc: The civil service, the largest employer in France, cannot remain on the sidelines of this technological revolution, at the risk of suffering it.

name: Tackling urban heat through data, paying attention to our citizens' perception
desc: Tackling the effects of rising urban heat goes beyond objective physical measurements. For sure, technical services are in need of blended indicators about the effects of local policies: under which conditions tree planting, fountains, urban design contribute to reduce island heats.

name: Targeting establishment inspection - refine targeting of establishments for inspections
authority:
General Directorate of Food (DGAL) of the Ministry of
Agriculture and Food:
desc: refine the targeting of establishments to be inspected in the direct delivery sector to consumers (restaurants, catering trades, distributors) through consumer reviews on online review sites.

name: Transforming Public Services with AI in the Var Department
desc: The Var Department in southern France has implemented AI-driven tools to enhance public service efficiency and improve citizen engagement.

name: Use of Public Lighting System to Deploy a Comprehensive Smart City Platform
desc: The City of Paris aims to reduce its public lighting energy consumption by 30% by 2020. Paris has made a smart city-ready lighting grid covering the entire city. This helps minimize its lighting system’s environmental impact and improve citizens’ public safety and user experience.

name: Voice-bot ACOSS - answering questions from users
authority: Central Agency of Social Security Bodies (ACOSS):
desc: The Central Agency of Social Security Bodies developed the ACOSS voice-bot to answer questions from users of the Chèque Emploi Associatif, addressing a common service-delivery challenge in social-administration contexts: large volumes of routine enquiries can slow response times and place heavy demand on human support…

name: WISP - Road Crossing Management supported by AI - Pilot - Paris
desc: Urban traffic-light control often relies on static or costly automated regulation systems that do not adapt well to real-time traffic conditions, leading to unnecessary delays, higher emissions, and inefficient use of infrastructure.

name: "LLMoin" pilot project to provide insight into Hamburg's medium-term LLM strategy
desc: Public administrations face growing demands for efficiency in text-heavy tasks such as summarising documents, drafting responses and conducting research.

name: 120 Words per Minute - a Training App for Basal Automated Reading
desc: Primary schools face a persistent literacy challenge, as a substantial share of pupils do not reach fluent reading speed by the end of primary education and often struggle to recover later.

name: 5G test field planned in the Port of Duisburg
desc: 5G offers increasing flexibility, especially in traffic control.

name: A Web App to Support Risk Assessments for Small Businesses
authority: Berufsgenossenschaft Energie Textil Elektro Medienerzeugnisse (BG ETEM)
desc: BG ETEM has released a new web-app designed to help very small businesses quickly and easily carry out a “Gefährdungsbeurteilung” (risk assessment) — a key requirement for workplace safety.

name: A2I - Networked hearing system with innovative sensors
desc: In audiological, occupational health, and cardiological care, clinicians often rely on fragmented observations and periodic assessments, which can limit their ability to identify emerging issues early and respond with appropriately tailored interventions.

name: ABILITY - Improving the accessibility of digital images for blind users
desc: For blind and visually impaired people, digital images often remain difficult to access in a meaningful way, because standard image analysis tools are typically designed around the assumptions and preferences of sighted users.

name: ADLER: Local Language Models for Sensitive Data
authority: Bundesdruckerei Group – Federal AI Competence Center
desc: Public sector organisations frequently process confidential documents that cannot be transferred to external systems without risking data breaches or loss of sovereignty. Administrative staff require advanced text-processing capabilities while maintaining strict control over sensitive information.

name: AI -based cross-type mobility optimization in non-urban regions - KIMoNo
desc: Regions at the interface between urban and rural areas often suffer from fragmented mobility systems, inefficient logistics, and limited transport alternatives, leading to higher emissions and reduced accessibility.

name: AI -supported data analysis and simulation of rescue services - AI-Rescue
desc: Rescue services in Germany operate within heterogeneous organisational structures and varying levels of digitalisation, limiting data-driven optimisation of emergency response.

name: AI Language Assistant for the German Federal Administration: Efficient Information Processing
authority: Bundesdruckerei Group – Federal AI Competence Center
desc: Administrative decision-making often depends on analysing large volumes of unstructured documents, which places significant strain on staff resources. Federal authorities require tools to extract relevant information efficiently while maintaining accountability.

name: AI against pornography - Analysis of suspicious material
desc: Public prosecutors and investigators face the operational challenge of reviewing very large volumes of seized digital material in cases involving the distribution, acquisition or possession of child and youth sexual abuse imagery.

name: AI and M2M -based optimization of safety and comfort for people with mobility restrictions in non-motorized individual transport in the ERFURTS location
desc: People with mobility restrictions often encounter safety risks and accessibility barriers at signalised intersections and public transport stops, particularly where pedestrian flows intersect with motorised traffic.

name: AI and discrete loading optimization models to increase utilization in KV - KiBa
authority: Kombiverkehr German Society for Combined Freight Transport mbH & Co. KG
desc: Combined transport terminals must assign loading units to wagon sets efficiently, yet placement decisions often need to be made before complete information on incoming shipments is available. This creates operational uncertainty and can reduce utilisation of rail capacity.

name: AI competences for or the Max Planck Institute for Human Development in the institute's basic research
authority: Max Planck Institute for Human Development
desc: Interdisciplinary basic research increasingly depends on high-end AI, machine learning, and software-engineering capability, especially where projects attract public attention and require robust, secure, high-quality digital components.

name: AI for Species Protection - Detection of Illegal Online Wildlife Trade
authority: AI Lab at the German Environment Agency (UBA) and Federal Nature Conservation Agency
desc: Germany’s Federal Agency for Nature Conservation, together with the AI Lab at the German Environment Agency, developed an AI-driven tool to detect illegal online trading of protected species, one of the fastest-growing environmental crimes worldwide.

name: AI in Evaluating Citizens’ Contributions
desc: Public administrations increasingly rely on citizen participation processes, yet analysing large volumes of written contributions remains time-consuming and inconsistent. This research-based pilot explores how natural language processing can support public decision-making by structuring and analysing citizen input.

name: AI in numerical weather and climate forecasting
desc: Numerical weather prediction relies on complex physical models and vast quantities of observational data, including satellite imagery. Processing and integrating this data efficiently remains computationally demanding and may limit forecasting precision, particularly in extreme weather scenarios.

name: AI pilot in Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) in Ludwigshafen (Germany)
desc: Ludwigshafen PSAP explored whether advanced language and call-assistance technologies could improve emergency-call handling in situations where operators must work quickly, accurately and sometimes across multiple languages.

name: AI to combat child pornography online
authority: the Zentral- und Ansprechstelle Cybercrime (Contact Office for Cyber Crime, ZAC NRW)
desc: An AI tool to identify pornographic images of children was developed in a collaboration between (Richter, 2019) Microsoft and the Ministry of Justice of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia, the Zentral- und Ansprechstelle Cybercrime (Contact Office for Cyber Crime, ZAC NRW) based in the department of public…

name: AI to spot counterfeit products at customs
desc: Customs authorities face growing challenges in detecting counterfeit goods within increasing volumes of international trade. Manual inspection processes are resource-intensive and may not consistently identify sophisticated counterfeits, undermining trademark protection and fair competition.

name: AI warns german businesses that the documents uploaded to apply for import tax exemptions might be wrong
authority: Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control (BAFA)
desc: German businesses, in the case of an application to limit the Renewable Energy Sources (EEG) surcharge as part of the special equalization regulation, must submit all relevant documents before the material deadline.

name: AI-Based Virtual Assistant for Faster and Reliable Businesses Support
authority: Berufsgenossenschaft Energie Textil Elektro Medienerzeugnisse (BG ETEM)
desc: The statutory accident insurer BG ETEM developed a virtual assistant (MeinAssistent) to support its “Members and Fees” department, which has seen a sharp increase in inquiries from businesses.

name: AI-Breeding – find the highest yielding strains quickly and accurately
authority: Justus Liebig University Giessen, Professorship for Plant Breeding
desc: The main goals of the AI ​​breeding project are initially to develop or apply machine learning (ML) methods for pattern recognition from highly complex genome/phenomenon or environmental data sets for the prediction of performance-related and environment-dependent genetic structures in plant breeding populations.

name: AI-Driven Early Warning and Decision Support for Fraud Prevention in Quality-Labelled Food Supply Chains
authority: Bavarian State Office for Health and Food Safety (Bayerisches Landesamt für Gesundheit und Lebensmittelsicherheit – LGL)
desc: The ALLIANCE EWDSS, developed by Netcompany S.A. as part of the EU-funded ALLIANCE project, is an AI-powered system designed to detect and mitigate food fraud across complex supply chains.

name: AI-EFFECT, Advancing AI Integration in the European Energy Sector - Distribution Network Congestion Management for Renewable Integration
desc: Electricity distribution networks are under increasing strain as renewable generation, electrification, and decentralised energy resources grow, leading to congestion and operational complexity at local grid level.

name: AI-Enhanced Processing of Business Registrations for Faster Public Service Delivery
authority: Berufsgenossenschaft Energie Textil Elektro Medienerzeugnisse (BG ETEM)
desc: The statutory accident insurer BG ETEM faced a sharp rise in electronic business registrations, causing long delays and a five-digit backlog. To resolve this, it introduced the EDA GWA AI solution, which integrates artificial intelligence and robotic process automation into its core system.

name: AI-Supported unmanned aeriasl vehicles (UAVs) for Ecological Agriculture and Forestry
desc: This project explores the use of unmanned aerial vehicles to support ecological agriculture and forestry management. Monitoring weeds, crop health, and forest conditions typically requires significant manual effort and may lack precision at scale.

name: AI-TEST-FIELD – Semantic Environment Perception for Intelligent Sensor Systems
authority: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence GmbH (DFKI)
desc: Safe operation of autonomous and assisted systems requires reliable perception of complex and changing environments. Current sensor systems often struggle to deliver consistent and certifiable outputs under varying conditions, limiting deployment in safety-critical contexts.

name: AI-based Integrated identity management for asylum procedures, improving plausability, data quality and security aspects
authority: German Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF)
desc: Asylum procedures require accurate registration and verification of personal identity under challenging conditions, often involving missing documents, language barriers, and high case volumes. Manual processes increase the risk of data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and security vulnerabilities.

name: AI-based system for connected mobility - KIS'M
authority: State of Berlin, represented by the Senate Department for the Environment, Mobility, Consumer and Climate Protection
desc: Rapidly growing residential areas in Berlin require affordable and reliable public transport solutions capable of operating safely in mixed traffic environments.

name: AI-iREPro - using AI to manage viticulture more efficiently
