authority: Julius Kühn Institute Federal Research Institute for Cultivated Plants (JKI)
desc: The joint project KI-iREPro aims to develop digital tools for vineyard-specific yield forecasting, which combine state-of-the-art sensor technology with intelligent forecast models.

name: AI.CAN: AI Citizen Science Aqua Network
desc: Monitoring water quality across a river system is a complex task, particularly when environmental changes can emerge quickly and official measurement points alone may not provide enough spatial or temporal coverage.

name: AI4POL: Using Artificial Intelligence to Support Regulators & Policy Makers
desc: A key focus of the AI4POL project is understanding and improving consumer protection.

name: AI4grids - AI - based planning and operational management of distribution grids
desc: The AI4Grids project at HTWG Konstanz focuses on using artificial intelligence to support the planning and operation of electricity distribution networks and micro-grids.

name: AI^2 - (Aphid identification through artificial intelligence)
authority: Julius Kühn Institute Federal Research Institute for Cultivated Plants (JKI)
desc: The AI² project focuses on improving the monitoring of harmful insects in agriculture, where timely detection is critical to prevent crop damage and ensure food security. Traditional methods of analysing insect trap data are labour-intensive and slow, limiting the ability to respond quickly to emerging threats.

name: ALLEGRO - administer unemployment benefit
desc: The Bundesagentur für Arbeit (Federal Labor Agency) uses an IT-system called ALLEGRO to administer unemployment benefit. The agency workers input an applicants’ data and the system calculates the corresponding benefit levels.

name: ARC-D - Automatic Road Condition Detection
authority: BMVI, Autobahn GmbH of the Federal Government
desc: ARC-D addresses the lack of automated, up-to-date condition monitoring across the federal motorway network, a gap that makes it harder for road authorities to detect deterioration early and to plan timely maintenance before defects become more severe and more expensive to repair.

name: ARMAR-6 – Cooperative robot in industrial environments
desc: ARMAR-6 is a humanoid assistance robot for industrial environments that interacts with people and proactively supports them. With his human-like body, he can use tools created for humans such as drills or hammers.

name: Adaptive maps and AI -based infrastructure monitoring - AK-KII
desc: Highly automated mobility depends on precise and continuously updated digital maps reflecting the condition of road infrastructure. Vehicles can only operate safely and efficiently if they have reliable, location-specific information about road geometry, surface condition and structural integrity.

name: Alpine mobility data room Inntal - ALMODA
desc: Mountain regions face complex mobility challenges due to terrain, weather variability, cross-border traffic, and safety requirements. Local communities in the Alpine Inntal region require accurate, real-time information to support safe, efficient, and sustainable mobility.

name: Application of AI for early recognition of criminal offences that relate to hate crime
desc: In this research project, the use of AI to detect, prevent and prosecute hate crime in police organisations is being investigated within a holistic framework.

name: Aquatic Litter Drones
desc: Monitoring marine and freshwater litter is essential for environmental protection, yet manual surveys are labour-intensive and inconsistent. This use case establishes a service that processes drone imagery to detect and classify floating litter in water bodies and on beaches.

name: Artificial Intelligence and Mobility - AIAMO
authority: Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport (BMDV)
desc: Fragmented mobility data and limited interoperability between transport services hinder environmentally oriented and multimodal traffic management across cities and regions.

name: Artificial Intelligence in the Sorting of Municipal Waste as an Enabler of the Circular Economy
desc: Municipal waste management systems face persistent challenges in increasing recycling rates, improving material purity, and reducing the volume of waste sent to landfill.

name: Artificial intelligence helps predict groundwater levels
authority: Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR)
desc: Climate change and increasing water demand are placing growing pressure on groundwater resources, making reliable prediction of groundwater levels critical for sustainable water management.

name: Artificial intelligence in Ingolstadt's transport system - KIVI
desc: Modern transport systems often lack a complete and up-to-date view of all road users, particularly pedestrians and cyclists, which makes it harder to optimise traffic control and improve safety in mixed urban environments.

name: Assessment of money laundering activities through AI
desc: The German Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) is responsible for analysing suspicious transaction reports to detect and prevent money laundering and terrorist financing. The increasing volume and complexity of financial data make manual analysis inefficient and time-consuming.

name: Assessment security properties of Symmetric Ciphers - Supporting assessment of security properties of cryptographic algorithms
desc: Assessing the security strength of cryptographic algorithms is a technically demanding task, yet it is essential for organisations that rely on encryption to protect sensitive information.

name: Automated border control via Easypass Registered Traveler Program - biometric face recognition system
desc: International airport border control in Germany faced growing passenger volumes requiring faster processing whilst maintaining security standards and compliance with Schengen external border regulations.

name: Automated image recognition for determining the type of wood
desc: Ensuring the legal origin of timber products is a key requirement under the European Timber Trade Regulation, which obliges market participants to accurately document the wood species used in traded goods.

name: Automatic Detection of Impervious Surfaces
desc: Recklinghausen, located in North Rhine-Westphalia, together with the Westphalian University of Applied Sciences, has developed software based on artificial intelligence (AI), which automatically derives a map of impervious surfaces from aerial images and aggregates it to any area divisions.

name: Automation of Hamburg's on-demand offering with integration into public transport - AHOI project
authority: Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, Authority for Transport and Mobility Transition (FHH)
desc: Urban mobility providers face operational and regulatory challenges when integrating on-demand transport services and emerging autonomous vehicle technologies into existing public transport systems.

name: Autonomous Fawn Tracking System - AROS
desc: Farmers and wildlife-protection volunteers have only a short time to locate hidden fawns in fields before mowing begins, and manual searches with thermal drones can still be labour-intensive, weather-sensitive, and dependent on multiple people.

name: Autonomous Tram Depot (AStriD) – Digital Depot Operations in Potsdam
desc: Urban transport operators face rising pressure to increase efficiency while maintaining safety and reliability in depot operations. The ASTRiD project addresses this challenge by developing a digital tram depot capable of supporting autonomous vehicle movements within controlled environments.

name: Autonomous shuttles & Co in the digital test field for city traffic - Shuttles &Co
authority: State of Berlin, represented by the Senate Department for the Environment, Transport and Climate Protection
desc: Urban authorities face challenges in integrating highly automated vehicles into complex city traffic while ensuring safety, interoperability and public acceptance.

name: Autonomously working machines in road construction 4.0 - ROBOT road construction 4.0
desc: Road construction projects often face labour shortages, safety risks and inconsistent quality control during asphalt paving.

name: BETTER-WEEDS - AI to recognise weed species
authority: Julius Kühn Institute Federal Research Institute for Cultivated Plants (JKI)
desc: Farmers must balance effective weed control to protect crop yields with growing societal and regulatory expectations for environmentally sustainable practices and biodiversity preservation. Conventional blanket herbicide application can harm beneficial plant species and increase ecological pressure.

name: BOTschafft Inclusion - AI for families with disability
desc: Parents caring for children with disabilities or chronic illnesses often face a complex and exhausting landscape of support services, rehabilitation options, training opportunities and employment-related questions.

name: Battling pandemics with the help of AI
desc: The Lower Saxony State Health Office developed Nova to respond to a recurring public-health communication challenge: during major health events such as the COVID-19 pandemic, public enquiries can rise sharply, overloading staff and making it harder to provide quick, consistent answers through traditional channels…

name: BerDiBa Project: Berlin Digital Railway Operation
desc: BerDiBa Project addresses the need to modernise urban rail transport in Berlin by increasing automation, safety and operational reliability under real traffic conditions.

name: Bobbi -  Berlin administration
desc: The state of Berlin already offers convenient solutions with the ServicePortal and the citizen hotline 115 for citizens' requests. The chatbot “Bobbi” can serve as an additional channel to help citizens quickly and conveniently with their concerns, even outside of 115 service hours.

name: BoniKI - plant-specific assessment by autonomous systems
authority: FZI Research Center for Computer Science
desc: Assessing plant health, growth, and pest infestation is essential for sustainable agriculture, yet manual inspection is labour-intensive, costly, and dependent on expert judgement. Sampling-based methods provide limited resolution and may miss early signs of stress or disease.

name: C-19 - Interdepartmental chatbot on the topic of Corona.
desc: During the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, German public services experienced a dramatic increase in citizen enquiries, with volumes reported to rise by up to ten times.

name: COMo - CO2 monitoring in publicly accessible indoor spaces
authority: Technology Foundation Berlin and the Berlin University of Applied Sciences (HTW)
desc: In COMo, the CO2 concentration served as a measure for indoor air quality and aerosol pollution, which was correlated with the potential (COVID) viral load. Objective CO2 readings via networked sensors enabled operators to control the indoor air quality and thus reduced the risk of infection for visitors.

name: CONMAR - studying contaminated sites with underwater drones
authority: Helmholtz Center for Ocean Research Kiel (GEOMAR)
desc: The CONMAR project addresses the environmental and safety challenges posed by marine munitions and contaminated sites in coastal and offshore areas. These hazards are difficult to monitor due to limited accessibility and fragmented data across institutions.

name: CORRECTIV.Faktenforum - AI to combat disinformation
desc: CORRECTIV.Faktenforum is Germany's first fact-checking community, built by CORRECTIV to combat disinformation using a combination of prebunking and debunking strategies, supported by civic tech.

name: ChatBot Botty Bonn
desc: The chatbot received a new technical basis and will be set up in a live and developer environment. As a community offer, the chatbot is then freely available as an open platform for all interested co-developers. All municipal service information will be available in the chatbot by the end of the year.

name: Chatbot - German Federal Employment Agency
desc: The Federal Employment Agency introduced a chatbot to improve accessibility to information on employment services and social benefits.

name: Chatbot Govii
desc: The City of Flensburg piloted Chatbot Govii in 2021 to streamline access to municipal administrative services and contact information. Residents often encounter difficulty identifying the correct department or procedure for specific requests.

name: Chatbot Guido
desc: The State of North Rhine-Westphalia implemented Chatbot Guido to simplify access to information regarding online business registration procedures. Entrepreneurs and business owners often require clear guidance on administrative steps, documentation requirements and digital submission processes.

name: Chatbot LinA: the chatbot that answers general inquiries in the field of motor vehicle tax and customs law
desc: Germany's customs authority receives high volumes of citizen inquiries about import duties, customs procedures, and international trade regulations, creating significant workload for staff and variable response times for users.

name: Chatbot Munich
desc: The IT-Department of the municipality of Munich is developing a chatbot for Munich which is supposed to complete the current services like the common emergency number 115, the service portal and mobile apps.

name: Chatbot ViOlA for the homepage of the german Federal Central Tax Office
desc: Germany's Federal Employment Agency (Bundesagentur für Arbeit) serves millions of citizens seeking employment services, training, and benefits.

name: Chatbot for the 2021 Federal Elections
desc: Elections require well-informed citizens who understand voting procedures, the electoral system, and key democratic principles.

name: Child benefit - Voice assistant for parents support
authority: Hamburg Office for IT and Digitalisation
desc: In the days immediately following childbirth, parents are legally required to complete a range of formal administrative steps, including providing registration information, determining the child’s name and establishing the first official conditions for receiving parental and child benefits.

name: City of Herne road maintance with AI
desc: Urban road networks require continuous monitoring and timely maintenance to ensure safety and cost efficiency. In Herne, managing a 380 km road network posed challenges in data integration, prioritisation and long-term planning. Stakeholders include municipal authorities, infrastructure managers and contractors.

name: Civic-Sync – Mapping platform for social offerings
desc: Citizens and frontline organisations often struggle to navigate the wide range of social and cultural services available in a community, especially when information is fragmented across providers, difficult to search or inaccessible to people who face language or digital barriers.

name: Civocracy - Online Platform
desc: Civocracy is an online platform serving as a discussion board between citizens, businesses, organizations, and governments.

name: Claim - AI for social claims
desc: Many people do not access state support simply because the system is difficult to understand, full of administrative language and fragmented across multiple schemes, forms and eligibility rules.

name: Comms4Good - AI for public relations work of social and non-profit organizations
desc: Many social and non-profit organisations need to communicate professionally with the public, funders and local communities, yet they often lack dedicated communications staff, sufficient budgets or the specialist expertise needed to produce high-quality public-relations material.

name: DB Smile - the national railway service chatbot for job seekers
desc: Deutsche Bahn introduced DB Smile to streamline recruitment processes and support job seekers navigating employment opportunities within the national railway company. The operational challenge was to manage high volumes of candidate enquiries and simplify application procedures.

name: DZSF – Object Detection and Classification for Automated Rail Driving
desc: Higher levels of rail automation require technical systems to assume tasks traditionally performed by drivers, including continuous monitoring of the track environment to detect and classify objects that may affect safety or operations.

name: Data4UrbanMobility - Development of application-driven tools for mobility information
desc: Urban mobility planning increasingly depends on integrating diverse data sources to understand traffic dynamics, user behaviour, and emerging mobility services. Cities often lack tools that translate large volumes of heterogeneous mobility data into actionable insights for planning and operations.

name: Deaf.AI - AI for social inclusion
desc: Deaf people continue to face significant communication barriers in everyday social and professional life, particularly where information, services and interactions are not readily available in sign language.

name: Differentiation of ship types on satellite radar images
desc: Monitoring maritime activities over large ocean areas is critical for environmental protection, security, and enforcement against illegal activities such as unregulated fishing. Traditional methods rely on manual interpretation of satellite imagery, which is time-consuming and limited in scalability.

name: Digital test field Air Cargo - DTAC
authority: Fraunhofer Institute for Material Flow and Logistics IML
desc: Air freight transport involves numerous actors, including airlines, freight forwarders, ground handlers and customs authorities, whose fragmented information systems limit efficiency and transparency across the logistics chain.

name: Digitale Assistenz Ina
authority: Integration Office of the State Government of Schleswig-Holstein
desc: The state of Schleswig-Holstein introduced the digital assistant Ina to provide information related to the Integration Office, particularly on matters concerning disability and workplace inclusion.

name: Digitaler Erstkontakt (Digital Initial Contact) - AI for counseling services related to family and parenthood
desc: People seeking advice on family and parenting issues do not always know which counselling service is appropriate for their situation, and this can delay support, create frustration and increase the burden on organisations that must redirect enquiries manually.

name: DyRiAS potential to go on a school shooting rampage.
desc: In Landesschulamt Sachsen-Anhalt (Federal State Education Agency) DyRiAS-Schule (DyRiAS school) is deployed to analyze the threat levels of students who have the potential to go on a school shooting rampage.

name: DyRiAS threat levels of abusive male partners
desc: Protection centers for women in the cities of Singen and Weimar use DyRiAS-Intimpartner (DyRiAS intimate partner) to determine the threat levels of abusive male partners.

name: DynAWI - Predict extreme weather situations reliably and region-specific
authority: Julius Kühn Institute Federal Research Institute for Cultivated Plants (JKI)
desc: Extreme weather events increasingly threaten agricultural productivity, yet timely and region-specific assessment tools are often lacking. Farmers and public authorities need reliable indicators to anticipate yield impacts and support risk management decisions.

name: EKAPEx - AI for precipitation forecast
desc: Forecasting extreme precipitation accurately is a growing operational challenge, particularly as severe weather events place increasing pressure on infrastructure, emergency planning and public safety.

name: EdTech for Diversity in AI
desc: As companies increasingly adopt digital applications in people-related processes such as recruitment, there is a growing need to ensure that these systems are introduced in ways that do not reproduce or reinforce discrimination.

name: EnMAP - Environmental Mapping and Analysis Program
authority: Federal Ministry of Economics and Climate Protection (BMWi)
desc: Traditional satellite imagery captures only a limited portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, restricting scientists' ability to detect subtle environmental changes in vegetation health, water quality, soil composition, and mineral deposits essential for climate monitoring and resource management.

name: Enhancing metadata for textual information - improving the quality of search and automatic reasoning
authority: Federal Office for Security in Information Technology (Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik - BSI)
desc: Public organisations working with large volumes of unstructured information on IT security need better ways to search, interpret and reuse textual content that is often fragmented across news, reports and background material.

name: Environmental monitoring of sea trouts with AI
authority: Fraunhofer Institute for Computer Graphics Research IGD
desc: Monitoring fish populations such as sea trout is essential for environmental conservation and fisheries management, but traditional counting methods based on manual observation are labour-intensive and prone to error.

name: Environmental monitoring with AI at the German Environment Agency
desc: Environmental authorities face growing challenges in analysing large volumes of heterogeneous data across climate, air quality, energy and resource use, often stored in fragmented and hard-to-access systems.

name: ErLeSen - Creation and Analysis of Easy Language through AI
desc: Access to information remains uneven when official or public-facing texts are difficult to understand for people with cognitive impairments or limited proficiency in German.

name: F13, the LLM used by the State of Baden-Württemberg in collaboration with Aleph Alpha
desc: The system, F13, was developed primarily by the Heidelberg-based AI start-up Aleph Alpha, which has been touted as a German response to OpenAI's ChatGPT, though aimed at government, administration and industry in particular.

name: FAKE-ID - Video analysis using AI to detect false and manipulated identities
desc: The rapid spread of manipulated video content poses growing risks to trust, security, and democratic processes, as falsified or synthetic identities can be used for fraud, disinformation, and impersonation.

name: Feasibility study for the harmonisation of truck parking space occupancy through networked model-predictive control systems based on V2X technologies - PAHA
authority: Erfurt University of Applied Sciences, Faculty of Economics, Logistics, Transport
desc: Overcrowding at truck rest areas along heavily used federal highways leads to safety risks, inefficient parking searches and uneven utilisation of available capacity. Despite infrastructure investments, demand peaks in the evening and at night continue to strain facilities.

name: FlatFish - Autonomous inspections in the deep sea
authority: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
desc: The underwater inspection of offshore industrial facilities is a complex, expensive and risky undertaking.

name: FloReST - Intelligent tools for urban flood resilience
desc: Increasing frequency of heavy rainfall events has exposed urban areas to significant risks of flash flooding, causing damage to infrastructure and disrupting communities.

name: Flora Incognita app - recognise wild plants using an app
desc: The free Flora Incognita app uses artificial intelligence to identify wild plants quickly, easily and precisely. It is intended to raise awareness among the population on the importance of biodiversity.

name: Fluently - the essence of human-robot interaction
desc: Modern manufacturing increasingly depends on effective collaboration between people and machines, yet many industrial systems still require specialised knowledge to operate and can place unnecessary cognitive or physical strain on workers.

name: Frag-den-Michel! Innovativer Online-Bürgerservice in Betrieb
desc: Hamburg authorities receive a wide range of general enquiries from citizens, many of which fall outside normal office hours and place pressure on telephone services. Citizens expect timely access to reliable information regardless of time or channel.

name: FreshRegio – making the quality of fruit and vegetables measurable
desc: Quality assessment of fruit and vegetables is critical for regional agriculture and efficient food supply chains, yet traditional inspection methods are often subjective, labour-intensive, and limited in predictive power.

name: Future criminal court rooms
desc: The aim of this pilot project developed by the Central Cybercrime Department of North-Rhine-Westphalia is to create modern court rooms which allow videotaping and speech-to text recognition. All participants are projected to receive a transcription and the audio file embedded.

name: G@ZIELT: Safe shopping on the internet
authority: Federal Office of Consumer Protection and Food Safety (BVL)
desc: Consumers in Germany are increasingly purchasing food and cosmetics online, with a rising trend in online purchases of various items including kitchen utensils, toys, clothing, and tobacco products.

name: GAIA-X: AI-Marketplace: An Ecosystem For Artificial Intelligence
desc: The project AI Marketplace establishes a digital platform for artificial intelligence (AI) in product development. The platform brings together AI experts, solution providers and manufacturing companies alike, promotes joint innovations and builds on an existing infrastructure.

name: GAIA-X: Data Science & Machine Learning (DSML) Hub
desc: The Data Science & Machine Learning (DSML) Hub stands for openness and use of public administration data (in consideration of data protection) in order to make it available for the develop-ment of data science and AI applications.

name: GAIA-X: Digital public administration – Chatbot
desc: The project can support the implementation of digital assistants by creating the necessary basis for a legally compliant cloud environment for the development and use of digital assistants in administration, in which functional AI building blocks (i.e.

name: GAIA-X: Predictive maintenance for the road infrastructure in South Tyrol
desc: GAIA-X acts as a data lake and scalable infrastructure for the storage and processing of heterogeneous data sources used by public administrations to make more well-founded decisions for road maintenance.

name: GPT-enabled chatbot of the Rhineland-Palatinate Development Agency
desc: Agencies that run many projects and programmes often hold relevant information across numerous internal and public materials, making it difficult for users to obtain quick, targeted answers about activities, tasks, and ongoing work.

name: Generative AI Assistant PARLA for the City of Berlin
desc: Public administrations and political institutions generate thousands of documents, but finding the right information quickly across parliamentary papers, committee procedures, and written questions can be time-consuming for civil servants, journalists, associations, and citizens alike.

name: Generative Ai for German Public Administration
desc: German public administrations face increasing demand for faster, clearer and more consistent public services amid staffing constraints and growing volumes of written communication. Federal, state and municipal authorities have begun piloting generative language technologies to support administrative tasks.

name: German Ministry of Research, Technology, and Space provides a popular chatbot to make project funding regulations more accessible
authority: German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology, and Space (BMFTR)
desc: Research funding regulations are complex and difficult for applicants to interpret, often leading to incomplete applications and high enquiry volumes. The German Ministry of Research, Technology, and Space introduced a digital assistant to improve accessibility of funding information.

name: German government hotline 115: AI-based chatbot for 24/7 support
desc: Germany’s national public-service hotline “115,” which provides citizens with information and guidance on a wide range of administrative procedures, has upgraded its digital support system by replacing its earlier rule-based chatbot with a new AI-driven version.

name: Germany analyses big data with AI to manage tourist trends
desc: This solution from the German National Tourist Board (GNTB) provides a comprehensive overview of destination visitor trends.

name: Germany's Federal Office for Migrants and Refugees - Refugee Language Detection
authority: Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF)
desc: Asylum authorities sometimes need to assess the likely origin of applicants who lack documentation, yet this can be difficult where identity evidence is incomplete and decisions must rely on a combination of interviews, records, and expert judgement.

name: Govbot -  Administrative search engine for citizens' enquiries
authority: Ministerium für Inneres und Kommunales des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen
desc: Citizens frequently struggle to find the right administrative information because public services are spread across many institutions, websites, and levels of government, each using its own terminology and structure.

name: HEB KI– Artificial intelligence searches to improve barley variety
authority: Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg, Institute for Agricultural and Nutritional Sciences
desc: The HEB-KI project aims to expand the HEB-25 barley population to the HEX-35 in a resource-efficient manner using AI methods. For this purpose, suitable accessions for the crosses are specifically selected from a wild barley population.

name: HammerHAI - New AI-optimised Supercomputer
desc: HammerHAI is a European initiative aimed at accelerating the adoption of artificial intelligence in industry and scientific research.

name: Helpme.ai - assisting asylum seekers with AI
desc: Helpme.ai utilises Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver chatbot functionality. The platform employs an LLM version to ensure the responsible and privacy-compliant use of the AI solution.

name: ITERATOR – Automated Detection of Pores in Rocks
authority: Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR)
desc: Understanding the physical properties of rocks is essential for applications such as geothermal energy, fluid storage, and geological disposal, where porosity plays a decisive role.

name: Identity Check of Migrants - Analysis of content and language of phones
authority: Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, BAMF)
desc: The Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, BAMF) has been using automated text and speech recognition systems to identify refugees since 2017.

name: InA– The Chatbot at the Office of Integration
authority: Office of Integration of the Ministry for Social Affairs, Health, Family, Youth, and Senior Citizens of Schleswig-Holstein
desc: The Office of Integration of the Ministry for Social Affairs, Health, Family, Youth, and Senior Citizens integrated a chat bot into its website in February 2020. This chat bot is being further developed in a follow-on project.

name: Indoor Robot - Making a 3D model of a new building
authority: Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure (BMVI)
desc: This use case was created to improve accessibility and navigation in public buildings by generating more detailed and practical spatial information than conventional building plans typically provide.

name: Intelligent information technologies for process optimization and automation in inland ports - Binntelligent
authority: Institute of Shipping Economics and Logistics (ISL)
desc: Inland waterways offer underutilised capacity for freight transport, yet coordination gaps within multimodal logistics chains limit the performance of inland ports. The Binntelligent project aimed to strengthen inland port operations by improving data-driven coordination among transport stakeholders.

name: Intelligent layout of areas for optimal school districts design
desc: School districts should be designed in such a way that schools have as even a capacity as possible and the distances to school for children are short. At the same time, it is important to achieve a social mix among the students.

name: Intelligent traffic control in the port of Hamburg - various applications
desc: In the Port of Hamburg, state-of-the-art digital intelligence ensures smooth and efficient operation. The control systems used by the Hamburg Port Authority are world leaders, and the interaction of sensor technology, analysis, forecasting and information systems has led to enormous increases in efficiency.

name: JUS-IT -  Child Care Service
authority: Agency for Labor, Social Affairs, Family and Integration
desc: Since 2012, the Behörde für Arbeit, Soziales, Familie und Integration (Agency for Labor, Social Affairs, Family and Integration) in Hamburg has been using a piece of software called JUS-IT (Behörde für Arbeit Soziales Familie und Integration, 2018) for the General Social Service, the Child Care Service and the…

name: Jelbi - the mobility app for Berlin's public and sharing services
desc: Jelbi was launched by Berlin’s public transport authority BVG to integrate public transport and shared mobility services into a single digital platform. Urban travellers often face fragmented booking and payment systems across transport providers.

name: KAMI – Dairy cow respiratory rate monitoring
authority: Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy
desc: The aim of KAMI is to develop an early warning system that warns farmers when their dairy cows become ill or are exposed to the beginning of stress. This will increase animal welfare in the future and avoid financial losses.

name: KI4Forst - Monitoring the Forest with Satellite Data and AI
desc: The Schleswig-Holstein State Office for Surveying and Geoinformation aims to improve forest monitoring and management by leveraging satellite data.

name: KI4GeoSeDa – AI-Based Georeferencing of Specialist Data Pools for Semantic Data Integration
authority: Schleswig-Holstein State Office for Surveying and Geo-Information
desc: The Schleswig-Holstein State Office for Surveying and Geoinformation, in collaboration with the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, aims to improve the integration of heterogeneous spatial datasets used in public administration.

name: KI4LSA – Artificial Intelligence for Adaptive Traffic Signal Control
authority: Municipalities of Bielefeld, Gütersloh, Lemgo, Neuss, Rheine and Soest
desc: Increasing urban traffic congestion leads to longer travel times, higher fuel consumption, and increased noise and air pollution.

name: KIA - AI-supported assistance for digital psychosocial counseling
desc: Digital psychosocial counselling services often require counsellors to assess complex enquiries quickly while maintaining empathy, relevance and consistency in their responses.

name: KIBREED – using AI to grow site-adapted plants
authority: Leibniz Institute for Plant Genetics and Crop Plant Research (IPK)
desc: The aim of the KIBREED research project is to make AI algorithms usable for breeding locally adapted varieties. By means of 'Deep Learning' procedures, data from the methods of 'Genotyping', 'Phenotyping' and 'Envirotyping' are to be analyzed in an integrated way.

name: KIEZ - an Agentic AI Assistant for Development Cooperation
authority: German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)
desc: KIEZ is an AI-powered assistant developed by the Datalab of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) to support public servants in processing large volumes of text and improving decision-making in the domain of economic cooperation.

name: KINERA – Optimizing production processes in agriculture
authority: University of Hohenheim, Department of Artificial Intelligence in Agricultural Engineering
desc: The aim of KINERA is to increase efficiency and resilience in the agricultural sector through the use of artificial intelligence (AI).

name: KIRA - AI research assistant
authority: Secretary of State of the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg (Senatskanzlei)
desc: As part of Hamburg’s digital strategy, the KIRA Research Assistant addresses the challenge of managing vast amounts of legal and social services legislation.

name: KISTRA (use of artificial intelligence for the early detection of criminal offenses) - research project
desc: Online hate crime poses growing societal risks, yet early detection and prevention raise complex legal, ethical and operational challenges for security authorities.

name: KIWA, an AI-based forest monitoring system
desc: KIWA — “AI‑based forest monitoring” — is an initiative that combines drones, artificial intelligence and decision‑support systems to enable early detection and effective management of forest fires.

name: KIdetect - Reliable detection of weed growth centers
desc: The aim of the project is to detect weeds in real time based on AI-supported image processing and multispectral camera systems (VIS/SWIR).

name: KRIBL - affordable robotics also for small businesses
authority: University of Lübeck, Institute for Robotics and Cognitive Systems
desc: Innovative future solutions should be accessible to all agricultural businesses. KRIBL wants to support this by developing practical, small robot systems at an affordable price and with flexible application options. The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in agriculture can be very helpful.

name: Kora - virtual assistant
desc: The Municipality of Heidenheim introduced Kora, a virtual assistant designed to provide round-the-clock responses to common citizen enquiries. The objective was to improve accessibility to municipal information while reducing administrative workload.

name: LUMI - the Made-in-Europe chatbot for Heidelberg
desc: Municipal residents often need simple guidance on everyday administrative matters, yet city websites can be difficult to navigate when users do not know the exact terminology or service path they need.

name: Land register analysis component in the project Development of a federal database land register
authority: Commission for information technology in the judiciary
desc: This project aims to automate the analysis of existing PDF files with land register information. Afterwards the tool will fragment the file and assign the values to a database field in order to be able to store the contents in a structured manner in a database.

name: Language skills in the digital age
desc: Public administrations operating in international contexts require fast and reliable translation capabilities, yet traditional human-only workflows struggle to keep pace with growing volumes of multilingual content.

name: MACRO – Cross-Scale Regionalisation of Hydrogeological Information
authority: Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR)
desc: Hydrogeological assessments often rely on data collected at different spatial scales, making it difficult to derive coherent regional models that support water management and planning. Local measurements provide high accuracy but limited coverage, while regional datasets lack detail and consistency.

name: MASIRI – Multi-Agent Simulation for Integrated Energy and Mobility Systems
desc: The integration of energy and mobility systems, such as vehicle-to-grid solutions, depends not only on technical optimisation but also on human behaviour and decision-making. Traditional system models often neglect how users’ experiences, preferences, and habits influence energy and mobility usage.

name: MODUL-F: empowering public administration through low-code/no-code
desc: Public administrations in Germany face persistent challenges in digitising internal procedures, often relying on fragmented, manual, or paper-based processes that slow service delivery and burden staff. Developing custom IT solutions is costly and time-consuming, especially for smaller authorities.

name: Machine Learning in Editing and Imputation - Automated editing and correcting of data
desc: A key operational issue in official statistics is the need to correct missing, implausible or inconsistent observations quickly enough to keep production cycles on schedule without overloading staff.

name: Machine Learning in Simulation for Imaging Improvement
authority: Bundesamt für Ausrüstung, Informationstechnik und Nutzung der Bundeswehr
desc: Military training simulations require high levels of visual realism to ensure effective preparation, yet conventional rendering methods may lack photorealistic detail, particularly across different spectral ranges. Stakeholders include defence research bodies, simulation software providers and training institutions.

name: Machine Learning in Text Classification Projects -  Relieving staff from coding tasks
desc: Across many official statistics processes, large amounts of text information must be coded into predefined categories before the data can be analysed and published. This coding work is repetitive, labour-intensive and increasingly difficult to sustain as digitisation expands the volume of incoming textual material.

name: Machine learning increases biotechnological protein production
desc: Biotechnological production of proteins, such as those used in vaccines and therapeutics, is complex and sensitive to numerous biological and process variables, making yield optimisation challenging.

name: Machine translation service of the justice system - Developing translation memory
authority: Ministerium der Justiz und für Europa (JUM)
desc: In the judicial environment, legal texts in foreign languages must repeatedly be relevant and then translated at short notice. Existing offers of large platforms are not usable due to the lack of quality and data protection.

name: Mission KI - Museum-exhibition services
authority: Deutsches Museum von Meistwerken der Naturwissenschaft und Technik (AdöR)
desc: The German Museum Bonn initiated the Mission KI project to enhance public understanding of artificial intelligence through interactive exhibition installations. As part of a thematic reorientation of its AI forum, the museum sought to demonstrate the functioning of artificial neural networks in an accessible manner.

name: MoCaB - Reliable mobile support for caring relatives
authority: Peter L. Reichertz Institute for Medical Informatics
desc: Caring relatives often face complex daily coordination tasks, emotional strain and limited access to tailored nursing knowledge while supporting family members in need of care.

name: Monitoring biological diversity in agricultural landscapes with remote sensing
desc: Maintaining and enhancing biodiversity in agricultural landscapes is a central objective of agri-environment-climate measures under the EU Common Agricultural Policy.

name: Movi-Q – optimize visual quality controls intelligently
authority: DIL German Institute for Food Technologye
desc: The Movi-Q project worked on a mobile system for automatic quality detection of fruit and vegetables in order to optimise processing processes. In fact, in the food industry, a wide variety of natural products are processed, many of which are unusable for further processing or sale due to defects.

name: Municipality Welcome Manager (L2B2 Service Robot) in Ludwigsburg
desc: First Information and guide for citizens visiting the Service Department: The digital helper named "L2B2" welcomes in the entrance area of the Bürgerbüros, drives independently through the corridors and accompanies the visitors to the respective departments.

name: Municipality of Cologne improves the accuracy of its wastewater taxation system with a geospatial AI system
desc: Köln's wastewater authority previously used manual inspections and self-reports to identify impervious surfaces for taxation. Municipal officials worked with Hexagon on a GeoAI platform using components from Leica and Melown Technologies.

name: MÖVE: Benchmarking of Language Models for Public Administration
authority: Bundesdruckerei Group – Federal AI Competence Center
desc: Public administrations face growing pressure to adopt language technologies while ensuring reliability, fairness and regulatory compliance. Decision-makers often lack objective criteria to compare available models for administrative use.

name: NOcsPS (Agriculture 4.0 without chemical-synthetic crop protection)
authority: Georg-August University of Göttingen (UGOE) and Julius Kühn Institute (JKI
desc: Agricultural scientists from the University of Hohenheim, the Georg-August University of Göttingen (UGOE) and the Julius Kühn Institute (JKI) are working on a cultivation system that sensibly combines organic and conventional farming with the help of artificial intelligence.

name: National Initiative for AI-based Transformation in the Data Economy - NITD
authority: acatech - German Academy of Engineering Sciences
desc: Germany seeks to strengthen its position in the European data economy by improving interoperability, governance and trust in data-driven innovation. Fragmented data ecosystems and inconsistent standards can hinder cross-sector collaboration and scalable digital services.

name: Networked LiDAR bus for safe autonomous use in shared spaces - LiDARshared
desc: Urban authorities require detailed and up-to-date traffic data to manage complex shared spaces safely, particularly in dense city centres where interactions between vehicles, cyclists and pedestrians are frequent.

name: NeuraBot - Chabot for German municipal citizen services
authority: Stadt Bergisch Gladbach, Gemeinde Niederkruchten and others
desc: Municipalities receive large volumes of routine enquiries related to administrative procedures, events, and general city information, often overwhelming staff and limiting service availability outside office hours. NeuraBot addresses this challenge by providing continuous, multilingual digital assistance to citizens.

name: Neuropolis - Information System rethought in the City of Freiburg
desc: City councils manage vast collections of documents, minutes, and resolutions, making it difficult and time-consuming for staff to locate relevant information for informed decision-making. In Freiburg, this challenge affected efficiency and transparency in administrative work.

name: Notification procedure - Automatic control of accident occurring at the workplace
authority: Employer's Liability Insurance Association for Energy, Textiles, Electrical and Media Products (BG ETEM)
desc: When an accident at work, or on the journey to or from work, is caused by a third party, the Employer’s Liability Insurance Association must assess whether recourse proceedings against that third party are likely to succeed.

name: Open Mobility Electrical Infrastructure - OMEI
authority: University of Applied Sciences Energy Technology Center (TZE)
desc: The expansion of electromobility requires coordinated planning of charging infrastructure, integration of renewable energy, and efficient management of energy flows across regions. Fragmented data and incompatible systems currently limit optimisation of charging networks and energy use.

name: OpenGPT-X - 35 GenAI usecases
desc: Europe faces a strategic need for large language models and related infrastructure that are developed within its own technical, regulatory, and linguistic context rather than relying only on external providers.

name: OpenGPT-X project to create a LLM "Made in Germany"
desc: OpenGPT-X was launched to strengthen Europe’s capacity in generative-language technologies by developing a large language model ecosystem rooted in German and European research, industrial capability and trusted data environments.

name: PLAIN: a data analysis platform for the entire German federal administration
authority: Bundesdruckerei Group – Federal AI Competence Center
desc: Effective public policy increasingly depends on the ability to analyse large and heterogeneous datasets across institutional boundaries. Federal ministries often lack a shared infrastructure to support advanced data analysis securely.

name: PRE-VIEW - Identification of international crisis
desc: The Federal Foreign Office uses the data analytics tool PRE- VIEW– Prediction, Visualization, Early Warning (Auswärtiges Amt, 2019) to identify evolving international crises.

name: PRECOBS - Predictive policing in German administrations
authority: Baden Wurttemberg, Hesse,  Berlin and  North Rhine-Westphalia
desc: In Bavaria, the tool PRECOBS (Institut für musterbasierte Prognosetechnik, 2018) calculates where burglaries are most likely to occur, however, the same software was discontinued in Baden Wurttemberg in 2019 due to data quality issues (Mayer, 2019).

name: Pepper robot as an examination assistant and source of information
authority: Technical University of Applied Sciences Wildau
desc: Pepper at TH Wildau is a deployed library assistant, based on SoftBank’s humanoid platform and the NAOqi software stack. The project adapts Pepper for a 24/7 academic library, where access is card-controlled outside staffed hours.

name: PhenoRob proejct - Fertilise crops more specifically
desc: Researchers at the University of Bonn and the Research Center Jülich want to use AI methods and robotics to show ways towards a sustainable agricultural economy. The Cluster of Excellence PhenoRob researches more resource-efficient and sustainable production of crops.

name: Pilot project to support the future development of photos with AI
desc: Municipal archives often hold vast photographic collections that are difficult to index and search due to limited metadata and manual cataloguing processes. The Heilbronn City Archive launched this pilot to improve access to its digital photo collections and enrich historical documentation.

name: Planning and execution for a mobile indoor robot
authority: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence
desc: The goal of this use-case is to explore and demonstrate how task planning and execution can be used to control a mobile robot for manipulation tasks in an indoor environment.

name: Practical, Learning-Based Tools for Finding and Fixing Bugs
desc: Software defects cause system failures, security vulnerabilities and financial losses, yet traditional static analysis and rule-based tools often miss complex or context-dependent errors.

name: Project ML-SAST - Machine Learning in the Context of Static Application Security Testing
desc: The Federal Office for Information Security launched the ML-SAST project to address a pressing software-security problem: identifying vulnerabilities and coding errors early enough in the development process to reduce remediation effort, shorten delivery times and improve the overall security of software systems.

name: Project ROMATRIS
desc: Project ROMATRIS responds to a practical problem in emergency response: transporting essential materials through difficult or obstructed terrain during rescue operations.

name: RADAAR-iTE Predictive policing - risk assessment of militant Salafitsts
desc: Since 2017, the Bundeskriminalamt (Federal Crime Agency, BKA) has used the risk-assessment tool RADAR-iTE (Bundeskriminalamt, 2017) to sort “militant Salafists” into three threat levels (high, conspicuous, and moderate).

name: RADAR-rechts | Assessing the risk of violence by far-right extremists
desc: Following a series of fatal right-wing extremist attacks in Germany in 2019 and 2020, federal and state law enforcement authorities faced increasing pressure to strengthen the prevention of politically motivated violent crime.

name: RECAP - Reliable Capacity Provisioning and Enhanced Remediation for Distributed Cloud Applications
desc: The Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) presents a number of challenges for the control of Cross Compliance rules due to the complexity and diversity of the obligations to be monitored.

name: RehaPlus: AI-Powered Identification of Complex Rehabilitation Cases in Public Health Insurance
authority: Berufsgenossenschaft Energie Textil Elektro Medienerzeugnisse (BG ETEM)
desc: The statutory accident insurer BG ETEM introduced RehaPlus to improve the early identification of complex rehabilitation cases requiring intensive case management. Previously, such cases were often detected late through manual reminders, leading to delayed interventions, higher treatment costs and longer recovery…

name: RenovAlte - Resilient planning and design of renovation projects
desc: Building renovation projects frequently encounter delays, cost overruns and vulnerability to changing environmental conditions, undermining long-term sustainability objectives.

name: RoLand - how to achieve low-cost automation in agriculture
authority: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence
desc: The aim of the project is to design and develop a semi-autonomous, mobile system that is able to harvest fruit independently.

name: Rüsselsheim am Main enforces truck ban with AI to abate pollution
desc: Local officials enacted a ban on trucks weighing 7.5 tons or more originating outside of city limits. Sixteen sensors were installed on street lights along roads entering and exiting Rüsselsheim am Main. An AI-enabled platform distinguishes overweight trucks from other vehicles using anonymized data.

name: SEMMI - Avatar
desc: Deutsche Bahn developed SEMMI Avatar to enhance customer service interactions in stations and other service environments by providing an engaging digital interface capable of handling routine enquiries.

name: SEMMI - Hotline
desc: High call volumes and repetitive enquiries place significant strain on customer service centres, leading to long waiting times and rising staffing costs.

name: SEMMI - Robot
desc: Customer-facing organisations often struggle to provide multilingual, consistent and accessible front-office support, particularly in high-traffic environments such as transport hubs or service centres.

name: SUMM AI - Creating accessible information: End to end automated with AI
desc: Public administrations are increasingly expected to provide information that is not only accurate and timely, but also easy to understand and accessible to people with different communication needs.

name: Sat4GWR_IF-Bund – Remote sensing & AI for the register census
desc: Maintaining an accurate and up-to-date register of buildings and dwellings is essential for population statistics, spatial planning, and evidence-based policymaking.

name: Shuttle model region Upper Franconia II - SMO-II
desc: Public transport providers in rural and semi-rural regions face growing pressure to offer flexible, reliable, and cost-efficient mobility services despite low passenger density and challenging operating conditions.

name: Signals - Detection of statistically significant clusters in reported infectious diseases
desc: Germany's disease surveillance system required methods to identify unusual patterns in reported infections that might indicate emerging outbreaks, requiring analysis of large volumes of routine surveillance data against expected baselines.

name: Silicon Economy Logistics Ecosystem - SELE
authority: Fraunhofer Institute for Material Flow and Logistics IML, Dortmund
desc: Fragmented digital systems and limited interoperability hinder efficiency and innovation in logistics and supply chain management. The SELE project sought to establish an open-source infrastructure and shared technical components to support a platform-based logistics ecosystem.

name: Skala - Predictive policing
authority: State Criminal Police Office (LKA) of North Rhine-Westphalia
desc: Police forces must decide how to deploy limited patrol and prevention resources across large territories, yet burglary and related offences often occur in patterns that are difficult to anticipate through manual analysis alone.

name: Smart Urban Logistics through Electrification Collaboration and Automation - SULEICA
desc: Urban freight transport contributes to congestion, emissions and reduced quality of life, prompting cities to seek cleaner and more efficient logistics models.

name: Smart control center for automated transport robots and buses in the city of Lauenburg/Elbe - TaBuLa-LOGplus
desc: Integrating passenger and goods transport through automated systems requires coordinated fleet management and reliable operational oversight. The TaBuLa-LOGplus project aimed to implement a prototypical control centre to enable efficient combined transport services in Lauenburg/Elbe.

name: Sovereign AI for Public Administration in Germany
desc: Germany has announced a strategic public–private partnership with Mistral AI and SAP SE to develop and deploy a “sovereign AI” infrastructure tailored for public administrations.

name: Steuerchatbot
desc: Tax administrations receive large numbers of routine questions about declarations, deadlines, and procedures, and handling these enquiries manually can consume staff time that could otherwise be used for more complex taxpayer support.

name: Study certificates - Automatic recognition for applying for child benefit
desc: Family benefits offices in Germany face a recurring administrative burden because, to maintain eligibility for child benefit, a student’s current certificate of enrolment must be submitted twice a year.

name: Suicide Prevention in Jail - Detecting of suspicious objects in a cell
authority: Ministry of Justice of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia
desc: In 2019, the Ministry of Justice of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia launched a program aimed at preventing suicide in jail.

name: Support the integration of job seekers with artificial intelligence
desc: The University of Applied Sciences Kiel, in collaboration with Jobcenter Kiel and the Institute for Labour Market and Vocational Research, is developing tools to improve the integration of job seekers into the labour market.

name: TWIN4ROAD@Essen: AI-based analysis and forecast
desc: Managing Germany’s extensive road network requires continuous assessment of pavement condition and infrastructure assets, yet the volume and complexity of data make manual evaluation inefficient and costly.

name: Trade statistics - Classification system that automatically new data points as relevant
desc: This use case was developed to improve the production of official trade statistics by automating the initial classification of incoming units, such as craft enterprises, as relevant or not relevant for inclusion in the statistical process.

name: Trustworthiness platform for AI solutions and data rooms - TrustKI
desc: Manufacturing companies increasingly rely on data-driven solutions and shared data spaces, yet potential users often lack transparent criteria to assess organisational reliability and the robustness of digital solutions.

name: Urban Cockpit - a digital twin of Bad Hersfeld
desc: The municipality of Bad Hersfeld developed the Urban Cockpit as a publicly accessible digital twin to increase transparency and improve urban management. The objective was to aggregate heterogeneous municipal data into a single visual platform supporting informed decision-making and citizen engagement.

name: Urban Intelligence-as-a-Service model for smart lighting upgrade
desc: The UlaaS model allows Bad Hersfeld and Urban Lighting Innovations to integrate smart technologies into a unified system. New LED lighting fixtures across the community are connected to sensors that gather data on temperature, noise levels, and traffic.

name: WELCOME(Multiple Intelligent Conversation Agent Services for Reception, Management and Integration)
desc: WELCOME (Multiple Intelligent Conversation Agent Services for Reception, Management and Integration of Third Country Nationals in the EU) aims to research and develop intelligent technologies for support of the reception and integration of migrants and refugees in Europe.

name: WeGovNow: Collective and participative approaches for addressing local policy challenges
authority: Empirica Gesellschaft für Kommunikations- & Technologieforschung mbH.
desc: Citizens are partners, and not customers in the delivery of public services. Bearing this in mind, the WeGovNow project team tapped into emerging technologies to support co-production by civil society stakeholders in the delivery of public services.

name: Wearable exoskeleton for stroke patients
desc: In recent years, the Robotics Innovation Center of the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI) in Bremen has developed a mobile whole-body exoskeleton for patients with neurological diseases in its Recupera REHA project. This offers you expanded and innovative therapy options.

name: Weather-independent and highly automated ridesharing service in Kelheim (Germany)
desc: Rural and semi-urban districts such as Kelheim face challenges in providing reliable and affordable public transport, particularly under adverse weather conditions that affect automated vehicle performance.

name: WeedAI – promoting non-chemical weed control in sugar beet cultivation
authority: Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn, Faculty of Agriculture, Institute for Agricultural Engineering
desc: The importance of novel methods for weed control is rapidly growing, however, evaluating the effectiveness of these technologies is lacking. Weed AI is working on methods to rapidly and autonomously evaluate the efficacy of weeding systems.

name: X-PIDER - an electonic investigative tool in the field of e-commerce used by the German tax authorities
desc: Tax authorities face growing challenges detecting undeclared economic activity as commerce increasingly moves online. Traditional audit methods cannot efficiently monitor the vast volume of internet commercial activity, creating opportunities for tax evasion through e-commerce platforms and social media.

name: mAInZaun – the intelligent fence that recognizes animal species
authority: Justus Liebig University Giessen, Institute for Animal Breeding and Domestic Animal Genetics
desc: The project, developed by the Universities of Bremen and Giessen and the company RoFlexs, aimed to develop an electric fence that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to detect and drive away predators, and, thus, better protect grasing animals.

name: “Demenzwegweiser-SH” (Schleswig-Holstein Guide to Dementia)
authority: Ministry of Social Affairs, Youth, Family, Senior Citizens, Integration and Equality of Schleswig-Holstein
desc: Demenzwegweiser-SH was created to centralise and maintain up-to-date information on dementia-related services across Schleswig-Holstein. Individuals and families often struggle to identify regional counselling centres, specialist doctors, care options and support services.

name: AI Chatbot in the City of Athens
desc: The City of Athens implemented an AI-powered search engine and digital agent on its official website to improve access to municipal services.

name: AI to increase the efficiency of fiscal audit at the Greek General Directorate of Financial Controls (GDDE)
desc: Public financial oversight bodies face limited resources and cannot audit all government entities annually, increasing the risk of inefficiency, fraud, and corruption. Greece’s General Directorate of Financial Controls sought to improve audit coverage and effectiveness.

name: AI-enabled healthcare services during cross-border medical emergencies and regular patient services
desc: Healthcare systems face increasing strain when managing medical emergencies across borders and ensuring continuity of care for mobile populations, while also improving routine patient services. Differences in systems, data availability, and coordination can hinder timely and effective treatment.

name: AI4EU-AI4Media
authority: Centre for Research and Technology Hellas (CERTH)
desc: A Network of Research Excellence Centres delivering advances in AI Technology in the Media sector, funded under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme, the project aspires to become a Centre of Excellence engaging a wide network of researchers across Europe and beyond, focusing on…

name: AI4EU-AICopernicus
authority: National Center for Scientific Research Demokritos
desc: AI4Copernicus is a European H2020 project that aims to bridge Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Earth Observation (EO) world by making the already developed AI4EU AI-on-demand platform, the digital environment of choice for users of Copernicus data, for researchers and innovators.

name: AI4Gov - Trusted AI for Transparent Public Governance in Transport (Greece - Pilot1)
desc: Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni (VVV) is a municipality in eastern Attica with 50,585 residents and a significant influx of seasonal and weekend visitors drawn to its coastline, cultural sites, and events.

name: AI4Gov - Trusted AI for Transparent Public Governance in Waste Management (Greece - Pilot2)
desc: Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni (VVV) is a municipality in eastern Attica with 50,585 residents and a significant influx of seasonal and weekend visitors drawn to its coastline, cultural sites, and events.

name: ANPR Greece
desc: Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras were introduced in 2019. 50 Hellenic police vehicles are equipped with such cameras and they are capable of detecting the license plates of stolen vehicles or vehicles used in criminal activities.

name: ARISE - Advanced AI and RobotIcS for autonomous task pErformance
authority: Twi Ellas Astiki Mi Kerdoskopiki Etaireia
desc: Labour shortages and hazardous conditions in sectors such as renewable energy and agriculture create demand for adaptable robotic systems capable of performing complex tasks autonomously.

name: AVINT Trikala - Integration of a line of automated buses
desc: Trikala city is part of the AVINT (“Autonomous vehicles integrated within the urban context”). Tjos is a project set up to study urban transport in Trikala. It will integrate a line of automated buses – three buses in total, carrying 10 passengers each – into the city’s transportation network.

name: Assisted Living and Safe Aging Services in the Region of Central Macedonia (Greece)
desc: The service includes the 24-hour monitoring of the elderly through special devices such as home monitoring devices with fall detection and panic buttons, outdoor tracking, and locator devices which are given to the elderly and installed in their homes.

name: CENTAUR - Greek camps for asylum seekers surveillance systems
desc: Reception and identification centres for asylum seekers in Greece face operational challenges related to security management, overcrowding and incident prevention. The Greek Ministry of Migration and Asylum introduced surveillance infrastructure to enhance safety within camps and monitor potential unlawful activities.

name: CERTH-MUKA - Public Organizations Multi-factor Misinformation Handling
desc: In the municipality of Katerini, the challenge addressed by this use case is the growing need to identify misleading information quickly and to prioritise emerging issues before they create operational, reputational or social harm.

name: Chatbot Poseidon - Municipality of Palaio Faliro
desc: Poseidon Chatbot is the virtual assistant featured on the official website of the Municipality of Palaio Faliro. It helps residents and visitors access information about municipal services, local procedures, public facilities, events, and community resources.

name: DELPHI - Coordinated mobility for passengers and freight - Attika Use Case
desc: Freight movement in the Athens metropolitan area is heavily affected by congestion on the Attiki Odos ring road, yet road and metro systems currently operate as separate domains with limited real-time coordination.

name: DELPHI - Coordinated mobility for passengers and freight - Mykonos use case
desc: Public spaces are often designed according to planning assumptions that do not fully reflect how people actually move, stop, interact and spend time in the urban environment.

name: Digital Doctor Assistant
desc: The Greek government has launched an AI‑powered tool known as Digital Doctor Assistant, now available to doctors through the national electronic health record system.

name: Dryads - AI-powered platform to manage forest resilience and mitigate climate change impacts
desc: Dryads is an AI-powered environmental monitoring platform developed by the SCAN Laboratory at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens in cooperation with the Hellenic Ministry of Environment and Energy.

name: EKOME Greece - chatbot
authority: National Centre of Audiovisual Media and Communication
desc: The EKOME chatbot is a digital assistant integrated into the official website of Greece’s National Centre of Audiovisual Media and Communication, providing users with immediate answers to general enquiries about the organisation’s services and activities.

name: Efficient and targeted COVID-19 border testing via reinforcement learning
authority: Department of Hygiene and Epidemiology - University of Thessaly
desc: Here we report the design and performance of a reinforcement learning system, nicknamed ‘Eva’. In the summer of 2020, Eva was deployed across all Greek borders to limit the influx of asymptomatic travellers infected with SARS-CoV-2, and to inform border policies through real-time estimates of COVID-19 prevalence.

name: GREEN-LOG Last-Mile Digital Control Tower: An AI-Driven Platform for Real-Time Optimisation and Sustainable Urban Logistics
desc: The GREEN-LOG Last-Mile Digital Control Tower (DCT), developed as part of the EU co-funded GREEN-LOG project, addresses the growing challenges of urban last-mile logistics driven by e-commerce expansion.

name: Greek Government and Sword Health team up for AI-driven initiative
desc: The Greek government has partnered with Sword Health to launch an AI‑driven healthcare initiative that seeks to modernise how citizens access care.

name: LEGAL-BERT: The Muppets straight out of Law School
authority: Athens university of economics and business
desc: BERT has achieved impressive performance in several NLP tasks. However, there has been limited investigation on its adaptation guidelines in specialised domains. Here we focus on the legal domain, where we explore several approaches for applying BERT models to downstream legal tasks, evaluating on multiple datasets.

name: MetaCities Excellence Hub in South-Eastern Europe
desc: Cities and regions in South-Eastern Europe face shared challenges related to sustainable mobility, green urban development, and digital transformation, but often lack the coordinated innovation ecosystems needed to scale advanced solutions.

name: MitosLOD: Exporting Linked Open Data from the Greek National Registry of Administrative Public Services
authority: Ministry of Digital Governance and Ministry of Interior
desc: The MitosLOD project has successfully integrated Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to develop advanced semantic search capabilities, significantly enhancing the functionality and user experience of the Greek National Registry of Administrative Public Services (MITOS).

name: Municipality of Palaio Faliro: Development of IOT Platform - Energy Upgrade
desc: The goal of this project is the development of a centralized IOT management platform with the ability to control, record and analyze power consumption data and other resources in buildings and other infrastructures of the Municipality of Palaio Faliro.

name: NADINE -  platform to promote migrant inclusion
desc: NADINE is a platform to promote migrant inclusion. It aims to harness the potential of big data and Artificial Intelligence to better understand the supply and demand of skills brought to Europe through migration.

name: OpenAI For Greece - ChatGPT Edu in Secondary Education
desc: The OpenAI for Greece education initiative aims to strengthen digital skills and prepare students for an AI-driven future by integrating artificial intelligence into the national education system. The program focuses on building foundational AI literacy while ensuring responsible and ethical use in academic settings.

name: OpenAI For Greece - Greek AI Accelerator to support local AI‑focused start‑ups
desc: The OpenAI for Greece startup accelerator is designed to boost innovation and economic growth by supporting the development of AI-driven businesses. It aims to position Greece as a competitive hub for artificial intelligence by nurturing local talent and connecting startups to global opportunities.

name: OpenGovIntelligence (Fostering Innovation and Creativity in EU through Pub Administration Modernization)
desc: The OpenGovIntelligence project ran pilot studies in six countries to exploit Linked Open Statistical Data (LOSD) technologies aimed at modernising public administrations.

name: Pharos AI Factory
authority: GRNET (National Infrastructures for Research and Technology)
desc: The Pharos AI Factory is Greece’s national AI initiative, launched on 1 April 2025 as part of the EuroHPC AI Factories programme.

name: ROBORDER project
desc: The Center for Research and Technology Hellas (ITI/CERTH), the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (UoA), and the Hellenic Ministry of Defense participate in the research project consortium ROBORDER (“autonomous swarm of heterogeneous RObots for BORDER surveillance”).

name: SPIRIT - Scalable privacy preserving intelligence analysis for resolving identities
desc: SPIRIT – Scalable Privacy Preserving Intelligence Analysis for Resolving Identities aims to enhance criminal investigations by enabling authorities to correlate fragmented information across multiple digital sources while addressing privacy considerations.

name: SPIRIT predictive policing  - privacy-preserving intelligence analysis for resolving identities
desc: Hellenic Police and four other law enforcement authorities (i.e.

name: Smart policing software - Development an integrated information system for police
authority: Hellenic Police and the Hellenic Ministry of Citizen Protection
desc: Intracom Telecom, a global telecommunication systems and solutions vendor, signed a four million euro contract with the Hellenic Police and the Hellenic Ministry of Citizen Protection for the development of “Smart Policing” software.

name: TRACY: A big-data analytics platform for law enforcement investigations
desc: The TRACY project was implemented to address the growing need for secure, efficient, and interoperable use of electronic communications metadata in the investigation of serious and organised crime across EU Member States.

name: Titormos - the citizens assist chatbot in the Municipality of Agrinio
desc: Titormos addresses limited accessibility and inefficiencies in citizen engagement with municipal services, where requests could previously only be submitted via phone during restricted hours. This constrained responsiveness and excluded citizens with limited availability or access to traditional channels.

name: mAIGreece - the digital AI assistant for visitors
desc: The mAiGreece platform is a digital AI assistant launched by the Greek Ministry of Tourism in collaboration with the Ministry of Digital Governance to enhance services for visitors to Greece.

name: mAIgov - AI-powered digital assistant of Greece's unified public administration portal
desc: mAigov is an AI-powered digital assistant integrated into Greece's unified public administration portal, gov.gr. Launched in December 2023 by the Ministry of Digital Governance, mAigov aims to streamline citizens' interactions with public services by simplifying access to information and procedures.

name: ‘Outpost’ autonomous towers to monitor Greek islands for threats
desc: Utpost uses artificial intelligence for geo-locating, classifying and tracking a wide-range of threats including persons, drones, vessels, aircraft, vehicles, and smoke piles, according to manufacturer Lambda Automata.

name: ADVANCE - Advanced predictive-analysis-based decision-support engine for logistics
authority: Institute for Computer Science and Control
desc: ADVANCE tried to develop an innovative predictive-analysis-based decision support platform for novel competitive strategies in logistics operations. It provided a dual perspective on transport requirements and decision making dependent on the latest snapshot information and the best higher-level intelligence.

name: AI technology speeds up historical image handling at Hungary's National Archive
desc: Hungary’s National Audiovisual Archive (NAVA) faced the challenge of organising and preserving millions of historical images and audiovisual records forming the country’s twentieth-century cultural memory. Manual classification was slow, costly, and unable to keep pace with digitisation efforts.

name: Algorithm to detect fraud at the National Tax Authority in Hungary
desc: Tax administrations face increasing challenges in detecting complex and evolving forms of tax fraud while ensuring compliance with strict data protection and transparency requirements.

name: Anomaly detection in e-government administration
desc: In Hungary, government administration relies on numerous critical digital services. To ensure their reliability and availability, various machine learning techniques are being introduced. The primary goal is to maintain the smooth operation of a large number of services while minimising the risk of service disruptions.

name: BrAIn – BRinging Artificial INtelligence towards SMEs
desc: The BrAIn – BRinging Artificial INtelligence towards SMEs project aims to support the sustainable and human-centric development of SMEs in the Danube Region by transferring AI and Industry 4.0 (i4.0) technologies.

name: DONNA: A digital assistant for IT operations
desc: DONNA is a digital assistant designed to enhance IT operations within public administration, targeting critical services such as vehicle registration and identity card issuance.

name: Decision on the Maternity Benefit (TÉBA) - The Family Support Scheme of the Hungarian State Treasury
desc: The Hungarian State Treasury introduced the TÉBA system to address a structural administrative problem in family support: benefits such as family and disability allowances were managed across different databases and processes, making it harder to deliver a unified, efficient and citizen-centred service.

name: Home Quarantine App - Supporting the use of electronic control for home quarantine
desc: In early May 2020, a government decree enabled the use of electronic control to support home quarantine, responding to the practical challenge of monitoring compliance during the COVID-19 pandemic without relying solely on manual enforcement.

name: Speech recognition and transcription
desc: The project examines how the National Office for the Judiciary in Hungary (HU) could implement speech-recognition and transcription software in its courts. By automatically converting court proceedings into text, it aims to accelerate the creation of judicial decisions and minutes.

name: URBANITE - AI-driven insights to optimise public transport systems
desc: Public-transport planning has often depended on surveys and interviews, which are valuable but slow, expensive and limited in their ability to capture real, constantly changing mobility patterns across a city.

name: Véda-KAFIR-ROBOTZSARU (‘Robocop’) - System Operated by the Police for Traffic Safety Automated Processing
desc: Hungary’s road-safety enforcement authorities needed a faster and more integrated way to process large volumes of traffic violations with minimal delay and consistent evidential handling.

name: Water Network Monitoring
