desc: Ensuring reliable water supply and minimising losses is particularly challenging in areas with limited infrastructure and remote pumping stations. In Tápióság, Hungary, water utilities required better visibility of network performance without continuous on-site supervision.

name: Better Reykjavik
desc: Cities need practical ways to involve residents in shaping local priorities, yet traditional consultation methods often struggle to attract broad participation or turn large volumes of public input into useful policy signals.

name: How Iceland is using GPT-4 to preserve its language
authority: Language Planning Department of the Government of Iceland
desc: Small language communities face risks of digital marginalisation when advanced language technologies are predominantly trained on high-resource languages. Iceland sought to ensure that its national language remains represented and usable in emerging digital services.

name: Smart Street Lighting
desc: Urban lighting represents a major source of energy consumption and maintenance costs for municipalities. Hafnarfjörður sought to modernise its lighting infrastructure to improve efficiency and safety. The objective of this pilot is to enable adaptive, data-driven lighting management.

name: Aeolus – Mid-altitude maritime monitoring platform for security, search & rescue and environmental monitoring
desc: Maritime authorities require wide-area surveillance to address security threats, coordinate search and rescue operations and monitor environmental risks, yet conventional ship-based sensors have limited range constrained by low elevation.

name: Air quality sensors in Trim (Ireland)
desc: The Meath County Council installed quality sensors in a number of locations in Trim, with a dashboard subsequently being made available for the general public to view real-time data from the sensors.

name: Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR)
desc: The project concerns deployment of Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) technology by the Department of Justice and Equality in Ireland (IE). Using optical character recognition initially, and later augmented with artificial intelligence, the system automatically reads and records vehicle registration plates.

name: DPER Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Pilot
authority: Department of Public Expenditure and Reform
desc: During 2017, the Department of Public Expenditure and Reform (DPER) ran a pilot study in RPA where four Government Departments selected some routine, stable and completely computer based processes for the purpose of exploring the efficiencies to be gained by automating this work using RPA.

name: Dublin City Council accelerates the potential of drones across Ireland
desc: Local authorities increasingly recognise the potential of unmanned aerial vehicles to support public services, yet fragmented regulation, limited operational experience and lack of shared standards have slowed adoption.

name: Dublin City Council and OpenAI Announce Partnership to Show the Potential of AI to Support Europe’s Tourism Industry
desc: Tourism authorities aim to enhance visitor experiences by providing personalised, engaging recommendations that go beyond static guides. Dublin sought to demonstrate how advanced language technologies could support tailored travel planning.

name: Dublin to host AI-powered e-scooter research project
desc: Dublin faces growing challenges in managing shared micro-mobility services, particularly e-scooters, as their rapid adoption raises concerns around road safety, pavement congestion, parking compliance, and integration with existing transport systems.

name: Evaluate the potential of facial matching technologies as an aid to the intelligence gathering process
desc: The aim of the project that was developed by the Irish Department of Justice and Equality in 2019 was to evaluate the potential of facial matching technologies as an aid to the intelligence gathering process, as part of a broader process whose aim is to introduce the use of innovative technologies in the justice field…

name: FAITH - monitoring mental health with Artificial Intelligence - IRELAND Pilot
desc: FAITH aims to provide an Artificial Intelligence application that identifies and analyses depression markers in people that have undergone cancer treatment. UPMC will be the main Irish pilot test trial site, focusing on breast cancer patients as the selected use case and target group for FAITH.

name: Gallery Visitor's AI Analysis
desc: Gallery Visitor’s AI Analysis responds to the Hugh Lane Gallery’s need to obtain accurate, non-intrusive insights into visitor numbers and movement patterns in order to improve exhibition planning, optimise spatial design and strengthen health and safety management.

name: GenAI-based chatbot to help the public access services on official websites
desc: The project, which began in January, aims to deliver a “chat agent” that would supply information to the public on business supports that are being provided by the Government.

name: Housing Assistance Payment Robotics Pilot
authority: Housing Assistance Payment Shared Service Centre
desc: Limerick City and County Council operate the Housing Assistance Payment Shared Service Centre (HAP SSC) on behalf of the local government sector and are continuously striving for ways to improve their business.

name: The Dublin Beat - Citizen opinion analysis
desc: Public authorities need to understand how residents feel about local issues, yet conventional consultation methods may not always capture timely shifts in public sentiment across a fast-changing urban environment.

name: VDA - Voicebot on calls from Irish taxpayer on tax clearance
desc: Tax administrations receive large volumes of routine telephone enquiries, and many callers seek straightforward information that can be difficult to provide efficiently through human operators alone, especially during peak demand periods.

name: Virtual Digital Assistant with the Revenue Commissioners of Ireland
desc: The Revenue Commissioners of Ireland handle large volumes of telephone enquiries related to tax clearance certificates, creating operational pressure and delays for both staff and taxpayers. Many of these requests are repetitive and transactional in nature.

name: "Chatta col David" - Chatbot on the Galleria dell'Accademia di Firenze website
desc: The chatbot answers questions and information on Michelangelo's David statue.

name: "INPS risponde" - Optimised management of web requests to Customer Service
desc: One of the channels by which citizens can communicate with INPS is via the web with the "INPS Risponde" service, which receives more than 2.5 million communications annually.

name: 3DAI City Mobile Application - AI for Road Maintenance
desc: MM Spa introduced the 3DAI City mobile application to address a practical infrastructure-management problem: maintaining Milan’s roads more efficiently by identifying defects earlier and improving the quality of maintenance planning.

name: A Public Administration Canvas for Ethical AI implementation
desc: Public administrations often need structured help to assess legal, ethical, organisational, and technical issues before adopting AI, especially under evolving European regulatory requirements.

name: ADRYX - Chatbot for real-time flight updates

name: AI Applications within INAIL
authority: Italian National Institute for Insurance against Accidents at Work (INAIL)
desc: A large public insurance and prevention body such as INAIL must manage diverse tasks ranging from workplace-accident prevention and grant administration to customer service, medical evaluation, fraud control, and legal support, all under strong regulatory and public-value constraints.

name: AI-SCORE, a project to calculate prognostic risk from Covid-19
desc: The AI-SCORE project (Artificial Intelligence – SARS-CoV-2 Risk Evaluation) is an Italian research initiative led by IRCCS San Raffaele Hospital in Milan, developed in collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

name: AI-Traffic solutions used in multiple Italian public administrations to monitor traffic
authority: City of Afragola, City of Bari and others

name: AI-assisted diagnostic and rehabilitative tools for personalised support of children with cerebral palsy
desc: Unilateral cerebral palsy (UCP) is the most common chronic neurological condition. name: AI-based device for parkinson patients

name: AI-based model to track the impact of the climate crisis on glacial resources
desc: Glaciers are critical natural resources and indicators of climate change, yet monitoring their evolution at scale remains complex, resource-intensive, and fragmented.

name: AI-for-Covid Predictive diagnostics made in Italy
authority: Hospital Centro Diagnostico Italiano di Milano
desc: During the Covid-19 pandemic, hospitals faced significant pressure to rapidly assess newly admitted patients and prioritise clinical resources.

name: AI-powered Linguistic Mediator: A Phygital Solution for Inclusive and Accessible Public Services at INAIL

name: AI-powered virtual assistant for payments
desc: The PagoPA AI support project is an initiative launched in February 2025 by PagoPA S.p.A., the Italian public company behind the national digital payment platform pagoPA and related citizen services such as the IO app.

name: AI-powered “Gestore Emendamenti” (GEM) at the Italian Senate

name: ARISTOTELES - Applying ARtificial Intelligence to Define clinical trajectorieS for personalized predicTiOn and early deTEctiOn of comorbidiTy and muLtimorbidiTy pattErnS
authority: Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia
desc: Patients with atrial fibrillation and other complex conditions often experience fragmented care due to coexisting diseases, delayed diagnosis, and lack of personalised risk assessment, leading to avoidable hospitalisations and increased mortality.

name: Acquedotto 4.0, Hera invests in artificial intelligence
authority: Municipalities of Santarcangelo di Romagna, Riccione and Cattolica
desc: Water utilities face significant challenges in maintaining ageing distribution networks, where undetected leaks can lead to water loss, infrastructure damage, and costly, disruptive repairs.

desc: This chatbot is intended to share information regarding the Coronavirus. All data are taken from the website of the Ministry of Health http://www.salute.gov.it/nuovocoronavirus

name: Ministry of Labour and Social Policies chatbot
authority: Ministry of Labour and Social Policies
desc: The chatbot replies to general enquiries from citizens in relation to social policies, such as the "bonus trasporti" (Italian citizens could apply for a cash benefit of maximum 60 euros to buy transportation monthly passes).

name: Mobilità Integrata Trentino Trasporti (MITT)
authority: Provincia autonoma di Trento - Trentino Trasporti (in house)
desc: The MITT makes it possible to optimize the management of the provincial public transport system in such a way as to offer a better and more effective service to the citizen.

name: Modello Italia, the first Italian Foundational Large Language Model
desc: European public administrations and enterprises require advanced language technologies aligned with national regulatory, privacy and security standards. Dependence on externally developed models may raise concerns regarding data sovereignty and compliance.

name: Municipality of Messina pilots  the Recycleye robot to select garbage and improve reciclying
desc: Messinaservizi Bene Comune partnered with Recycleye to deploy an AI-managed robotic waste sorting system at the Pace sorting centre, the first of its kind in Sicily. Municipal waste management requires precise separation of materials to improve recycling rates and reduce landfill reliance.

name: MyInail Chatbot - support tool for INAIL users
authority: Italian National Institute for Insurance against Accidents at Work (INAIL)
desc: The MyInail Chatbot provides users with guided, conversational support across INAIL’s wide range of services, from healthcare and financial benefits to prevention and training.

name: NORMA - virtual assistant for the analysis of legislative production
authority: Polytechnic University of Milan and the Einaudi Institute for Economics and Finance
desc: Accessing and interpreting parliamentary data can be complex, particularly when users need to navigate large volumes of legislative information spread across amendments, draft laws, procedural stages and official reports.

name: NUMEL.AI - A communication tool for neurological disorders
desc: Neurological disorders are often difficult for patients to understand due to the complexity of medical imaging and the abstract nature of diagnostic explanations.

name: Navigard: the future of road safety on Italian motorways
desc: Navigard is an advanced road safety platform developed collaboratively by Autostrade per l'Italia and the Italian State Police, aiming to revolutionise traffic monitoring and management on Italian highways.

name: New Web Analytics System on the INPS official website
desc: Large public sector websites often struggle to adapt content and interfaces to the real needs of users, particularly when services are complex and audiences diverse.

name: Noovle - Management of health documentation
desc: Healthcare systems produce vast quantities of clinical documentation, and important diagnostic information is often embedded in free-text discharge letters that are difficult to process consistently at scale.

name: PERKS - AI for industrial operational efficiency
desc: The PERKS project, co-funded by Horizon Europe, aims to enhance industrial operational efficiency by using AI to optimise procedural knowledge management in line with Industry 5.0. The initiative focuses on improving how industrial workers access and apply knowledge related to processes, safety, and energy management.

name: Piedmont harnesses AI to bring healthcare to every corner
desc: Piedmont is seeking to transform healthcare delivery through AI, with a focus on diagnostics, organisational efficiency, and telemedicine.

name: Pioneering Europe’s Future of Autonomous Urban Mobility
desc: Turin and the Piedmont region are positioning themselves at the forefront of autonomous driving in Europe.

name: Predicting Image Quality Degradation in Digital Radiology
authority: Azienda Provinciale per i Servizi Sanitari di Trento (APSS)
desc: Optimal design of medical x-ray imaging systems is essential for delivering maximum image quality while minimizing radiation risk to patients. The performances of imaging devices could degrade over time.

name: Predicting chronic pathologies and post-surgery complications
desc: In the city of Vimercate, in the Lombardy region of northern Italy, the local branch of the public health authority (Azienda Socio Sanitaria Territoriale, ASST) has adopted open source cloud solutions (developed by Almaviva) which use algorithms to predict the beginning of chronic pathologies and post-surgery…

name: Predictive Healthcare Assistance DB (BDA) in Regione Lombardia
desc: The evolution of the Assisted Database from a predictive point of view of the Region, which up to now has been involved in stratifying the Lombard population, according to their consumption, on 62 chronic pathologies for tracers, level of complexity, territory, gender, age group and assistance.

name: Predictive Jurisprudence - Tribunale di Pisa
authority: Tribunal of Pisa (and EMbeDS, KDD Lab)
desc: In 2019, the first experiment with automated decision-making within the justice system was developed at LIDER Lab Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna in collaboration with EMbeDS, KDD Lab and the Tribunal of Genoa (Gonews 2019).‎Predictive Justice is an ambitious long-term project built with an innovative approach and an…

name: Predictive justice - a database to provide predictable guidelines and timing in particular areas
desc: By means of this pilot project run in 2019, the aim of Brescia's Court of Appeal was to implement a jurisprudence database in order to provide predictions of guidelines and timing in particular areas of law. In terms of technology, the database used expert, rule-based systems and natural language processing.

name: Predictive maintenance for wind farms
desc: A service to minimize the damage suffered in the company by the downtime of a windpower machine and better manage the efficiency of the production process. This purpose is achieved thanks to software system for predictive maintenance based on machine learning algorithms.

name: Preserving History with Smart Technology: IoT Monitoring at the Colosseum
desc: Protecting world heritage sites requires continuous monitoring while avoiding invasive interventions that could compromise historical integrity.

name: Project PIERINO (Platform for the Extraction and Retrieval of Online Information)
desc: The PIERINO project was developed through collaboration between the Bruno Kessler Foundation, the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, and institutional partners to support the analysis of large-scale public consultation data.

name: Project “Sibyl A.I. Virtual" with Regione Puglia
desc: Public administrations increasingly need efficient and accessible channels to manage interactions with citizens, respond to enquiries, and deliver services in a timely manner. Regional institutions face high volumes of requests, fragmented communication channels, and rising expectations for digital public services.

name: Public AI Challenge - Hub Innovazione Trentino - Overtourism detection
desc: Overtourism places pressure on environmentally sensitive areas, leading to congestion, ecological damage, and reduced quality of life for residents and visitors. The Province of Trento sought tools to anticipate tourism peaks and manage mobility proactively.

name: REBUILD -  ICT toolbox providing support to both migrants and refugees
desc: REBUILD (ICT-enabled integration facilitator and life-rebuilding guidance) aims at designing and developing an ICT toolbox providing support to both migrants and refugees in Europe for accessing existing services, and local service providers interacting with migrants and refugees in enhancing their service provision.

name: REDOC - Digital Tutor to make easier learning the STEM subject
desc: Redooc is a revolutionizing website trains your brain in math and sciences, like a gym does with your muscles. Redooc, through a successful use of innovative gaming and technology, stimulates an health dose of competition among kids of different age ranges.

name: RainBO (follow-up of BLUEAP Bologna Urban Environment Adaptation Plan for a resilient city)
authority: Lepida Spa (inhouse ICT of Regione Emilia Romagna)
desc: The overall objective is to develop and improve methods and tools to predict severe rainfall events and their impact, focusing on the hydrologic response of the small watercourses within the urban area of Bologna.

name: RePAIR – Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Cultural Heritage Reconstruction
desc: Archaeological artefacts are often discovered in thousands of fragments, making physical reconstruction a painstaking and time-consuming task that requires scarce expert skills. Many damaged artworks remain in storage for decades due to the effort required to restore them.

name: RePAIR – Reconstructing the Past: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics meet Cultural Heritage
desc: The RePAIR Project — “Reconstructing the Past: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics meet Cultural Heritage” — was launched in 2021 with the goal of transforming the restoration of fragmented archaeological artefacts such as vases, amphorae, and frescoes.

name: Regional AI Hub/Centres for Environmental Data and Sustainable Mobility
desc: Environmental protection and mobility planning increasingly require coordinated action across administrative boundaries, yet data fragmentation often limits policy effectiveness. Lombardy and Veneto regions sought to improve environmental and transport governance through shared analytical capabilities.

name: Regional AI Hubs/Centres for Health and Tourism
desc: Several Italian regions are facing similar operational pressures in two high-impact service areas: healthcare and tourism. In healthcare, long waiting lists, uneven demand and constrained resources make it difficult to plan appointments and allocate capacity fairly and efficiently.

name: Regional AI Hubs/Centres for Resilience and Security of the Territory with 5G pilot action
desc: Preventing environmental risks and ensuring the safety of infrastructure and communities requires timely data, advanced analysis and reliable connectivity. Tuscany and partner regions sought to strengthen territorial resilience and emergency preparedness.

name: Regional AI Hubs/Centres for the PA
desc: Public administrations face increasing complexity in policy design and technical-administrative procedures, placing pressure on staff capacity and decision quality. Several Italian regions recognised the need for shared innovation to support administrative effectiveness.

name: Respondus:  assessment software for remote management of students (university)
authority: Multiple Italian Universities (Cattolica, Bocconi, Roma Tre etc.)
desc: Respondus is a proctoring software. Proctoring is a tool that allows you to control the student's device at exams or questions and to acquire data to decree whether that is copying or not.

name: Rimini Chatbot
desc: Citizens seeking information about municipal services often rely on email, phone calls or in-person visits, creating pressure on administrative staff and limiting accessibility outside office hours.

name: Robot-mediated rehabilitation (IIT-FDG)
desc: This use case addresses the need to extend rehabilitation support beyond conventional clinical sessions by introducing an assistive robot that can complement therapists’ work in hospitals, rehabilitation gyms and patients’ homes.

name: Rome conducts smart city trial of intelligent vision sensors
desc: Welfare Ticket – Blockchain-Based Social Security Platform for the Gig Economy (status: conceptual design, not implemented)

name: SAFERS - Structured Approaches for Forest fire Emergencies in Resilient Societies
authority: CSI Piemonte (Inhouse ICT of Regione Piemonte)
desc: SAFERS aims at developing, over the course of three years, an innovative platform to improve the management of forest fires, whose impact has greatly increased also due to climate change.

name: SARI (Automatic Image Recognition System)
desc: SARI (Automatic Image Recognition System) is a facial recognition software, in use at the Ministry of the Interior and Central Anti-Crime Directorate of the State Police since 2017. The software is produced and supplied to the Ministry by the company Parsec 3.26 S.r.l.

name: SAVIA project: Artificial Intelligence for law quality
desc: The MarghERita and SAVIA initiative in Emilia-Romagna combines high-performance computing and artificial intelligence to enhance public administration and citizen access to information.

name: SAVIO - Data mining to score sickness certificates for the purpose of controlling their truthfullness
desc: Social security institutions face the challenge of ensuring that sickness benefits are granted lawfully while avoiding excessive or intrusive medical controls. INPS, the Italian National Social Security Institute, reactivated the SAVIO system to support the verification of sickness certificates submitted by workers.

name: SIMPATICO - Platform for PS - Italian Usecase
desc: Online services may fail to adapt to the specific needs of citizens and companies because they are standardised processes, copied from their offline counterparts and designed from the public sector organisations own perspective.

name: Safe Spotter - AI platform to detect and transmit data of an accident
desc: Safespotter is an R&D project born for the Municipality of Monserrato whose general objective is to reduce the number of deaths and injuries in case of road accidents. The idea was born as part of the creation of an innovative and sustainable Smart City model towards which the Municipality of Monserrato aims.

name: Seamless Flow: facial recognition of airport passengers
desc: Seamless FloW is a technology produced by the Portuguese company Vision Box used at many airports – including Fiumicino, Malpensa and Linate. The aim is the management of passengers' digital identities and automatic recognition through a biometric identification (facial recognition).

name: SegnalaCI - Transparent management of citizen reports about City status
desc: The administration takes charge of the report, informs the competent office and resolves the problem (eg: repair the hole, empty the trash) .At the end of the procedure, the citizen receives a notification on the outcome of his report.

name: Shareart: measure the public's satisfaction in front of the works of art exhibited in museum
desc: ShareArt is the monitoring system through which it would be possible to measure the public's satisfaction in front of the works of art exhibited in museums, tested by the Sustainability Department of Production and Territorial Systems of ENEA in collaboration with the Bologna Museums Institution.

name: Silfi Smart City Control Room in Florence
desc: Florence developed a Smart City Control Room (SCCR), a physical space enabling a “cooperative model for managing the city and sharing data”, connecting service operators (the city authorities, police department, traffic and parking management operators, public transport and utilities in the sectors of water, waste,…

name: Similis: for the identification of similar and identical amendments
desc: The IT Department of the Italian Republic Senate has developed Similis, a system for clustering similar and identical parliamentary amendments, in close collaboration with the Institute of Legal Informatics and Judicial Systems of the National Research Council (CNR-IGSG).

name: Sof-IA: management of online medical appointments
desc: Sof-IA is the proprietary artificial intelligence developed by iDoctors, launched publicly in late 2025.

name: TALIA SF - Extract and organize knowledge coming from the analysis of textual documents
desc: The TALIA Semantic Framework, developed and managed by InnovaPuglia on behalf of the Regional Government of Apulia, addresses the challenge of extracting actionable insights from large volumes of textual documentation produced by projects funded under the Interreg MED Programme.

name: TITAN - AI for Citizen Intelligent Coaching against Disinformation
desc: Citizens frequently encounter misleading or false information online, yet lack accessible tools to critically assess claims. The TITAN project aims to empower individuals through an interactive coaching ecosystem that supports critical thinking and fact evaluation.

name: TOLIFE - Combining Artificial Intelligence and smart sensing TOward better management and improved quality of LIFE in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
desc: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) requires continuous monitoring to prevent exacerbations that significantly impair quality of life and increase hospitalisations. TOLIFE aims to support personalised disease management through unobtrusive sensing and predictive analytics.

name: TOURISMO Project - Florence
desc: The Municipality of Florence is piloting new smart technologies, including thermal cameras and “sniffers”, to monitor and manage tourist flows in the historic centre as part of the TOURISMO – TOURism Innovative and Sustainable Management of flOws project funded by Interreg Euro‑MED.

name: Talk with Arianna - the chatbot of the Italian National Institute for Social Security
desc: Arianna is a chatbot that answers citizens' enquiries related to the management of their PIN code, which is necessary to access some personal services on the INPS website. It is currently in the process of being integrated with other functions.

name: Text Simplification for Citizens with GenAI
authority: Italian National Institute of Social Security (INPS)
desc: Clear and accessible communication is essential to ensure that citizens can effectively navigate public services. INPS—Italy’s National Institute of Social Security and the largest welfare institution in Europe—serves approximately 45 million citizens through nearly 500 digital services related to pensions and welfare.

name: The AI algorithm that blew up Italy’s school system
desc: Italy's education system faced the annual challenge of assigning approximately 100,000 teachers to schools across diverse regions, a complex optimization problem that had historically relied on manual processes prone to errors and delays.

name: The Responsive PIAO: An AI-Enabled Model for Proactive and Continuous Skill Development
desc: Launched by LepidaSCpA in collaboration with the Italian public administration, the project introduces a strategic, data-driven approach to staff training, aligning professional development directly with the organisational objectives set out in the Piano integrato di attività e organizzazione (PIAO).

name: Toscana Open Research - Allows users to access information through "queries"
authority: Regional Conference for Research and Innovation
desc: Research, innovation, and higher-education ecosystems generate complex and distributed data, yet this information is often difficult for non-specialists to explore because databases are organised around technical structures rather than intuitive user needs.

name: TreC Mamma - Italian app for new mothers
desc: TreC Mamma is a digital app that allows mothers to use chatbots to gather information on pregnancy and childcare.

name: Trentino Salute 4.0: TREC+
desc: TreC + consolidates and puts into service the trials that have been tested in recent years in Trentino together with citizens and health professionals.

name: TrueBee (Digital forensics and blockchain tech against deceptive deepfake imaging in social media)
desc: The project (part of subcall of EU Project Troublo) intends to combine artificial intelligence tools for the recognition and classification of false images and a blockchain system to create a register, where the classification can be indelibly saved.

name: University La Sapienza launches the first voice "assistant":  Infostud-Watson
desc: Large universities manage complex administrative interactions with students, including exam bookings, certification requests, and general study-related enquiries, which can overwhelm traditional service desks. Sapienza University sought to simplify access to student services and modernise interaction channels.

name: Urban EVOLUTION (Earth obserVatiOn and nature-based soLUTions agaInst urban pollution)
authority: City of Naples, Catania, and Perugia
desc: Urban EVOLUTION addresses a pressing urban-management challenge: how to reduce air pollution and urban heat-island effects in dense city environments while planning interventions that are practical, evidence-based and replicable.

name: Use of IoT technologies to gather data from the City of Ferrara
desc: City of Ravenna started multiple projects on the use of IoT technologies to monitor and gather sensitive data from the city to monitor air quality, to analyse tourists flow, to monitor mobility sharing.

name: VELVET - Italian AI Open Source model
desc: European administrations and organisations require language technologies that reflect linguistic diversity, regulatory requirements and sustainability goals. The objective of this pilot is to develop an open-source model prioritising Italian language and content while supporting multilingual use.

name: VeRa 1.0, the artificial intelligence that tracks tax evaders
desc: Italy loses over €99 billion annually to tax evasion, with €30 billion from VAT alone, whilst traditional enforcement methods struggled to identify non-compliant taxpayers among millions of returns.

name: Venice Smart Control Room
desc: Supported by automated reasoning, the system developed by the Municipality of Venice in collaboration with the mobile company TIM is able to detect automatically all kind of boats cruising in the Venice sea channels, calculate the speed limit, cruising allowance.

name: Venice smart monitoring systems for tourists
desc: Overtourism threatens the liveability and heritage of Venice, requiring precise understanding of visitor flows to support management decisions. This use case involves the city administration, residents, and visitors, with the objective of monitoring and managing tourist density.

name: Virtual Assistant based on generative AI at INPS
desc: INPS has recently launched an experiment with the objective to integrate within the INPS Virtual Assistant the same 'Large Language Model' (LLM) algorithm at the basis of ChatGPT, thanks to the collaboration of Microsoft Azure with OpenAI.

name: Virtual assistant equipped with artificial intelligence for Parkinson's patients and their families
desc: Campus Bio-Medico University Hospital and IBM join forces to create "Parkinson bot", a virtual assistant, based on artificial intelligence, capable of answering questions related to Parkinson's 24 hours a day every day.

name: Virtual assistant for services - first step towards artificial intelligence in diplomacy
authority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
desc: Citizens and businesses interacting with diplomatic and consular services often face complex procedures and time-zone constraints, leading to delays and information gaps. The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs sought to improve service accessibility and consistency across its global network.

name: Water monitoring using AI in South Tyrol
desc: Water utilities need better visibility over the condition and performance of distribution systems, yet smaller operators in particular often lack integrated tools for monitoring, maintenance planning, and rapid response to leaks, interruptions, or inefficient network behaviour.

name: Webapp L15 - digital ecosystem of Lombardy Region
desc: This digital platform gathers single APIs provided by public or private providers. L’ambiente si basa su una personalizzazione (realizzata da Aria S.p.A) di Open 2.0, l’applicativo open source messo a disposizione da Regione Lombardia per la creazione di strumenti collaborativi.

name: Whatsapp InfoCenter City of Milan (020202)
desc: The City of Milan manages a very high volume of citizen enquiries, particularly during periods of regulatory change and public health or mobility restrictions, when residents need fast and reliable information across multiple service areas.

name: XLAW - Trends and pattern discovery in crimes
authority: Department of Public Security Central Anti-Crime Directorate
desc: XLAW software also developed by a law enforcement official and it has already been deployed in the cities of Naples, Modena, Prato, Salerno, Livorno, Trieste, Trento, and Venice (Business Insider 2019).

name: YUCCA-Smart Data Platform
desc: Yucca Smart Data Platform is an open and pre-competitive cloud platform available for private and public entities that offers tools to experiment and create innovative technological solutions related to the world of data.

name: crowdHEDGE: Using AI to help governments and local authorities keep citizens safe
desc: Local authorities need timely information on how public spaces are being used, especially when crowding, footfall, or unsafe proximity may affect public health and safety, yet traditional monitoring methods can be slow, incomplete, or costly to scale.

name: iMaging Project - EyeOnWater app
desc: Marine oil spills are difficult to detect and track quickly across large sea areas, yet delays in identification can worsen environmental damage, complicate response planning and reduce the effectiveness of mitigation efforts.

name: ‘Democratic Engagement through a Public Chatbot’ (DepuChat) - How GenAI can increase transparency
desc: The Chamber of Deputies is more transparent and closer to the citizens thanks to the project ‘Democratic Engagement through a Public Chatbot’ (DepuChat), developed by the European Interdepartmental Research Centre for Advanced Studies on Digital Innovation IDEAS (Research Center IDEAS - Innovation Digital European…

name: “Connected” robots in Turin hospitals
authority: Hospitals of Regina Margherita and Sant’Anna (Turin)
desc: Job seekers often struggle to navigate complex information on occupations, training pathways, and reskilling opportunities, particularly in a rapidly changing labour market.

name: AI Factories Latvia
authority: Ministry of Economics of the Republic of Latvia
desc: The project “AI Factories Latvia” is a national-level initiative aimed at boosting artificial intelligence innovation in Latvia.

name: Automatic decision making of the Electronic Declaration System of the State Revenue Service
desc: Tax administrations receive very large volumes of declarations and supporting documents, and reviewing each submission manually can limit efficiency, delay compliant cases, and divert expert attention away from higher-risk filings.

name: Chatbot - Lad Va
authority: Rural Support Service of the Republic of Latvia
desc: LAD Va Chatbot is the virtual assistant available on the official website of the Rural Support Service of the Republic of Latvia.

name: FITS ITEMS - Road safety
desc: Road safety authorities need reliable ways to enforce rules on speeding, insurance, and vehicle roadworthiness, yet manual roadside control is resource-intensive and cannot provide the same breadth of coverage as automated monitoring.

name: Hugo - Virtual Assistant for governments
desc: Public administrations often struggle to provide consistent, multilingual digital support across agencies, particularly when regulations change frequently and institutions must keep guidance up to date across many separate websites and service channels.

name: Just - virtual assistant of the State Unitary Computerized Land Book
desc: At the end of 2019, the Court Administration introduced a virtual assistant into the Land Register portal. The assistant named Justs (from the word justīcija, ‘justice’) helps people find their way around the services offered by the Land Register.

name: LAA - Pilot lung cancer risk assessment
desc: In 2018, Latvia launched a pilot project to improve lung cancer risk assessment, early diagnosis, and forecasting using large-scale data analysis. Since treatment is most effective when detected early, the project applied machine learning for cancer diagnostics.

name: Satellites for Wilderness Inspection and Forest Threat Tracking (SWIFTT)
desc: Forest ecosystems face increasing risks from climate change, pests and biodiversity loss, yet monitoring large and remote areas remains resource-intensive. The SWIFTT project aims to provide forest managers with accessible and scientifically robust remote sensing tools to monitor and mitigate forest threats.

name: TildeOpen LLM – AI solution for European languages
desc: TildeOpen LLM is an open‑source large language model released by the European language technology company Tilde in September 2025, specifically designed to support European languages, including those often under-represented in major commercial models.

name: Toms - Chatbot facilitating customer communication with the State Revenue service
desc: Revenue agencies handle high volumes of repetitive public enquiries, ranging from office locations and opening hours to questions about digital filing, annual income declarations, and eligible expenditure.

name: UNA - Chatbot for process enterprise registration
authority: Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia
desc: In 2018, the Register of Enterprises of Latvia introduced the Chatbot UNA (Future assistant for entrepreneurs - FAE) to answer frequently asked questions regarding the process of enterprise registration. Chatbot is available 24/7 and thus able to make communication between citizens and the state accessible and…

name: VARIS - Reviews all the applicants to Rural Support Service
desc: Processing aid applications in the agricultural sector often requires public authorities to check eligibility, verify company-related information, and ensure that beneficiaries have not been subject to relevant penalties, all of which can be administratively burdensome when handled manually at scale.

name: Voice recognition in court administration
desc: This project, developed for the Latvian Prosecutor's Office, was implemented through a tool that applies AI for voice recognition to be used for court administration.

name: viLTe' - Chatbot answering relevant questions regarding the COVID-19
authority: Government of the Republic of Lithuania
desc: Created during the “Hack the Crisis” hackathon, viLTe' was designed to address an urgent public-information problem during the COVID-19 pandemic: citizens needed fast, reliable and easy-to-understand answers about symptoms, restrictions and related public-health measures at a time of high uncertainty and rapidly…

name: AI Model Combining Speech and Brain Activity for Depression Diagnosis
desc: Researchers at Kaunas University of Technology (KTU) have developed an artificial intelligence model that combines two types of data — speech and brain activity measured via EEG — to diagnose depression.

name: AI tool for depersonalising sensitive data at the State Consumer Rights Protection Authority (SCRPA)
desc: The personal data depersonalisation AI tool is an internally developed solution designed to enhance data privacy, security, and regulatory compliance.

name: AI-based tool for monitoring cultivated land in Lithuania using Copernicus Sentinel data
desc: Lithuania uses advanced technology to monitor the EU's Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) and distribute funds more efficiently. They partnered with Geomatrix UAB to develop a system (SAGRIS and CAPCON) that analyses satellite data with machine learning to assess farm activities and land use.

name: Dìgital Twin in the City of Vilnius
desc: Vilnius has deployed an advanced digital twin platform supported by AI, GIS and drone data to optimise city services and planning.

name: EditAI – AI Tool for Teachers
desc: EditAI is an AI-powered tool designed to help teachers create lesson plans, assignments, and learning materials more efficiently. It supports modern teaching approaches such as problem-based and personalised learning, while allowing educators to adapt content to different student needs.

name: Evaluate science and business cooperation in terms of knowledge usage efficiency
desc: Developing an innovative tool using AI that will allow for the collection, processing and classification systematisation of relevant data on the knowledge generated by the Institutions of Science and Studies (ISS).

name: FCIS - Machine learning to identify suspicious patterns (trade, financial flows)
desc: Financial Crime Investigation Service under Lithuanian Customs sought to strengthen its ability to detect suspicious trade and financial-flow patterns across fragmented and high-volume datasets, in a context where investigators and other law-enforcement units needed faster, better-prioritised intelligence to support…

name: Innovative Mathematics Learning Platform (Grades 5–12)
desc: This AI-powered mathematics platform supports students in grades 5–12 by providing curriculum-aligned exercises, intelligent feedback, and adaptive learning paths.

name: Integration of an Innovative Product – AI Technology – into Public Procurement Object Price Analysis and Forecasting, and Centralized Public Procurement Savings Identification Procedures
authority: Public Institution CPO LT (Viešoji įstaiga CPO LT)
desc: The Republic of Lithuania is pioneering the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into centralised public procurement to improve efficiency, transparency, and cost-effectiveness.

name: LitAI - Lithuania AI Factory
desc: Lithuania is establishing a national Artificial Intelligence Factory, known as LitAI, which will be coordinated by Vilnius University. The initiative will create a comprehensive centre combining high-performance computing and AI-optimised infrastructure with data resources, research capabilities and technical…

name: Lithuania Innovative solution for the assessment of the impact and damage of hydrometeorological phenomena
desc: Extreme weather events and hazardous natural phenomena pose increasing risks to populations, infrastructure and economic activity, yet information about their impact is often fragmented across agencies and data sources.

name: Lithuania Solution for greening the city of Vilnius using satellite data and AI
desc: Urban greenery plays a critical role in environmental quality and citizens’ wellbeing, yet monitoring vegetation health across an entire city is resource-intensive and often relies on manual inspections.

name: Lithuanian solution for systematised forecast of the regional labour market demand
desc: Regional authorities often lack timely, evidence-based insights into how labour market demand evolves, making it difficult to plan vocational education, reskilling programmes and economic development policies.

name: Mantas – chatbot created by Lithuanian Post together with Tilde
desc: Mantas is an intelligent AI‑powered chatbot developed for Lithuanian Post in collaboration with the language technology company Tilde.

name: Next-level eLearning: AI Chatbot with LLM revolutionises academic communication and learning processes
desc: The Digne eLearning AI Chatbot is an advanced, AI‑powered virtual assistant developed by Tilde to transform academic communication and support within university courses.

name: Personalised Mathematics Learning Platform for Every Student (Grades 5–12)
desc: This platform delivers personalised mathematics learning through adaptive tasks, interactive content, and gamified elements that respond to each student’s individual progress and knowledge gaps. It is designed to improve engagement, reinforce foundational skills, and support steady academic development.

name: ROXANNE – Real-Time Network, Text and Speaker Analytics for Combating Organised Crime
desc: Law enforcement agencies investigating organised and cross-border crime face large volumes of multilingual communications, multimedia content and complex relational data. Manual analysis can delay investigations and obscure network structures.

name: Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks’ Juris – the first chatbot in the property management field
desc: Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks’ Juris is an AI‑powered chatbot developed by Tilde in collaboration with Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks (RNP), Northern Europe’s largest apartment building management company, to modernize customer communication in the property management sector.

name: VRK chatbot: AI-powered support during the elections in Lithuania
desc: The VRK AI Chatbot is an AI-powered virtual assistant developed by Tilde for the Central Electoral Commission of Lithuania (VRK).

name: Virtual Market Assistant for the State Consumer Rights Protection Authority (SCRPA)
desc: The Virtual Market Assistant is an innovative mobile application designed to enhance consumer safety by providing instant access to information on officially listed hazardous products and enabling users to report new risks.

name: "Iwwersetzungskorpus fir d'Lëtzebuergescht" - multilingual parallel corpus
authority: Zenter fir d'Lëtzebuerger Sprooch (ZLS – Centre for Luxembourgish Language)
desc: The Zenter fir d'Lëtzebuerger Sprooch (ZLS – Center for Luxembourgish Language) is proposing the establishment of a multilingual parallel corpus. This corpus will focus on Luxembourgish as the source language — and therefore the main language — with translations into three target languages: German, French and English.

name: "Sproocherkennung fir d'Lëtzebuergescht": improving schreifmaschinn.lu, an AI-based speech-to-text tool in various languages
authority: Zenter fir d'Lëtzebuerger Sprooch (ZLS – Centre for Luxembourgish Language)
desc: The Zenter fir d'Lëtzebuerger Sprooch (ZLS – Center for Luxembourgish Language) has developed the prototype schreifmaschinn.lu, an AI-based speech-to-text tool in various languages, including Luxembourgish.

name: A comprehensive language model specifically trained on Luxembourg legislation
desc: Luxembourg is developing a large language model trained specifically on national legislation, with the intention of making the country’s legal framework easier to navigate for professionals and more comprehensible for citizens.

name: A high-performing multilingual model that includes Luxembourgish in both written and spoken form
desc: Luxembourg is building a multilingual language and speech model that includes Luxembourgish in both written and spoken form, in order to strengthen the presence of the national language in modern digital tools.

name: ADEM Interact - AI conversational platform for the Employment Agency
desc: ADEM Interact is an AI conversational platform that will assist state agents of the Employment Agency ADEM who receive messages from job seekers, by formulating personalised responses. This is expected to apply to emails and enquiries received via a new Chatbot service integrated into the ADEM website.

name: ADEM Profiling
desc: ADEM Profiling will allow through the analysis of existing data at ADEM to develop a support model for their agents to assess which jobseekers need which measures and level of support to access employment.

name: AI Reader - enhancing the efficiency of data entry processes
authority: Commissariat aux affaires maritimes (CAM – Commission for Maritime Affairs)
desc: The project led by the Commissariat aux affaires maritimes (CAM – Commission for Maritime Affairs) aims to develop a tool capable of automatically extracting predefined data from official documents, such as visas, in PDF (text or image) or JPEG format without human intervention.

name: AI in Education in Luxembourg
desc: Luxembourg is deploying artificial intelligence to support personalised learning in the education system, creating tools that help pupils learn more effectively while also teaching them how to use AI responsibly.

name: AI in Rectruitment Procedures
authority: State Centre for Human Resources and Organisation Management
desc: The State Centre for Human Resources and Organisation Management intends to improve recruitment procedures by using artificial intelligence in order to assist their agents in checking the conditions of admissibility of applications and registrations for the general aptitude test for the Luxembourg civil service.

name: AI4DI - AI-Powered Automation of Information Requests
desc: The National Commission for Data Protection’s (CNPD) "Information Requests" service handles a diverse range of inquiries received through email, mail, and telephone. As the number of questions and responses has grown over time, manual searches by staff have become increasingly time-consuming.

name: Anomaly detection: machine learning to detect water leaks
desc: The 'Anomaly detection' project is designed to enable the local authority association, DEA (Distribution d'Eau des Ardennes), to use machine learning to detect water leaks in the network and identify changes in a set of data with daily and seasonal differences.

name: Assitance in drafting judgments JUAIDE
desc: This project concerns an artificial intelligence component to assist judges in drafting legal documents. It analyses the context of the text being drafted in real time and automatically suggests relevant legal texts and court decisions.

name: Automatic labelisation of documents
desc: The Central legislative service aims to automatically label (categorise/classify) documents based on their content, with a view to coupling a chatbot with the knowledge graph of Luxembourgish legislation.

name: CLAVIS project - Automatic recognition of old handwritten documents
desc: Historical archives contain vast quantities of handwritten material that remain difficult to exploit because older manuscripts are often challenging to read, search and interpret at scale.

name: Extraction of topographical objects - AI to extract topographical objects from aerial images
desc: Updating national topographic and land-registry databases is labour-intensive, particularly when officials must identify newly built structures, new roads and emerging construction areas from large volumes of aerial imagery.

name: Floodwater detection in urban areas powered by AI and SAR data
desc: Rapid and accurate detection of urban flooding is critical for emergency response, infrastructure protection and disaster risk management. Optical imagery is often hindered by cloud cover during extreme weather events. Stakeholders include civil protection authorities, municipalities and urban planners.

name: Indexing of Government photos for better identification on photos using facial recognition
desc: The Government’s Information and Press service has an enormous media library of political photos belonging to the Luxembourg State. Until now, the work on indexing these photos, carried out manually, has been fastidious and time consuming.

name: JUANO - app to anonymise court decisions for publication on the justice internet portal
desc: JUANO is an application that helps anonymise court decisions for publication on the justice internet portal. JUANO is based on an artificial intelligence engine that recognises entities to be anonymised and automatically suggests categories based on the text.

name: L-AIF - Luxembourg AI Factory
desc: The project Luxembourg AI Factory (L-AIF) seeks to build a secure, trusted infrastructure for artificial-intelligence development centred in Luxembourg.

name: Legal and normative text analyser
authority: Luxembourg Office of Accreditation and Surveillance (OLAS)
desc: The Luxembourg Office of Accreditation and Surveillance (OLAS) aims to develop a tool, the ‘Legal and Normative Text Analyser’, designed to analyse documentation from recognised and reliable sources such as Legilux, EUR-Lex, ISO, CEN, EA, ILAC, IAF, as well as locally stored files.

name: MIREL - Mining and reasoning with legal text
desc: The MIREL project will create an international and inter-sectorial network to define a formal framework and to develop tools for MIning and REasoning with Legal texts, with the aim of translating these legal texts into formal representations that can be used for querying norms, compliance checking, and decision…

name: Machine learning for statistics
authority: National Institute of statistics and economic studies (STATEC)
desc: The National Institute of statistics and economic studies (STATEC) will implement a data science and machine learning program to enable the production of statistics on the mobile telephone database.

name: MeluXina-AI: High-performance supercomputer to test AI applications on a large scale
desc: Luxembourg is set to build an AI-optimised supercomputer, MeluXina-AI, together with a national “AI Factory” to advance artificial intelligence development and research.

name: Outlier detection - a system for detecting aberrant data
desc: The Ministry of Home Affairs aims to set up automated monitoring using a system for detecting aberrant data (outlier detection) in the financial data of the municipal sector.

name: Project Griffin - Drones to transport medical supplies in emergency situations
desc: Rapid transport of medical samples and supplies is critical in emergency healthcare, yet traditional logistics can be slow or constrained by infrastructure. In Luxembourg, emergency services seek innovative solutions to reduce response times.

name: ScreenreaderLB - AI-Powered Luxembourgish Accessibility for the Visually Impaired
desc: The ScreenreaderLB solution, developed by the Government Information and Press Service, addresses the increasing need for accessible content in Luxembourgish for visually impaired users.

name: UrbIA - AI for cadastral data
desc: The Land Registry and Topography Administration is responsible for managing the country's cadastral data. This data has been systematically organised for 200 years, both in graphic form (cadastral plans and sketch maps) and in tables recording changes in property rights.

name: a-z.lu to digitise text documents for Luxembourg's National Library
desc: The Bibliothéque Nationale du Luxembourg digitised textual documents by correcting OCR, extracting entities and organising image content.

name: Bilingual AI Chatbot and Mobile Robot
desc: The Life Events Robot is an AI‑powered assistant built to help citizens in Malta with major life‑event procedures — such as registering a birth, marriage or divorce — via a bilingual (Maltese and English) chatbot and, eventually, a mobile robot.

name: Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) - AI for urban mobility
desc: The project Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) in Malta is an initiative aimed at advancing the use of digital technologies, data-driven tools and automation to enhance the performance of modern transport networks.

name: Introduction of Microsoft 365 Copilot within the public sector
desc: The Malta Information Technology Agency (MITA) announced that, starting in 2025, the Maltese government will roll out Microsoft 365 Copilot — an AI-powered assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 applications — across the public sector.

name: Servizz.Gov Chatbox in Malta
desc: Citizens often need quick answers to routine questions about public services, but traditional customer-service models in government can be costly to scale and may deliver inconsistent response times across ministries.

name: TOURISMO Project - Malta
desc: As part of the TOURISMO – Tourism Innovative and Sustainable Management of flOws programme, a pilot beach monitoring system was launched at Golden Bay to help manage overtourism and protect the area’s natural environment.

name: Ministry of Finance, mTender
desc: With support from the EBRD, the Moldovan Government developed an open source electronic procurement system for electronic open tender, reverse auctions, aggregated procurement planning and online framework agreements. The system makes use of the open contracting data standard.

name: Digital Twin for Monte Carlo Station
desc: In June 2025, SNCF Gares & Connexions partnered with Akila and NVIDIA to deploy an AI‑powered digital twin platform at Monte‑Carlo train station in Monaco. The system uses real‑time simulation, AI agents and sensor data to create a dynamic 3D model of the station’s built environment.

name: "Responsible use of AI"- pilot project to enhahnce environmental monitoring within the Province of Fryslân in collaboration with Rijks ICT Gilde and the Z-Inspection® Initiative
authority: Province of Fryslân and Rijks ICT Gilde
desc: Environmental monitoring is essential for biodiversity protection, water management and climate mitigation, yet integrating advanced analytics into public administration requires careful governance.

name: 3D Point Cloud
desc: The City of Amsterdam aims to improve urban asset management by maintaining accurate and up-to-date information about public infrastructure such as trees, street lighting, and traffic signs. Traditional data collection methods are labour-intensive and may lack precision or timeliness.

name: 3D scan underground infrastructure - Prevention damage of critical infrastructure
desc: The 3D scan of the precise location of the main sewer in combination with an app that visualizes the location of the sewer above ground prevents damage to this critical infrastructure during construction work.

name: 8TING - Analysis of drivers to keep people in class
authority: 8Ting, business office Work & Income of the municipality of Enschede
desc: With 8TING, the use of pyschology and web technology in the Municipality of Enschede appeals to internal drivers by monitoring and adjusting on more than 80 factors. Based on profile, behaviour and context, it is made clear who needs what attention.

name: AI Chatbot Robin - Answer questions about business transfers
desc: Chatbot Robin is the sequel to the Pilot Watson. Chatbot Robin went live in April 2019. Chatbot Robin is a virtual agent that can answer questions about agricultural business transfers.

name: AI for detecting Asian Hornbill
desc: Detecting the presence of the Asian hornet is a growing operational priority because this invasive species can threaten biodiversity, disrupt ecosystems and create risks for beekeeping and public safety.

name: AI for detecting illegal substances -  AI to index seized data carrier
desc: The Netherlands Forensic Institute needed a faster and more effective way to review large volumes of seized digital material in investigations where images of illegal substances might be present.

name: AI for detection of diseases in plants and trees
desc: Plant and tree health monitoring is essential for protecting agriculture, biodiversity and wider environmental quality, yet disease detection across large areas can be difficult, time-consuming and dependent on scarce specialist expertise.

name: AI for fisheries inspections - Detecting illegal barrels
desc: Inspection authorities face a recurring challenge when monitoring production and storage environments: potentially harmful anomalies may be difficult to identify quickly across large areas, yet delayed detection can weaken controls, increase operational costs and heighten risks to food safety.

name: AI for green roof management
desc: The City of Amsterdam required reliable data on green roof coverage to support climate adaptation, biodiversity and urban planning policies, as previous mapping methods classified entire roofs as green when only partial vegetation was present, leading to significant overestimation and unreliable statistics.

name: AI for poverty detection
desc: Amsterdam implemented an early intervention system to identify households at risk of financial hardship based on payment arrears reported by health insurers, housing associations, energy suppliers and Waternet. The operational goal is to prevent escalation into problematic debt by initiating timely social support.

name: AI for public space notifications - Image recognition to analyse reports
desc: Municipalities receive many citizen reports about defects and inconveniences in public space, ranging from loose paving stones and broken streetlights to potentially dangerous situations requiring urgent intervention.

name: AI machine learning supervised - Delivering learning reports
desc: Educational and public-service organisations often hold large amounts of administrative and performance data, yet turning those data into useful learning insights for internal improvement can be slow and resource-intensive.

name: AI-EFFECT, Advancing AI Integration in the European Energy Sector - Transmission Congestion Management Laboratory
desc: Electricity transmission networks face growing congestion due to renewable integration, electrification, and increased demand, placing pressure on control rooms to manage grid stability in real time. Grid operators require safe environments to test and validate new operational approaches without risking live systems.

name: AI-based compression on Sentinel 2 data
desc: The increasing volume of high-resolution satellite imagery places pressure on onboard storage, downlink bandwidth and ground processing infrastructure. Conventional image compression techniques may reduce file size but can limit downstream analytical value.

name: AICrimePrediction (AICP) - Prediction of  the risk of crime and terrorism
desc: Police control rooms handle continuous streams of incident data and real-time reports, yet anticipating where risks may emerge remains a difficult task in fast-changing urban environments.

name: ANPR - Car plate recognition
desc: Public authorities need reliable ways to monitor vehicle movements and enforce rules across a wide range of operational contexts, including paid parking, traffic management, tax enforcement and environmental regulation.

name: ARTILLERY - Artificial Intelligence for early detection of non-communicable disease risk in people with breast cancer
desc: Breast cancer survivors face elevated risks of chronic conditions such as cardiovascular disease, osteoporosis and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, yet early identification of these risks is often limited.

name: Aerial Inspection Drones
authority: Dutch Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA)
desc: Aurea Imaging wants to develop image analysis technology for drones/Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to use them in the agricultural sector in detecting anomalies. These abnormalities may indicate harmful organisms.

name: Agent system
desc: The agent developed by ProRail in the Netherlands is an autonomous computer program that functions completely independently with associated actions and goals. The officer gives avies to train traffic controllers in case of delay to avoid further delays in train traffic.

name: Amberscript - Automated speech translation for public organisations
authority: About 120 different municipalities in the Netherlands
desc: Dutch municipalities such as Staphorst needed a practical way to make council meetings more accessible and transparent, particularly for citizens who are deaf or hard of hearing and may otherwise struggle to follow political debate in real time.

name: Amsterdam City Archive - Handwritten Text Recognition for eabling searches on old handwritten texts
authority: Aincient B.V., Picturae, Sioux Technologies, Islands of Meaning, Amsterdam City Archive.
desc: By means of Handwritten Text Recoginition (HTR), millions of scans of old handwritten texts from the Amsterdam City Archive can be automatically converted into transcriptions. This makes searching in complete texts possible. NLP is used.

name: Amsterdam: Generating sustainable materials with Generative AI
desc: Natural language processing – the backbone of gen AI chatbots like ChatGPT – uses word data to make new linguistic connections. Now a research project at the University of Amsterdam is swapping words for molecules to create new, sustainable materials.

name: Analysing data to help people on welfare get back to work for Social Assistance in The Hague
desc: Analyzing data to help people on welfare get back to work. The system finds people at an early stage so that they can be helped immediately on their way.

name: Anti-cheat software for exams
authority: University of Rotterdam and other 14 dutch universities
desc: Several Dutch higher education institutions use online surveillance software called Proctorexam. By means of the proctoring software, students can be watched during exams via the webcam, microphone or web browser. The software monitors whether the students are cheating and can label students as 'suspicious'.

name: Artificial Intelligence Knowledge System for the judiciary searches for similar lawsuits
desc: Knowledge system searches for similar lawsuits using entered text and gives the user the top 10 most similar lawsuits.

name: Artificial inspector - Self-learning system for the inspection of national roads and waterways
desc: Rijkswaterstaat needed a more efficient and affordable way to inspect national roads and waterways, since traditional inspection approaches often depend on expensive professional camera equipment and limited collection capacity.

name: Asphalt scan - Detection of  damage to roads
authority: Province of North Holland, Municipality of Amersfoort, Bam infra, Province of Gelderland and other provinces
desc: Road authorities need reliable and up-to-date information on pavement damage and declining visibility of signage in order to plan maintenance before defects become more severe, more expensive and more disruptive for road users.

name: Atlas Cyclable Utrecht
desc: Commissioned by the Province of Utrecht, Atlas Fietsbaar Utrecht was developed within a digital twin framework to assess cycling accessibility, particularly in relation to educational institutions.

name: Atlas Multimodal Brabant – Digital Twin for Freight Corridors (Netherlands)
desc: Atlas Multimodal Brabant was developed by Argaleo for Logistics Community Brabant to support coordination of multimodal freight transport corridors. Transport operators require clear visibility of shared routes, transhipment terminals and environmental performance indicators to optimise logistics planning.

name: Automated parking control
desc: In Amsterdam, the number of cars allowed to park in the city is limited, keeping the city liveable and accessible. The municipality checks whether a parked car has the right to be parked, for example, because parking fees have been paid via a parking meter or app, or because the owner has a parking permit.

name: Automatically Assessing and Improving the Readability of Municipal Communication
desc: Low literacy levels present barriers to civic participation, particularly in accessing municipal services such as taxation, voting and social benefits.

name: Automation subsidy requirements - Application for a subsidy are examined by AI algorithm
desc: The Province of South Holland introduced this use case to address a practical barrier to household sustainability: many homeowners wanted to make their homes more energy-efficient but lacked the financial means to do so.

name: Autonomous Boats Deployment
desc: Amsterdam’s dense canal network presents both opportunities and challenges for urban mobility, logistics and environmental monitoring. Traditional boats require human operators, limiting scalability and increasing operational costs.

name: AviaTor - Pilot detection child abuse
desc: AviaTor, which stands for Augmented Visual Intelligence and Targeted Online Research,was developed from a research project into a working prototype in just 12 months.

name: Bikeability.AI to analise bikeability in Municipality of Dordrecht
desc: Dordrecht needed a better way to understand how cycle-friendly different neighbourhoods and city areas actually are, and how planned infrastructure changes might improve the quality of cycling conditions.

name: Blue Operational Prevention Service
desc: Flood prevention requires timely decisions based on changing risk conditions, available response resources and the practical question of what action is most useful in a given moment.

name: Brid.ge - Smart City Enschede
authority: Municipality of Enschede, Saxion, Winkelhart Enschede, University of Twente, Both Social, eLabbs, Marotura, Present Media, Squal Media, Think Public, University of Twente and Winkelhart Enschede
desc: Urban mobility in Enschede is affected by congestion, inefficient parking usage and limited coordination between private vehicles and public transport, creating delays, emissions and poor user experience for residents and visitors.

name: Bridge sensors to control car and boat traffic
desc: The province of South Holland wants its roads and waterways to be safe and accessible, to which end it has introduced the Smart Shipping programme.

name: Business Intelligence and Analytics (BI&A) - Indication of tax fraud risks based on previous declarations
desc: Dutch Tax Authority works with self-learning models that increasingly more refined indicate where risks are based on previous inspected declarations and feedback of the results. An example is Dynamic Monitoring.

name: CAS - Crime anticipation system
desc: The Crime Anticipation System was designed to help police allocate limited resources more effectively by identifying where and when specific categories of crime were more likely to occur.

name: CEF Data Marketplace
desc: CEF Data Marketplace aims to develop a broader market serving the data needs of all stakeholders in the global translation space, across various desired language combinations and domains.

name: CLARITY - Causative Link between respirAtory syncytial viRus and chronic lung diseases: Identifying Targets for therapY
desc: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infections in early life are associated with increased risk of chronic respiratory conditions, including asthma, yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

name: Calculemus FLINT - Ensuring understandability of normative law texts
authority: Leibniz Center for Law, University of Amsterdam
desc: Legal and policy rules are often difficult to interpret consistently, particularly when different professional groups or affected citizens need to understand how norms should be applied in practice.

name: Cameras - Detection holding a phone in car
desc: The Dutch Public Prosecution Service introduced this use case to strengthen enforcement against drivers holding mobile phones behind the wheel, a behaviour associated with serious road-safety risks and difficult to police consistently through conventional roadside observation alone.

name: Case Law Engine
desc: The Public Prosecution Service (OM, Openbare Ministerie) is a Dutch governmental institution that investigated the applications of AI in their daily working procedures. The OM needed a tool to reduce research time and also to improve the quality of case preparation.

name: Catch facial recognition software
desc: Dutch police’s Catch face recognition system is of particular importance. An investigation published by VICE in July 2019 uncovered the existence of over 2.2 million images in the Catch system of a total of 1.3 million individuals who may be suspected of committing a serious criminal offense.

name: ChatAmsterdam - AI assistant for civil servants
desc: Municipal employees increasingly work with large volumes of text, policy documents and complex information, which places pressure on time, consistency and quality of administrative work. At the same time, public organisations must ensure that sensitive information is handled securely and in line with public values.

name: ChatAmsterdam - an internally developed generative AI chatbot tailored to the municipality's needs and values to support civil servants in their daily activities
desc: ChatAmsterdam is an internally developed generative AI assistant designed to support civil servants in the Municipality of Amsterdam.

name: CityFlows-Amsterdam
authority: Municipality of Amsterdam and AMS Institute
desc: CityFlows is an EIT Urban Mobility flagship project bringing together a diverse consortium of partners to launch a state-of-the-art Crowd Management Decision-Support System (CM-DSS) to improve the safety and comfort of busy pedestrian spaces.

name: Combating Online Child Abuse
desc: Authorities and online-safety stakeholders face the urgent challenge of identifying illegal child sexual abuse imagery on the internet quickly enough to support removal and limit further harm.

name: Consultation AI
authority: Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management
desc: ConsultationAI is an AI-powered tool developed during the OECD Co-Creation Bootcamp in Lisbon, Portugal. The project was a collaborative effort involving teams from deliberAIde, Dembrane, Harmonica, Brightlands Smart Services Campus, and the Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management.

name: Controlling and balancing public power grids with AI: TenneT usecase
desc: TenneT initiated a Dynamic Purchasing System to renew and enhance IT systems supporting control and balancing of high-voltage electricity grids between 2021 and 2031. The energy transition increases variability in power generation and requires advanced forecasting and grid management tools.

name: CrossWalk in Smart City Rijswijk
desc: The municipality of Rijswijk has tested a smart pedestrian app for people who have difficulty walking through a pilot. People who could not walk fast were given more time to cross by extending the time of green traffic light.

name: Crowd management dashboard in 's-Hertogenbosch
desc: Following the COVID-19 pandemic, the municipality of ’s-Hertogenbosch implemented a digital dashboard to manage pedestrian flows safely during reopening phases. The operational objective was to monitor visitor density and movement patterns in real time to prevent overcrowding.

name: DE-ENIGMA (Multi-Modal Human-Robot Interaction for Teaching Social Imagination in Autistic Children)
desc: Multi-Modal Human-Robot Interaction for Teaching and Expanding Social Imagination in Autistic Children (DE-ENIGMA) aims to create and evaluate the effectiveness of robot-based technology, directed for children with ASC.

name: Debt relief - Chatbot to assist people with debts
desc: Many people experiencing debt problems struggle to find the right form of help quickly, particularly when they do not know which service to contact or feel overwhelmed by the complexity of support pathways.

name: Deliberations @ Scale: Large-scale high-engagement citizen participation with generative AI
desc: Municipal decision-making often struggles to engage large numbers of citizens in meaningful deliberation processes. The Common Ground mobile application, developed in Eindhoven through a consortium of start-ups and local institutions, aims to scale citizen consultations using digital facilitation.

name: Detecting 'unknown' companies with environmental risk
desc: Mapping unknown companies that pose a potential environmental risk by making smart use of data.

name: Detecting welfare fraud - Prediction of the likelihood of unlawful behavior on the House Market
authority: Totta Datalab, municipality of Nissewaard, municipality of Brielle
desc: Municipalities administering welfare benefits face pressure to prevent fraud while ensuring fair and lawful treatment of beneficiaries.

name: Detecting welfare fraud in the municipality of Deventer and Goirle (SyRI system)
authority: Municipality of Deventer, Municipality of Goirle
desc: Generating risk profiles of welfare recipients. On the basis of the risk score, it is determined whether a dossier is additionally investigated. (SyRI system)

name: Detection of aggression, panic and abnormal behaviour with smart cameras
desc: In this project, the private company ViNotion develops AI technology that analyzes the behavior of individuals and recognizes panic, aggression and deviant behavior early.

name: Detection of crime and subversion in the Municipality of Leudal (SyRI system)
desc: The municipality of Leudal uses algorithms (SyRI system) to detect crime and subversion: in buildings where the paperwork smacks of suspicious cases.

name: Detection of crime and subversion in the municipality of Dronten (SyRI system)
desc: Dronten Municipality has an experiment under way to investigate how algorithms (SyRI system) can be used to detect subversive crime

name: Detection of crime and subversion in the municipality of Maastricht (SyRI system)
desc: The municipality of Maastricht uses algorithms (SyRI system) to detect crime and subversion: in buildings where the paperwork smacks of suspicious cases.

name: Detection of crime and subversion in the municipality of Nederweert (SyRI system)
desc: The municipality of Nederweert uses algorithms (SyRI system) to detect crime and subversion: in buildings where the paperwork smacks of suspicious cases.

name: Diagnosis Plan and Control Tool - Assessing the risk of home fraud
desc: Municipal social services must prevent benefit fraud while ensuring proportional enforcement and safeguarding citizens’ rights.

name: Digital Twin Technology to Improve Operations
desc: The Port of Rotterdam initiated the development of a digital twin to enhance operational efficiency and optimise maritime logistics. Port operations involve complex coordination of vessel movements, infrastructure, and environmental conditions, where inefficiencies can lead to delays and increased costs.

name: Digital assistant for answering Parliamentary questions
authority: Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment
